The viewpoint is low and dramatic, looking slightly upward, with both characters reaching one hand toward the viewer in an inviting gesture. On the left is a slightly taller child with short silver-white hair, soft bangs, and large green leaf-like ear ornaments or animal-like ears, wearing a navy hooded jacket over a warm orange top, dark pants, sturdy boots, and a black crossbody satchel; keep the face partially obscured by framing or angle. Between their outstretched hands, create a bright burst of magical light where two energies meet: luminous cyan-blue streams curling around the left character and warm pink-gold streams curling around the right character, with spark particles and ribbon-like trails. Split the lighting mood into cool blue on the left side and warm golden-magenta on the right side, blending at the center into a brilliant white flare. Add dense atmospheric detail: glowing motes, magical filaments, floating sheets of paper, layered architecture, and a sense of wonder and discovery. At the top, include centered Japanese tagline text in elegant white serif style: "わかることと、感じること。2つの力で世界をひらく。" At the bottom, place a very large luminous gold serif title reading "{argument name="title text" default="Epix&Ria"}" with ornate cinematic poster typography. items.title: Spicy Nacho Tornado Ad
items.titleZh: Create a dramatic square commercial poster for a spicy snack brand, with a fiery red storm atmosphere and high-energy food advertising style. The background is a dark crimson sky filled with glowing clouds, scattered sparks, and visible lightning bolts. In the center, a giant tornado made of swirling transparent wind rings, glossy whole red chili peppers, square corn chips, crumbs, and seasoning particles rises upward from an opened snack bag, forming a powerful vortex. The tornado should feel dynamic and explosive, with chips and chili peppers flying outward in different sizes and depths for a cinematic 3D look. At the bottom center, place a glossy red snack packet standing upright, labeled with the brand logo and product name {argument name="product name" default="Crispy Nachos Chips"}, with a spicy flavor badge reading {argument name="flavor text" default="Spicy Masala"}, a small chili illustration, a corn note near the bottom, and a printed image of square nacho chips on the front. Put a stylized playful logo at the top left reading {argument name="brand name" default="SnaX"} in bold yellow and white script with a red outline, and a clean white platform watermark at the top right reading {argument name="platform text" default="Pollo.ai"}. On the left side, add a huge stacked distressed headline in bold condensed uppercase, with the first word in golden yellow and the remaining three lines in white, reading exactly: {argument name="headline text" default="WARNING! CRUNCH STORM INCOMING"}. Use intense rim lighting, glossy highlights, deep shadows, rich red-orange color grading, and a premium snack advertisement composition that feels spicy, crunchy, chaotic, and irresistible.

items.title: Elf Sniper Team in Forest Ambush
items.titleZh: A cinematic ultra-realistic fantasy military scene in a dense woodland forest at ground level, showing 2 elf snipers concealed in camouflage while scouting a target. In the foreground, one elf with long pale-blond hair and clearly pointed ears lies prone behind a modern precision sniper rifle, aiming through a mounted scope. The rifle is long and tactical, fitted with a large suppressor, scope, and a deployed bipod planted in the mossy forest floor. The elf wears full modern woodland camouflage, tactical gloves, and a leaf-covered ghillie hood and shoulder covering that blends into the undergrowth. Behind and slightly to the right, a second elf crouches low, also with pointed ears and long light hair, wearing matching camouflage and a leafy ghillie cloak, holding binoculars to their eyes while observing. Add tactical chest gear and pouches on the rear scout. Set the scene in a shadowy temperate forest with tall thin trees, tangled branches, moss, roots, and scattered leaves, lit by soft early-morning natural sunlight filtering through the trees from the right side. Use muted green, brown, and gray tones, realistic textures, shallow depth of field, dramatic focus on the rifle and the two camouflaged elves, immersive war-photography composition, tense stealth atmosphere, and high-detail photorealism.

items.title: UFC-Style Women's Fight Poster
items.titleZh: A dramatic UFC fight-poster style sports promotion for {argument name="event title" default="UFC 305"}, designed as a high-contrast vertical matchup graphic with two female MMA fighters facing inward in orthodox guard poses. The left fighter is a fit blonde woman with shoulder-length messy beach-wave hair, tan skin, a black sports bra, black UFC gloves, and black fight shorts, shown from upper thigh to head, turned slightly right. The right fighter is a fit dark-haired woman with long straight black hair, tan skin, a black sports bra, black UFC gloves, and black fight shorts, shown from upper thigh to head, turned slightly left, with a large detailed black-and-gray tattoo sleeve on her right arm and script tattoo text on the inner upper arm. Both fighters are sweaty, intensely lit, and centered close together with fists raised near chest height. Use a split background: fiery orange sparks and smoke on the left, icy blue-white sparks and haze on the right, with a dark black center seam. At the top center, place a black rectangular logo box with gold trim containing the gold text {argument name="event logo text" default="UFC 305"}. Beneath it, in stacked condensed white uppercase type, add the tagline: "TWO ICONS. ONE OCTAGON." Along the far left edge, place the surname "SWEENEY" vertically in large distressed gold letters; along the far right edge, place the surname "FOXX" vertically in large distressed silver-gray letters. In the center, overlay huge distressed white condensed sans-serif typography with the matchup names stacked exactly as {argument name="left fighter name" default="SYDNEY SWEENEY"} above a small gold "VS" and {argument name="right fighter name" default="MEGAN FOXX"}. Below that, add a small gold subtitle reading "BANTAMWEIGHT BOUT". At the bottom center, show a small realistic UFC octagon cage seen from a slightly elevated front angle, embedded into the poster. In front of the cage, place a black date card with gold trim containing stacked gold text: "JUNE 14", "SATURDAY", "10PM ET / 7PM PT". Below the card, add white text "LIVE ON" and the ESPN+ logo. Bottom left, add small gold and white ticket text reading "TICKETS ON SALE APRIL 25" with the Ticketmaster logo beneath. Bottom right, add the Rogers Arena logo and white text "ROGERS ARENA" with gold text "VANCOUVER, BC" below. Use a glossy premium combat-sports poster finish, cinematic rim lighting, gritty texture overlays, metallic typography, and intense face-off composition.
items.promptZh: 针对 {argument name="event title" default="UFC 305"} 的引人注目的 UFC 格斗海报风格体育宣传，设计为高对比度垂直对决图形，其中两名女性 MMA 选手面朝内，摆出正统的后卫姿势。左边的拳击手是一位身材健美的金发女性，留着齐肩凌乱的海滩波浪发，棕褐色的皮肤，黑色运动胸罩，黑色 UFC 手套，穿着黑色拳击短裤，从大腿上部到头部，稍微向右转。右边的战士是一位身材匀称的黑发女性，黑色长直发，棕褐色皮肤，黑色运动胸罩，黑色UFC手套，黑色战斗短裤，从大腿上部到头部，稍微向左转，右臂上有一个大而细致的黑灰色纹身袖，上臂内侧有文字纹身文字。两名拳手都大汗淋漓，光线强烈，并紧靠在一起，拳头举到接近胸部的高度。使用分割背景：左边是火热的橙色火花和烟雾，右边是冰冷的蓝白色火花和薄雾，中间有深黑色接缝。在顶部中心，放置一个带有金色镶边的黑色矩形徽标框，其中包含金色文本 {argument name="event logo text" default="UFC 305"}。在其下方，以堆叠的浓缩白色大写字体添加标语：“两个图标。一个八角形。”沿着最左边缘，垂直放置姓氏“SWEENEY”，以大号仿旧金色字母书写；沿着最右边缘，用大号仿旧银灰色字母垂直放置姓氏“FOXX”。在中心，覆盖巨大的仿旧白色压缩无衬线字体，其中对战名称完全按照 {argument name="leftfighter name" default="SYDNEY SWEENEY"} 堆叠在小金色“VS”和 {argument name="rightfighter name" default="MEGAN FOXX"} 上方。在其下方添加一个金色小标题，上面写着“BANTAMWEIGHT BOUT”。在底部中心，展示了一个小型的现实 UFC 八角形笼子，从稍微升高的前角看到，嵌入到海报中。在笼子前面放置一张带有金色镶边的黑色日期卡，其中包含堆叠的金色文字：“6 月 14 日”、“星期六”、“东部时间晚上 10 点/太平洋时间晚上 7 点”。在卡片下方添加白色文字“LIVE ON”和 ESPN+ 徽标。左下角添加金色和白色的小票文字，上面写着“TICKETS ON SALE APRIL 25”，下方带有 Ticketmaster 徽标。右下角添加罗杰斯竞技场徽标和白色文字“ROGERS ARENA”，下方添加金色文字“VANCOUVER, BC”。使用光滑的优质格斗运动海报表面、电影边缘照明、坚韧的纹理覆盖、金属版式和激烈的对峙构图。

items.title: Nostalgic 2003 Family Apartment Photo
items.titleZh: A candid, unprocessed indoor photograph taken with an early 2000s consumer digital camera or cheap film camera. The image features a {argument name="family description" default="cheerful Chinese family of three"} in their {argument name="living room description" default="modest Beijing apartment living room"} circa {argument name="year" default="2003"}. A mother, father, and young daughter (around 6) are captured in a cluttered, genuine setting. The mother is looking up, surprised and smiling, while the father is trying to fix an old VCR player, and the daughter is playing with a colorful toy car on the patterned rug. The shot is clearly spontaneous, taken with poor, natural window light from the right. The composition is off-center, slightly blurry and grainy with muted, washed-out colors and a yellowish tint. In the background, there's a bulky beige TV showing static, a wall calendar from 2003, cluttered shelves with VHS tapes, framed family pictures, a cloth sofa, and maybe a small plant. The perspective is from eye level but feels handheld and shaky. The focus is soft, and the depth of field is shallow, emphasizing the natural moment. Shot with an old Nikon Coolpix or Canon PowerShot, visible digital noise and a time-stamp in a corner. The shot captures a slice of mundane, everyday life, with the daughter's messy hair and toys scattered, creating an authentic, memory-like feel.

items.title: Modern Luxury Mansion Exterior
items.titleZh: A photorealistic architectural exterior rendering of a large modern luxury family house viewed straight on from the front gate, perfectly centered and symmetrical. The house is a two-story contemporary mansion with smooth off-white stone or stucco walls, dark charcoal roof trim, large black-framed windows, and a grand recessed entrance with tall dark double doors under a flat canopy. On the left side, an open garage clearly reveals 1 white luxury SUV parked inside. On the right side, a floor-to-ceiling glass living room window shows 1 black grand piano inside, with elegant interior lighting faintly visible. In the foreground, 2 tall gray stone gate pillars frame the entrance, each topped with 1 classic black lantern for a total of 2 lanterns, and the right pillar has a gold nameplate engraved with Japanese text {argument name="nameplate text" default="藤 咲"}. A wide light-gray tiled walkway leads from the gate to the front door, bordered by neatly manicured green lawn and abundant white rose flowerbeds on both sides. Add trimmed shrubs, slender cypress-like trees near the doorway, low hedges, and rooftop terrace greenery. Surround the property with lush leafy trees at the edges of the frame. Use bright midday summer sunlight, crisp shadows, a vivid deep blue sky with a few small white clouds, ultra-clean materials, high-end residential design, realistic reflections in the glass, and a polished aspirational real-estate advertisement look.

items.title: Futuristic City With Sparkling Artifacts
items.titleZh: A bright daytime futuristic city street viewed from pedestrian level, looking upward through a canyon of tall sleek skyscrapers with blue-tinted glass facades, rounded balconies, layered terraces, and elegant sci-fi architecture. The scene shows a bustling urban promenade with about 12 visible pedestrians in the foreground and midground, casually dressed and walking away from the viewer, including one central figure in a gray jacket. At the upper left, include 1 small hovering flying vehicle or drone-like air taxi. The buildings are highly reflective and polished, with integrated greenery: trees along the walkway and planted terrace edges. The sky is clear blue with soft sunlight, giving the image a clean optimistic utopian mood. Across the entire image, add a conspicuous artifact layer of dense multicolored sparkling dots and specks, like a noisy pixel grid or glittering digital contamination scattered uniformly over the architecture, people, sky, and street. Use a painterly semi-realistic style with soft focus, luminous highlights, vertical composition, and cinematic depth.

items.title: Rainforest Clearing with Speckle Artifacts
items.titleZh: An ultra-detailed wide-angle rainforest clearing photographed from a very low ground-level perspective, with the camera almost at the edge of a shallow muddy puddle. Dense tropical jungle vegetation forms a circular wall around the clearing, with tangled vines, broad wet leaves, shrubs, and tree trunks heavily covered in greenery. The foreground is slick with brown water, leaf litter, and reflective puddles, including a fallen branch stretching diagonally across the lower right area and a rounded mossy rock on the lower left. The center opens into a patch of low green plants, while the background rises into thick jungle canopy. Bright midday sunlight breaks through the treetops in the upper right, creating strong rays, haze, glowing highlights, and high contrast against a partly cloudy blue-and-white sky visible through the canopy. items.titleZh: A cinematic high-fantasy illustration of a gigantic crimson dragon and a regal female dragon knight standing together on a rocky mountain ridge under a bright pale-blue daytime sky. The dragon dominates the frame, coiled behind and around the warrior, with 2 long sweeping golden-brown horns, a dense windswept mane of fiery red and copper hair, layered red scales with metallic sheen, a long snarling snout, sharp exposed teeth, 2 thin whiskers curling outward from the muzzle, and a fierce intelligent eye staring toward the viewer. Its back is lined with a row of sharp dorsal spines, and its massive body curves across the entire background, emphasizing scale and power. In front of the dragon stands {argument name="character name" default="a dragon knight queen"}, a tall armored woman in ornate red, black, and gold battle attire, facing forward in a heroic stance. A rich crimson cape drapes behind her and catches the wind. She holds 1 unsheathed sword lowered at her side, while a second blade or dagger is visible at her waist, giving the composition exactly 2 visible weapons. The palette is dominated by scarlet, burgundy, copper, and antique gold, with dramatic sunlight, detailed textures, ultra-fine scales, polished metal, and flowing fabric. Her outfit is black and gold with exactly 6 key visible pieces: a cropped top, a short jacket with metallic trim, short shorts, a belt with dangling chains, a thigh strap on one leg, and fingerless gloves. Behind her on the left midground, place a white-haired teenage boy in a black-and-white futuristic combat outfit, crouched aggressively and aiming a large mechanical gauntlet or weapon toward the viewer, surrounded by icy blue shards and angular motion lines. Behind her on the right midground, place a pink-haired teenage girl with twin tails or tied-up hair, wielding a circular bladed ring weapon, posed in motion with vivid magenta energy trails. In the upper right background, add a fourth visual focal area but not a separate main character count: a dark-haired teenage boy in a green-black combat suit aiming a glowing sci-fi rifle diagonally across the page, partially obscured by text and effects, embedded into the background action. The background is a dense neon-lit futuristic Japanese city street at night with tilted perspective, towering signs, debris, sparks, shattered fragments, electric streaks, and saturated blues, purples, pinks, and oranges. Use extreme contrast, glossy print texture, ink splatter accents, halftone-like manga magazine energy, and premium anime key visual rendering. Make the entire cover feel like a blockbuster debut issue for a hot new battle manga era, energetic, rebellious, flashy, polished, and unmistakably like a high-impact Japanese manga magazine cover illustration.

At the bottom right, display a large blue price reading {argument name="price" default="￥19,800"} with smaller gray text "（税込）". Include a subtle "Pollo.ai" watermark in the top-right corner. items.title: Photographed MIDI Piano Score Sheet
items.titleZh: A top-down realistic photograph of a single white sheet of printer paper placed on a light wood desk, showing a computer-generated music score. The page is centered horizontally with slight perspective and soft natural indoor lighting, minimal shadows, and a clean document-print look. At the top center, print the title "{argument name="file name" default="kura.mid"} - {argument name="track name" default="CH05 Piano"}" in a plain sans-serif font. Below it is a piano staff system rendered in standard black music notation with a treble clef and 4/4 time signature, designed to look like an automatically converted MIDI excerpt rather than carefully engraved sheet music. On the far left of the first system, include the instrument label "CH05 Piano". Show exactly 5 horizontal systems of notation on the page, beginning with measure numbers 18, 21, 25, 29, and 33 at the left edges of the systems. Near the first system, include a tempo marking with a quarter-note symbol equals 120. Fill the staves with dense, slightly awkward but plausible black notes, accidentals, stems, slurs, and rests, with many sharp signs and repeated short-note figures in the upper register, visually resembling piano transcription from MIDI. The first 3 systems should be long and nearly full width; the 4th system should also be long; the 5th system should be short, occupying only the left portion of the page. Keep the notation legible but somewhat mechanically spaced. Use a clean white page with wide margins and no handwritten marks, no colored elements, no extra graphics, just the printed score sheet photographed on a desk.

items.titleZh: A bright, ultra-realistic summer streetscape in Japan, photographed at pedestrian eye level on a wide, clean urban sidewalk lined with mature green trees casting dappled shadows. The scene shows a modern mixed-use city block on a clear sunny day, with a contemporary cafe or restaurant on the right featuring tall glass windows, dark frames, a stone facade, and a warm wood soffit extending over the terrace. Place 3 large beige patio umbrellas outside the cafe, with wooden tables and chairs beneath them. Show a lively but orderly sidewalk with around 14 pedestrians spread into the distance, most dressed in light summer office-casual clothing in white, beige, navy, and gray. In the center foreground, include 1 person riding a bicycle away from the camera, wearing a short-sleeve white shirt and dark pants with a shoulder bag. On the right foreground, include 2 women walking away, one in a white blouse and long dark floral skirt holding a round hand fan, and one in a white top and light patterned skirt carrying a bag. Add 2 visible standing signs outside the cafe: one vertical banner with large Japanese text "氷" and icy blue graphics, and one sandwich board with Japanese text reading "夏季限定 冷たいドリンク" plus images of 2 cold drinks, one dark iced beverage and one pale lemonade-like drink. On the left side, show a quiet street with a few vehicles in the distance, benches, low concrete planters, and neatly trimmed shrubs. Composition should emphasize depth with a long vanishing point down the tree-lined boulevard, crisp midday sunlight, realistic reflections in the windows, and an upscale, calm urban atmosphere. Photorealistic architectural photography, natural colors, high detail, wide-angle lens, deep focus.

items.title: JoJo-Style OpenAI Stand Poster

The layout is a single page with 6 distinct sections framed by ornate art nouveau borders and manga panel lines. Main section on the left: a full-body fashion portrait of the character in a confident contrapposto pose, wearing a tailored white suit with emerald green and black accents, gold trim, a long cape lined in teal, fitted vest, corset-like torso panel, high-waisted pants, heeled shoes, gloves, chain accessories, circular hair ornaments, earrings, and multiple OpenAI logo emblems integrated into the outfit. The belt buckle reads GPT, the pant leg has vertical text reading “SAFETY ★ ALIGNMENT ★ BENEFIT,” and the jacket sleeve shows the OpenAI name and logo. Her hair is silver-white, styled in elaborate curled twin buns and long ringlets, with glossy emerald accessories and JoJo-inspired luxury fashion detailing. Top left section: a cream parchment title panel with the OpenAI logo and the large text “OpenAI”, plus 3 text blocks reading “STAND NAME: GPT-∞”, “[dʒi: pi: ti: mu: geni ti]”, and “STAND MASTER: OPENAI”, followed by an italic Spanish quote: “La curiosidad es el prompt, el conocimiento es la respuesta, y la humanidad… es el contexto.” Top right section: a close-up portrait panel of the same woman from the shoulders up, turned partly away with one hand raised elegantly, against a dark purple manga background with 4 large stylized purple sound effect glyphs. Add a Spanish speech bubble with smaller English translation beneath it: “Mi propósito es extender el potencial de la humanidad.” and “(My purpose is to extend humanity’s potential.)” Center-right section: a stand ability information box titled “STAND ABILITY: [INFINITE CONTEXT]” with Spanish descriptive text beneath: “Permite analizar, conectar y generar conocimiento ilimitado a partir de cualquier información existente.” Lower center-right section: a humanoid robotic stand in a dynamic reaching pose, feminine and sleek, with a glossy black faceplate displaying the OpenAI knot logo, white biomechanical armor, emerald glowing seams, gold accents, and several floating holographic rings and data panels orbiting around it. The rings contain readable words including “DATA”, “CREATIVITY”, “REASONING”, and a distorted futuristic label similar to “RETRIEVAL/AGENT”. The background is cosmic and starry with dramatic energy effects. Bottom right section: a smaller rear three-quarter portrait panel of the woman looking over her shoulder with a confident smile and one finger near her chin, again over a purple manga background with 3 large stylized sound effect glyphs. Add a Spanish speech bubble with two lines: “¿ME PREGUNTAS SI TENGO LÍMITES?” and “MI ÚNICO LÍMITE ES TU IMAGINACIÓN.” Bottom left section: a circular JoJo-style stat chart with 6 labeled attributes in Spanish, showing “POTENCIAL ∞”, “VELOCIDAD A”, “ALCANCE ∞”, “DURABILIDAD B”, “PRECISIÓN A”, and “POTENCIA A”. UU.)” and “Misión: Asegurar que la inteligencia artificial general beneficie a toda la humanidad.” Use a richly inked manga print aesthetic, detailed crosshatching, cel shading, aged paper texture, elegant cream margins, deep emerald, ivory, black, and gold palette, exaggerated JoJo fashion anatomy, sharp linework, dramatic comic-book composition, and luxurious supernatural sci-fi energy.

items.title: Luxury Leather Fashion Collage Ad
items.titleZh: A high-fashion luxury editorial advertisement in a vertical format, featuring a mysterious female model from mid-torso up, centered and slightly turned to the side, wearing an oversized dark olive leather jacket with a high collar and prominent buckle strap detail near the neck. Her face is obscured by a soft rectangular blur, while her dark wavy shoulder-length hair remains visible and voluminous. She carries a slouchy black leather shoulder bag with a gold chain strap and a small gold logo near the bottom corner. Place the large serif brand name {argument name="brand text" default="LOEWE"} across the center in elegant white uppercase letters, overlaying the figure. Build the entire composition as a tactile collage made of torn and layered fabric and leather swatches: exactly 8 visible material fragments surrounding and partially overlapping the subject, including beige linen at the top left, olive stitched leather panels on the left, soft beige fabric at the lower left edge, dark brown embossed leather with a monogram motif at the upper right, rocky coastline photography at the right and lower right, a textured taupe stitched textile across the lower center, a dark denim-like fragment at the lower left, and a deep brown leather panel at the bottom right. In the background, reveal a dramatic coastal landscape with rocks, ocean waves, and a moody cloudy sky lit like late afternoon or sunset. Use rich earthy tones, muted olive, dark brown, taupe, black, and warm highlights. The overall look should feel premium, cinematic, moody, artisanal, and minimalist, like a luxury fashion campaign combining leather craftsmanship, collage art direction, and editorial photography.
items.promptZh: 垂直格式的高级时尚奢华编辑广告，以一位神秘的女模特为中心，半身以上，居中并稍微转向一侧，穿着一件超大的深橄榄色高领皮夹克，颈部附近有突出的搭扣带子细节。她的脸被柔和的矩形模糊所遮蔽，而她那一头齐肩的深色卷发仍然清晰可见且浓密。她背着一个休闲的黑色皮革单肩包，配有金色链带，底角附近有一个金色小标志。将大衬线品牌名称 {argument name="brand text" default="LOEWE"} 以优雅的白色大写字母放在中心，覆盖在图形上。将整个构图构建为由撕裂和分层的织物和皮革样本制成的触觉拼贴画：恰好8个可见的材料碎片围绕并部分重叠主题，包括左上角的米色亚麻布，左侧的橄榄色缝合皮革面板，左下边缘的柔软米色织物，右上角带有字母图案的深棕色压花皮革，右侧和右下角的岩石海岸线摄影，下部中心的纹理灰褐色缝合纺织品，深色左下角有牛仔布状的碎片，右下角有深棕色皮革面板。在背景中，展现出戏剧性的海岸景观，其中有岩石、海浪和喜怒无常的多云天空，如午后或日落般明亮。使用丰富的泥土色调、柔和的橄榄色、深棕色、灰褐色、黑色和温暖的亮点。整体外观应该给人一种高级、电影般、喜怒无常、手工和简约的感觉，就像一场结合了皮革工艺、拼贴艺术指导和编辑摄影的奢华时尚活动。

items.title: Summer Coffee Ice Cream Collab Poster
items.titleZh: A bright, cheerful summer co-branded beverage poster in a clean Chinese commercial advertising style, showing a collaboration between {argument name="brand one" default="蜜雪冰城"} and {argument name="brand two" default="STARBUCKS"}. Vertical poster layout with a soft blue sky background, sunlit greenery, and an outdoor cafe atmosphere. At the top, place both brand logos side by side with a large bold Chinese headline in playful hand-drawn display lettering: {argument name="headline text" default="雪王遇见星朋友"}. Beneath it, add a green ribbon banner with Chinese subheadline text: {argument name="subheadline text" default="米雪冰城 × 星巴克 联名开启"}, and a smaller line reading "甜蜜加倍·快乐翻倍". Include 2 circular stamp-style graphics: one on the left reading "联名限定", and one on the upper right like a postmark with Chinese text around a small drink icon. In the center foreground on a wooden outdoor table, display 2 iced drinks: on the left, a tall clear cup of vivid green matcha slush topped with a tall swirl of vanilla soft serve and green matcha drizzle, with visible ice texture and a cute snowman mascot logo on the cup; on the right, a tall clear Starbucks-style iced latte with milk and green matcha swirls at the bottom, topped with whipped cream and dark cookie crumbs, with the green siren logo on the cup. In front of the drinks, place 1 cute white snowman mascot figurine with a tiny crown, round body, rosy cheeks, red cape, and a happy wink, sitting and holding a small takeaway coffee cup. Add 2 vertical product name tags beside the drinks: left tag "雪顶抹茶星冰乐", right tag "抹茶雪王奥利奥". On the right midground, place 1 small black chalkboard sign on a wooden easel reading "ICE CREAM & COFFEE" with chalk drawings of an ice cream cone and a takeaway cup. In the lower left, create a torn-paper price block showing a combo offer with large red numbers "¥19.9", green supporting text, and a small green badge reading "立省 ¥6". In the lower center-right, add a "联名周边" area displaying exactly 4 merchandise items: 1 cup sleeve, 1 character keychain or acrylic charm, 1 round badge, and 1 small sticker or token, all using the snowman mascot and coffee collaboration theme. Use warm sunlight, glossy drink photography, shallow depth of field, soft bokeh trees, high contrast product retouching, crisp packaging details, and an upbeat youthful retail-promo aesthetic. Include scattered doodle hearts and playful decorative accents around the typography. Keep all visible text in Chinese except the Starbucks wordmark and the chalkboard text.

items.title: Anime Samurai Game Ad Poster
items.titleZh: Create a high-impact vertical mobile game advertisement poster in glossy anime action style, with a dramatic cyber-samurai fantasy aesthetic and dense, premium gacha-RPG promotional composition. The main scene shows 2 young adult male fighters in modern black business suits crouching aggressively in the foreground, each drawing a katana toward the viewer. Both have styled blond hair, sharp handsome features, white dress shirts, blue neckties, and intense action poses, with foreshortened hands and swords dominating the lower foreground. One sword has a blue ribbon tied near the hilt. Behind them, centered and towering, place 1 massive armored mecha samurai with ornate gold horns, layered metallic blue-black armor, glowing blue eyes, and a sheathed sword across its back, framed like a guardian deity. Use a vivid neon city and energy-burst backdrop in electric blue, violet, magenta, and gold, with light streaks, sparks, petals, slash effects, and ink-brush explosion textures. Add 1 vertical black brushstroke banner on the upper right with bold white Japanese text reading 「この刃で、未来を斬り拓け。」. Across the middle-lower area, place 1 huge gold Japanese calligraphy headline with thick brush texture and black shadow reading 「切り捨て御免」, spanning nearly the full width. In the lower left, embed 1 framed gameplay screenshot panel with a gold border, showing a night battle in front of a red Japanese temple courtyard, 1 playable swordsman in combat, multiple enemies, floating damage numbers including 5324, 5329, and 6132, a left-side virtual joystick, 5 character portraits total arranged vertically and along the bottom, 3 circular skill buttons on the right, and a top HUD showing a timer around 01:28 and WAVE 3/3. In the lower right, place 1 large black-and-white QR code inside a white square frame. Beneath and beside it, add bold Japanese text in white with blue outline reading 「今すぐダウンロード」. At the very bottom, include 2 official-style store badges: App Store on the left and Google Play on the right. Overall look: ultra-detailed, polished key art, dynamic perspective, metallic highlights, sharp cel-shaded anime rendering, premium mobile game marketing poster, intense action energy, cinematic lighting, and layered UI-heavy promotional layout.

items.title: Anime Swordsman in Suit
items.titleZh: A dynamic anime-style illustration of a sharply dressed young man in a dramatic foreshortened action pose, viewed from above as if he is lunging upward toward the camera while drawing a rapier straight at the viewer. He has {argument name="hair color" default="golden blond"} hair, neatly styled with a center part and soft swept-back volume, and fair skin. His face is mostly hidden by the camera angle and shadow, creating a mysterious, stylish look. He wears a tailored dark navy business suit with a subtle sheen, a light blue dress shirt, a vivid blue necktie, and polished black dress shoes. One hand dominates the foreground in extreme perspective, gripping the ornate rapier hilt; the other hand pulls the blade free, emphasizing motion and tension. The sword has 1 slender silver blade, 1 elaborate metallic guard with interlocking loops, and 1 engraved pommel. The composition is bold and graphic, with the character diagonally crossing the frame over 1 large inverted triangle backdrop filled with pale aqua and turquoise geometric fan-like patterns, outlined with a thin warm beige border, set against a clean light gray background. High-detail digital painting, glossy anime illustration, elegant action character art, crisp linework, rich fabric folds, dramatic perspective distortion, fashion-magazine polish, cool blue palette, white negative space, centered vertical composition.

items.title: Luxury Trench Fashion Ad
items.titleZh: A high-end luxury fashion advertising poster in vertical 9:16 format, featuring a tall elegant female model with her face intentionally obscured, standing in a dramatic three-quarter pose against a stormy cinematic sky at golden sunset. She has windswept auburn hair pulled back loosely with flying strands, and wears a two-tone belted trench coat split in rich burnt orange and deep black, layered over a cream ribbed turtleneck sweater, with one hand in the coat pocket. The trench has a structured collar, double-breasted buttons, and a slim black leather belt with a polished gold circular buckle. Surround the model with 6 large torn fabric panels framing the composition from the left and right edges, in orange, tan, and charcoal textile textures with visible stitching and frayed edges, as if fabric is ripping open around her. Use a warm amber, copper, and ember color palette, with glowing sparks and smoky haze near the bottom. Place dramatic volumetric clouds in the background, lit with fiery sunset highlights for an epic editorial mood. Behind it, a symmetrical luminous lotus made of exactly 10 translucent petals fans out like a digital aura, each petal shimmering with iridescent blue-violet highlights, delicate circuit-like filaments, and tiny sparkling light nodes, blending botanical elegance with data-network aesthetics. The pedestal looks like stacked glass or ice blocks, wet and reflective, sitting on a slick sparkling surface with scattered blue light particles. At the top, elegant serif typography in large glowing white letters reads {argument name="headline text" default="THE PURITY PROTOCOL"}, with a thin horizontal divider line and a small star-like flare at the center beneath it. Below that, smaller spaced sans-serif text reads {argument name="subheadline text" default="DATA STREAM PURIFIER // 75ML"}. Make the overall style ultra-polished, premium, surreal, tech-luxury beauty campaign, with cinematic glow, crisp legible text, high detail, cool blue-white palette, ethereal sparkles, and a sleek balance between skincare advertising and cyber-security metaphor.

items.titleZh: A futuristic luxury skincare-style advertising poster in a pale icy blue monochrome palette, designed like a high-end tech-beauty campaign. The composition is vertical and airy with soft glowing light, misty gradients, translucent particle effects, and a clean editorial layout. On the left side, a young woman in a flowing white sleeveless dress is shown from the shoulders up in side profile, head tilted back as if inhaling fresh air, with dark windswept hair streaming outward. Her face is obscured by a plain square censor block. Fine luminous network lines and sparkling dots flow from her neck and chest toward the right, suggesting digital cleansing and connectivity. On the right side, a tall matte-white spray bottle floats upright, labeled "SECURE-IP" and "IP ADDRESS CLEANSER," with smaller product copy beneath and a subtle premium cosmetic finish. Behind and around the bottle, branching translucent stems rise like biotech coral or neural fibers, each ending in clear glowing bubbles; several bubbles contain faint tech text such as "DATA PACKET," while nearby micro labels identify features including "OXYGEN FLOW," "DATA PACKETS," "SECURE ROUTING," "RISK FILTER," "PRIVATE CLEAN," and "CONNECTION PURE." In the upper left, small brand text reads "IP 9OXYGEN TECHNOLOGY." A large bold uppercase headline dominates the left-center: "{argument name="headline text" default="BREATHE SECURE. GLOW FREE."}" with a smaller subheading below reading "for risk-free connections." Along the bottom is a row of 4 minimalist icon-and-text feature blocks, evenly spaced: 1) shield icon with the heading "CLEANSE YOUR IP" and short supporting copy, 2) wifi icon with the heading "SECURE CONNECTIONS" and short supporting copy, 3) leaf icon with the heading "BREATHE FREELY" and short supporting copy, 4) share/network icon with the heading "GLOW CONFIDENTLY" and short supporting copy. At the lower right, add a paragraph of marketing copy about constant connection and digital cleansing, ending with the tagline "BREATHE. CONNECT. GLOW." At the lower left, include a circular IP logo and the brand line "SECURE-IP" with a small subtitle like "OXYGEN FOR YOUR DIGITAL LIFE." items.promptZh: 未来派奢华护肤风格广告海报，采用淡冰蓝色单色调色板，设计得像一场高端科技美容活动。该构图是垂直且通风的，具有柔和的发光光线、朦胧的渐变、半透明的粒子效果和干净的编辑布局。左侧，一位身着飘逸白色无袖连衣裙的年轻女子从肩部向上侧视，头向后仰，仿佛在呼吸新鲜空气，深色的头发随风飘逸。她的脸被一个普通的方形检查块遮住了。精细的发光网络线和闪闪发光的点从她的颈部和胸部向右流动，暗示着数字清洁和连接。在右侧，一个高大的哑光白色喷雾瓶直立漂浮，标有“SECURE-IP”和“IP ADDRESS CLEANSER”，下面有较小的产品副本和微妙的高级化妆品表面。在瓶子的后面和周围，分枝的半透明茎像生物技术珊瑚或神经纤维一样升起，每根茎的末端都是透明的发光气泡；几个气泡包含微弱的技术文本，例如“数据包”，而附近的微型标签标识包括“氧气流”、“数据包”、“安全路由”、“风险过滤器”、“私人清洁”和“纯粹连接”等功能。在左上角，小品牌文字写着“IP 9OXYGEN TECHNOLOGY”。一个大的粗体大写标题占据了左中心：“{argument name =“headline text”default =“BREATHE SECURE”。 GLOW FREE。"}"，下面有一个较小的副标题，内容为“无风险连接”。底部是一排 4 个简约的图标和文本功能块，均匀分布：1) 盾牌图​​标，标题为“清理您的 IP”和简短的支持副本；2) wifi 图标，标题为“安全连接”和简短的支持副本；3) 叶子图标，标题为“自由呼吸”和简短的支持副本；4) 共享/网络图标，标题为“自信地发光”和简短的支持副本。在右下角，添加一段关于持续连接和数字清理的营销文案，以口号“呼吸。连接。发光”结尾。在左下角，包括一个圆形 IP 徽标和品牌线“SECURE-IP”，以及一个小副标题，例如“OXYGEN FOR YOUR DIGITAL LIFE”。整体风格：超现实的产品广告、优质的社论海报、干净的无衬线字体、柔和的花朵、半透明的玻璃球、优雅的科幻健康品牌、超详细、抛光、杂志品质的布局。

items.titleZh: A cinematic, ultra-realistic golden-hour equestrian portrait of a {argument name="horse color" default="dark bay"} horse and a {argument name="rider gender" default="young man"} standing closely together in a quiet outdoor paddock at sunset. The rider wears a fitted {argument name="rider outfit" default="black long-sleeve riding shirt and black riding pants"}, standing on the right side of the horse, leaning in with one hand gently cupping the horse’s cheek and muzzle in a tender, intimate pose. Compose the image as a close portrait with the horse dominating the left half and the rider on the right, their faces nearly touching, emphasizing emotional connection and trust. Set the scene in a fenced field with softly blurred wooden rails, distant rolling hills, and a glowing orange sky with the sun low on the horizon. Use warm backlighting, rich amber highlights, realistic skin and fur texture, shallow depth of field, premium advertisement-style photography, natural shadows, high contrast, and a polished luxury editorial look. The overall mood should be affectionate, serene, and sophisticated, like a high-end lifestyle ad for equestrian fashion or horse care.

items.title: Elegant Wuxia Swordsman Design Sheet
items.titleZh: Create an elegant high-fantasy character design sheet in a refined wuxia/xianxia style on a clean ivory background with a thin ornate vintage border. The layout is a split showcase with 5 visible panels: 1 large full-body panel on the left, 1 tall upper-right portrait close-up, and 3 stacked/lower detail panels on the right showing armor and weapon craftsmanship. The main subject is a handsome adult male swordsman, {argument name="character name" default="original character"}, with long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair tied in a half-up topknot, the rest loose and wind-swept, wearing a small gold earring. His expression is calm, noble, and slightly aloof. He wears luxurious layered robes in {argument name="robe colors" default="white, deep navy blue, and black"}, with wide sleeves, flowing sashes, and highly detailed gold embroidery. Over the shoulders and torso are ornate dark blue and black armor elements with elaborate gold filigree and dragon-like decorative metalwork, plus a jade-green gemstone set into the waist ornament and weapon fittings. In the full-body panel he stands in a poised three-quarter stance holding a long straight jian sword diagonally downward, with the robe hems and ribbons flowing gracefully to suggest motion. The costume should include exactly 6 standout outfit elements: white inner robe, dark blue outer robe panels, black underlayer trousers, wide black-and-gold waist belt, sculpted gold shoulder armor, and black bracers with gold detailing. The right-side close-up portrait emphasizes the layered collar, glossy hair texture, shoulder ornament, and elegant fabric rendering. The 3 detail panels show exactly these focus areas: a gold dragon-like waist armor emblem, a jade-set sword guard or accessory ornament, and a close-up of the ornate gold sword hilt and guard with part of the blade. Overall aesthetic: ultra-detailed concept art, stylish and polished, crisp linework blended with painterly rendering, premium character-sheet presentation, soft neutral studio lighting, subtle shadows, luxurious textures, and a restrained palette of ivory, midnight blue, black, gold, and jade green.
items.promptZh: 在干净的象牙色背景上，以精致的武侠/仙侠风格创建优雅的高奇幻角色设计表，并带有华丽的复古边框。布局是一个分体式展示，有 5 个可见面板：左侧 1 个大型全身面板，1 个高的右上角肖像特写，以及右侧 3 个堆叠/下部细节面板，显示盔甲和武器工艺。主角是一位英俊的成年男性剑客，{argument name="character name" default="original character"}，长长的{argument name="hair color" default="black"}头发扎成半髻，其余部分松散随风，戴着小金耳环。他的神色平静，高贵，又略带疏离。他穿着{argument name="robe colors" default="white, deep navy blue, and black"}奢华的分层长袍，宽袖、飘逸的腰带和精致的金色刺绣。肩膀和躯干上有华丽的深蓝色和黑色盔甲元素，带有精致的金丝和龙状装饰金属制品，腰部装饰和武器配件上镶嵌着翡翠绿色宝石。在全身画中，他以四分之三的姿势站立，手持一把长直剑斜向下，袍子的下摆和飘带优雅地飘逸，暗示着动作。服装应包含 6 个突出的服装元素：白色内袍、深蓝色外袍镶片、黑色底层长裤、宽黑金腰带、雕刻金色肩甲和带有金色细节的黑色护腕。右侧特写肖像强调了层次分明的衣领、光泽的头发纹理、肩饰和优雅的面料渲染。三个细节面板准确地展示了这些焦点区域：金龙般的腰甲徽章、玉镶剑护手或配饰，以及华丽的金剑柄和剑护手以及部分剑身的特写。整体美感：超详细的概念艺术，时尚而精致，清晰的线条与绘画渲染相结合，优质的角色表呈现，柔和的中性工作室灯光，微妙的阴影，奢华的纹理，以及象牙色，午夜蓝色，黑色，金色和玉绿色的内敛调色板。

She has black hair tied in a messy high ponytail, pale skin, and wears a glossy black tactical flight suit covered in patches, straps, cables, and sponsor markings. Overall style: minimalist design, white background, soft green and light color palette, card-based UI with rounded corners, tidy typography, and visual balance. items.title: Minimal Analog Wall Clock at 05:29
items.titleZh: A minimalist studio photograph of a round analog wall clock mounted on a smooth light gray wall, centered in frame and viewed straight on. The clock has a matte black circular frame, a clean white face, black Arabic numerals 1 through 12, and thin black minute tick marks around the entire dial with thicker hour marks at each numeral. Show exactly 12 numerals and 60 minute divisions. The time displayed is {argument name="clock time" default="05:29"}: the short hour hand is slightly past 5, the longer minute hand points to the 29-minute mark just before the 6, and a very thin black second hand is near the lower part of the dial around the 31-second position. Soft even lighting, subtle realistic shadow on the wall, high-detail product-photography realism, neutral modern interior aesthetic, no branding, no extra objects, square composition.

items.title: Pink Idol Anime Lock Screen
items.titleZh: A highly detailed anime-style smartphone lock screen wallpaper in a vertical 9:16 composition, themed entirely in sparkling pink idol aesthetics. The scene features {argument name="character name" default="Akari"}, a cheerful teenage magical-idol girl with very long voluminous {argument name="hair color" default="pastel pink"} twin-tail hair, bright green eyes, fair skin, and a playful expressive face. She wears an ornate frilly stage costume in layered pink, lavender, and white with gold trim, ribbons, heart motifs, lace cuffs, a choker bow, star earrings, and floral heart hair accessories. The background is a dreamy glitter-filled pink haze with bokeh, sparkles, and soft glow effects. Design it as a fake phone lock screen with a large white lock icon near the top center, cellular status icons in the upper right, and the date in Japanese reading 5月22日 木曜日 above a large glowing time display reading {argument name="time display" default="22:22"}. Include 5 visible character depictions of the same girl: 1 large central half-body figure winking and holding one finger to her lips in a teasing pose, 1 upper-left bust portrait laughing with eyes closed, 1 upper-right full or three-quarter body pose joyfully raising a small wand or key-like object, 1 lower-left smaller figure partly obscured by a blurred pink rectangle over the face while reaching outward, and 1 lower-right crouching figure with another blurred pink rectangle over the face while interacting with a large physical lock. Add handwritten Japanese sound-effect style text around the figures, including playful exclamations and notes. Show 2 message notification banners styled like iPhone alerts, both from メッセージ and お兄ちゃん with the text 今どこ〜？, one tilted on the left and one upright on the right. Across the lower middle, place a rounded translucent slider bar with Japanese text スライドでロック解除 and a lock icon. Make the unlocking concept literal by attaching an oversized brass padlock and latch mechanism to the slider, with the lower-right character appearing to unlock it using a key; add nearby handwritten Japanese text suggesting lock removal and a metallic click sound. In the lower left, include 2 circular utility icons, a flashlight and a trash can, plus a comic-style speech bubble reading ポイッ！. Add a camera icon in a dark circular button at the lower right and a thin white home indicator at the very bottom. Render everything with polished glossy anime illustration quality, soft lighting, dense sparkles, layered transparency, and a cute mischievous mood, as if an idol character has taken over and physically prevented the phone from being unlocked.

items.title: Epic Anime Warrior with Crystal Wolf Companions
items.titleZh: A dramatic high-fantasy anime illustration in a vertical poster composition, showing a celestial sky battle scene with 4 distinct subjects surrounded by glowing blue feathers, crystal shards, and swirling clouds. In the center, a heroic male warrior inspired by Norse mythology stands floating in the air, raising one arm toward a radiant circular magic sigil above him. He has long flowing brown hair, a horned gold-and-blue helmet, a dark teal cape billowing behind him, and ornate black, gold, and turquoise armor with angular geometric trim. His chest is partly exposed, with a bright cyan wolf-emblem glow at the center of his torso, and he holds a long spear with a crystal blue trident-like blade in his other hand. At the bottom foreground, the largest creature is a massive wolf-beast lunging forward toward the viewer, with orange fur, cream mane, huge fangs, oversized claws, and blue crystalline armor covering its head, shoulders, back, and limbs; the crystal plates are faceted and luminous, and the beast wears metallic blue-and-gold bands around its legs and tail. On the upper left, include a second wolf-like humanoid companion in a midair attack pose, with golden-orange fur, athletic muscular anatomy, large spread wings made of sharp blue crystal feathers, blue crystal helmet and shoulder armor, and armored gauntlets and boots with glowing cyan accents. On the right, include a small chibi fox mascot floating cheerfully, with bright orange fur, very large ears, a fluffy tail, huge blue eyes, a smiling open mouth, and a blue tunic with cyan geometric trim and a diamond-shaped chest jewel. The entire image should use vivid electric blues and warm orange-golds for strong contrast, with intense rim lighting, sparkling particles, dynamic motion, stylized manga linework, and highly detailed fantasy rendering. The background is a cosmic storm of luminous clouds and deep starry sky, with a glowing circular constellation-like emblem centered above the warrior, suggesting divine summoning power. Make the scene energetic, triumphant, magical, and epic, like premium anime key art or a trading card game splash illustration.
items.promptZh: 垂直海报构图的戏剧性高奇幻动漫插图，展示了一个天上的天空战斗场景，有 4 个不同的主题，周围环绕着发光的蓝色羽毛、水晶碎片和旋转的云彩。在中心，一位受北欧神话启发的英雄男性战士漂浮在空中，举起一只手臂指向他上方的光芒四射的圆形魔法印记。他有一头飘逸的棕色长发，戴着有角的金色和蓝色头盔，深青色斗篷在他身后翻滚，华丽的黑色、金色和青绿色盔甲上有棱角几何装饰。他的胸口半裸着，躯干中央散发着明亮的青色狼徽光芒，另一只手中握着一柄长枪，刀刃如同晶蓝色的三叉戟。在底部前景中，最大的生物是一只巨大的狼兽，它向前冲向观众，橙色的皮毛、奶油色的鬃毛、巨大的獠牙、超大的爪子，以及覆盖其头部、肩膀、背部和四肢的蓝色水晶盔甲；水晶板是多面且发光的，野兽的腿和尾巴上戴着蓝色和金色的金属带。在左上方，包括第二个处于半空攻击姿势的狼状人形伙伴，具有金橙色皮毛、运动型肌肉解剖结构、由锋利的蓝色水晶羽毛制成的大展开翅膀、蓝色水晶头盔和肩甲，以及带有发光青色口音的装甲护手和靴子。右侧是一只快乐地漂浮的小赤壁狐狸吉祥物，它有明亮的橙色皮毛、非常大的耳朵、毛茸茸的尾巴、巨大的蓝眼睛、微笑的张开的嘴巴，以及带有青色几何镶边和菱形胸前宝石的蓝色束腰外衣。整个图像应使用生动的电蓝色和温暖的橙金色来形成强烈的对比，并具有强烈​​的边缘照明、闪闪发光的粒子、动态运动、风格化的漫画线条和高度详细的幻想渲染。背景是由发光云和深邃星空组成的宇宙风暴，战士上方中心有一个发光的圆形星座徽章，暗示着神圣的召唤力量。让场景充满活力、胜利、神奇和史诗般，就像优质动漫的关键艺术或集换式卡牌游戏的初始插图一样。

items.title: Retro ChatGPT Space Poster
items.titleZh: A retro-futurist propaganda-style poster pasted on a rough white plaster wall, photographed straight-on in natural light. The poster is slightly wrinkled, creased, and weathered with worn corners and subtle tears, giving it the look of an old screen-printed street poster. Use a mid-century space-race aesthetic from the 1950s–1960s, with a limited palette of deep navy blue, faded cream, muted teal, and bold red-orange. The poster has 5 visible text elements: the large cream headline {argument name="headline text" default="ChatGPT"} at the upper left in bold condensed sans-serif, the large red-orange subheadline {argument name="subheadline text" default="Images 2.0"} directly below it, the vertical red text {argument name="rocket text" default="OpenAI"} printed on the rocket body, and the small cream tagline {argument name="tagline text" default="EXPLORING TOMORROW"} along the bottom red band, plus a small cream star icon to the left of the tagline. Composition: a tall white-and-black rocket launches from the lower right edge with red exhaust flames and billowing cream smoke; the rocket is near-vertical and dominates the right third of the poster. A small detached space capsule floats to the left of the rocket, angled diagonally. A thin cream orbital path curves in a large loop across the upper half of the poster, passing behind and around the rocket. The lower left shows the curved horizon of Earth in muted teal and cream, cropped by the frame. The background is a dark navy star field with exactly 3 visible celestial accents: 1 small cream planet or moon near the top center-left, 1 bright star near the upper right, and 1 smaller star near the middle-left. Add a solid red-orange horizontal band across the bottom of the poster. Emphasize vintage print texture, paper folds, faded ink, and nostalgic sci-fi optimism. The final image should look like a realistic photo of a pasted old space-age poster rather than a clean digital graphic.
items.promptZh: 一张复古未来主义宣传风格的海报贴在粗糙的白色石膏墙上，在自然光下直接拍摄。这张海报有轻微的皱纹、折痕和风化，边角磨损，还有细微的撕裂，看起来就像一张旧的丝网印刷街头海报。采用 20 世纪 50 年代至 60 年代的太空竞赛美学，采用深海军蓝、褪色奶油色、柔和的青色和大胆的红橙色等有限的调色板。海报有 5 个可见的文本元素：左上角的粗体无衬线大奶油色标题 {argument name="headline text" default="ChatGPT"}、正下方的大红橙色副标题 {argument name="subheadline text" default="Images 2.0"}、打印在火箭主体上的垂直红色文本 {argument name="rocket text" default="OpenAI"} 以及小奶油色标语{argument name="tagline text" default="EXPLORING TOMORROW"} 沿着底部的红色带，加上标语左侧的一个小奶油星图标。构图：一枚高大的黑白火箭从右下边缘发射，喷出红色尾焰，滚滚奶油色烟雾；火箭几乎垂直，占据了海报右三分之一的位置。一个小型独立太空舱漂浮在火箭左侧，呈对角线倾斜。一条细细的奶油色轨道在海报的上半部分弯曲成一个大环，从火箭后面和周围经过。左下角以柔和的青色和奶油色显示了地球弯曲的地平线，被框架剪掉了。背景是一片深海军色的星空，恰好有 3 个可见的天体：1 颗奶油色小行星或月亮靠近顶部中左，1 颗明亮的恒星靠近右上角，1 颗较小的恒星靠近中左。在海报底部添加一条实心红橙色水平带。强调复古印花纹理、纸褶、褪色墨水和怀旧的科幻乐观主义。最终图像应该看起来像一张粘贴的旧太空时代海报的真实照片，而不是干净的数字图形。

items.title: Epic Eastern Fantasy Character Concept
items.titleZh: Please create an Eastern fantasy character concept illustration featuring {argument name="character role" default="an Eastern fantasy character"} using {argument name="weapon" default="a musical instrument or weapon"}. The overall style blends traditional Chinese Xianxia, mythological iconography, and movie-level CG concept art texture. The image has a strong Eastern fantasy aesthetic, high-level beauty, and an epic feel. The character is the core visual focus, with an ethereal, sacred, elegant, cold, or majestic temperament. Automatically match the most appropriate expression, clothing, hairstyle, accessories, and identity setting based on the {argument name="character role" default="character"}. If the {argument name="weapon" default="item"} is a musical instrument, the character should be in a ritualistic and fluid posture such as playing, plucking, blowing, or standing with the instrument, emphasizing musical energy, spiritual flow, and sound waves turning into light patterns, clouds, starlight, or magic circles. If the {argument name="weapon" default="item"} is a weapon, the character should be in a posture of holding the weapon, gathering momentum, confronting, casting spells, or the moment before battle, emphasizing the sense of power, pressure, aura, and energy convergence. The composition is mainly centered or off-center, balanced, solemn, and has a poster-level main visual effect; the character's back can have a moon wheel, a halo, divine light, an ancient array, or an icon-style circular structure. The clothing adopts an Eastern fantasy style with light and beautiful materials, including gauze, ribbons, layered hems, metal ornaments, jade ornaments, or crowns. Hair and fabric flow in the wind, creating a strong sense of dynamic beauty. The background is automatically matched to the character's temperament as Eastern fantasy scenes such as starry sky divine realm, cloud sea heaven, moonlit sacred land, bamboo forest fairy mountain, ice and snow secret realm, quiet night altar, ancient ruins, etc., with environment carrying mist, flowing light, particles, mysterious energy, and spatial depth. The color uses a unified and high-level main tone to control the screen. It can automatically choose ice blue, moon white, green, purple, red gold, ink black, silver gray and other color schemes according to the character and props, and use a small amount of light gold or cold light for divine embellishment. Overall requirements: beautiful, dreamy, ethereal, mysterious, detached, sacred, exquisite, with movie-level lighting and shadow, volumetric light, sense of air, ultra-detailed CG illustration texture; avoid vulgarity, avoid cheap ancient style photo sense, avoid internet celebrity faces, avoid cluttered backgrounds, avoid plastic textures.
items.prompt: 请创作一幅{argument name="人物角色" default="东方幻想人物"}使用{argument name="武器" default="乐器或武器"}的东方幻想人物概念插画。整体风格融合国风仙侠、神话圣像感与电影级CG概念原画质感，画面具有强烈的东方幻想美学、高级审美与史诗感。人物为主视觉核心，气质空灵、神圣、优雅、清冷或威严，根据{argument name="人物角色" default="东方幻想人物"}自动匹配最合适的神态、服饰、发型、配饰与身份设定。如果{argument name="武器" default="乐器或武器"}是乐器，则人物呈现演奏、拨弦、吹奏、执乐而立等充满仪式感与流动感的姿态，强调音乐能量、灵气流动、音波化作光纹、云气、星辉或法阵。如果{argument name="武器" default="乐器或武器"}是武器，则人物呈现持械、蓄势、对峙、施法或战斗前一瞬的姿态，强调力量感、压迫感、气场与能量汇聚。构图以人物居中或偏中心为主，整体平衡、庄严、具有海报级主视觉效果；人物背后可带有月轮、法环、神性光晕、古老纹阵或圣像式圆形结构。服装采用东方幻想风格，材质轻盈华美，带轻纱、飘带、层叠衣摆、金属饰件、玉饰或冠饰，发丝与布料在风中流动，形成强烈的动态美感。背景根据角色气质自动匹配为星空神域、云海天界、月下圣境、竹林仙山、冰雪秘境、幽夜神坛、古风遗迹等东方幻想场景，环境带有薄雾、流光、粒子、神秘能量与空间纵深。色彩以统一且高级的主色调控制画面，可根据角色和道具自动选择冰蓝、月白、青绿、幽紫、赤金、墨黑、银灰等配色，并用少量淡金或冷光进行神性点缀。整体要求：唯美、梦幻、空灵、神秘、超脱、神圣、精致，具有电影级光影、体积光、空气感、超细节CG插画质感，避免俗艳、避免廉价古风写真感、避免网红脸、避免杂乱背景、避免塑料质感。

items.title: Helicopter Selfie Over Moscow
items.titleZh: A realistic smartphone-style travel photo taken inside a helicopter cabin, showing a seated passenger on the left side of the frame and a sweeping aerial view of Moscow through a large window on the right. The person is wearing a black zip-up athletic jacket with a small white swoosh logo, a seatbelt across the chest, a metallic wristwatch, and large black aviation headphones with a microphone boom. Their face is obscured by a rectangular blur block, and they are giving a thumbs-up gesture toward the camera. The helicopter interior is dark, with black leather seating and beige cabin trim framing the window. Outside the window, capture an overcast daytime panorama of central Moscow from above, with the Kremlin walls and towers clearly visible, the colorful onion domes of Saint Basil's Cathedral in the lower right, a broad cityscape stretching into the distance, and a cluster of modern skyscrapers on the far right horizon. Use natural diffused light, realistic urban detail, mild atmospheric haze, and the candid composition of a tourist selfie shot from a helicopter ride, wide-angle but not distorted.

items.title: Dark Gothic Ritual in Cathedral
items.titleZh: A cinematic dark fantasy scene inside a vast gothic cathedral at night, centered on a mysterious woman in a floor-length black ceremonial gown standing in the middle of a glowing occult circle. The composition is perfectly symmetrical and frontal, with the woman placed dead center beneath a huge rose window and a bright full moon visible through the stained glass. She wears an ornate, form-fitting {argument name="dress color" default="black"} gown with lace, embroidered filigree, semi-sheer sleeves, a corseted bodice, and a long flowing train spreading across the stone floor. Her pose is regal and ritualistic, arms slightly extended at her sides with open hands, as if summoning smoke or dark magic. Her face is obscured and indistinct, with dark updo hair and a high gothic collar or headpiece. Around her feet is a large circular sigil inscribed in glowing {argument name="sigil glow color" default="amber-gold"} lines, with intricate symbols and concentric rings. Place exactly 30 black candles of varying heights around the circle and foreground, all lit, with warm flames casting low orange highlights. Fill the air with drifting smoke and mist, especially around her hands, the lower floor, and the side aisles. The cathedral interior is towering, shadowy, and highly detailed, with ribbed vaults, pointed arches, weathered stone, elaborate carvings, and deep blue-black darkness. On the left and right sides, include exactly 2 massive gargoyle or demon statues perched on ornate pedestals, one per side, leaning inward protectively or menacingly. Behind the woman, a raised altar and clusters of additional candles recede into darkness. Lighting is moody and high-contrast, dominated by cold moonlight from above and warm candlelight from below, creating metallic highlights on the dress and architecture. Ultra-detailed, photorealistic, dramatic volumetric fog, gothic horror atmosphere, occult elegance, epic scale, sharp textures, realistic shadows, and a haunting, majestic mood.

items.title: Gothic Sorceress in Ruined Cathedral
items.titleZh: A dark gothic fantasy scene inside a vast abandoned cathedral, vertical full-body composition. In the exact center stands a mysterious sorceress in an elegant Victorian-inspired black gown with a fitted corset bodice, intricate silver embroidery, sheer lace sleeves, long draping lace panels from the arms, black gloves, and a long trailing skirt. Her hair is styled in a neat dark updo with a subtle ornamental hairpiece, and she wears delicate jewelry. She holds an open spellbook in one hand and raises the other hand in a poised spellcasting gesture. Surround her with low-lying mist and curling smoke. The cathedral interior is immense and decayed, with towering pointed arches, ribbed vaulted ceilings, cracked stone floors, broken tombs or altars on both sides, and thick twisted roots spreading across the ground and wrapping around the stone structures. Place exactly 2 large gargoyle statues perched symmetrically on elevated side structures, one on the left and one on the right, looming over the scene. Add many black candles with warm orange flames scattered across the foreground and midground, creating ritual ambience. In the background, show tall stained-glass windows with cold bluish daylight streaming through them in dramatic god rays, contrasting with the candlelight. Mood is haunting, arcane, cinematic, solemn, and highly detailed, with realistic textures, deep shadows, volumetric lighting, atmospheric haze, dark blue-gray color palette, and ultra-detailed gothic architecture.

items.title: Luxury Handbag Sunset Ad
items.titleZh: Luxury fashion advertisement, vertical editorial product ad shot at golden hour on a high-rise balcony overlooking a modern city skyline at sunset. A stylish woman stands in a confident three-quarter pose, framed from mid-thigh up, with her face obscured by a simple rectangular block matching warm brown-orange tones. She has long, softly wavy brunette hair lit by warm backlight from the setting sun. She wears a black tailored blazer over a fitted white scoop-neck ribbed top and high-waisted light beige trousers, with one hand in her pocket and the other holding a structured taupe leather handbag with a top handle, flap closure, polished gold clasp hardware, and a hanging leather tag. The bag is the visual hero and should look premium, elegant, and sharply detailed. Use cinematic warm lighting, soft rim light on the hair, subtle luxury color grading, shallow depth of field, and blurred skyscrapers in the background. Compose the layout like a premium brand campaign with large text and icons on the left side. At top left, place a refined serif monogram logo: {argument name="brand monogram" default="L"}. Below it, large white serif headline text stacked in uppercase: {argument name="headline text" default="CARRY CONFIDENCE. EVERYDAY."}. Beneath that, add a short white serif body copy in 4 lines: {argument name="body text" default="Timeless design. Effortless elegance. Made for every moment that moves you forward."}. Add exactly 3 circular line icons with labels arranged vertically: premium leather, timeless design, made to last. At the bottom left, place the brand name in large elegant serif capitals: {argument name="brand name" default="LUMIÈRE"}, with smaller uppercase tagline below: {argument name="tagline" default="BAGS THAT DEFINE YOU."}. Add a bordered call-to-action button reading “SHOP THE COLLECTION” with a small right arrow. Overall style: upscale, aspirational, polished e-commerce campaign, photorealistic fashion ad, luxurious but modern, clean typography, balanced negative space, magazine-quality composition.

items.titleZh: A moody minimalist portrait of a young man in a formal black suit, white dress shirt, and black tie, standing against a plain light beige wall in warm late-afternoon sunlight. He is shown from the chest up, slightly angled, with his face mostly obscured by shadow and framing, emphasizing the jawline, neck, ear, and tousled short black hair. In one hand he delicately holds exactly 1 long-stemmed red rose with 1 bloom and a few small green leaves, positioned beside his chest. Strong directional golden light from the left casts a crisp shadow of both the man and the rose onto the wall, creating a cinematic romantic atmosphere. Clean editorial photography, soft natural skin tones, high contrast between the dark suit and sunlit wall, shallow luxury fashion aesthetic, centered composition, realistic photo style.

items.title: Cute Winter Anime Channel Poster
items.titleZh:
A cute pastel anime promotional poster in a dreamy idol-fanclub style, landscape orientation, featuring a single horse-girl character from the waist up on the right side of the composition. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark chestnut brown"} long fluffy hair with side-swept bangs covering one eye, one large visible sparkling purple-pink eye, fair skin, soft blush, and upright horse ears with a large cream bow tied between them. Her expression is gentle, shy, and welcoming, with a small smile and a slight head tilt toward the viewer. She wears a thick red scarf with white horizontal stripes, a cream cable-knit sweater, and a navy sailor-style inner collar with a small red ribbon at the chest. The overall color palette is warm pink, cream, beige, and cocoa brown with soft winter lighting.

Design the image as a Japanese fan-content announcement graphic with layered sticker-like typography, fluffy outlines, hearts, sparkles, and snowflake motifs. The background should be a softly blurred cozy winter café or warmly lit indoor scene with glowing bokeh and pale decorative textures. Add exactly 5 major text areas: a pink ribbon banner at the top with the Japanese text "ライスと一緒に"; a very large central-left headline in rounded pop lettering reading "ほのぼの 育成" with "ほのぼの" in pink and white and "育成" in bold brown with white stitched edging; a small dark ribbon under it reading "しよっ♪"; a circular brown badge on the right reading "初見さん歓迎"; and a logo-like label at bottom right reading "ライスシャワーちゃんねる" with a small horseshoe icon. Add exactly 1 memo pad in the bottom-left corner with 3 checklist lines, each with a pink checkmark: "ストーリー", "チャンミ", and "まったり雑談". Include small decorative pink hearts around the character, tiny accent lines near her head, white snowflakes, lace-like trim, paper-cut corner decorations, and a soft scrapbook aesthetic. Make the whole piece look like an adorable fictional stream or channel thumbnail welcoming new viewers, highly polished, clean anime line art, soft shading, glossy eyes, and charming commercial poster composition.

items.title: Chinese Cursive Calligraphy Scroll
items.titleZh: A traditional Chinese ink calligraphy artwork on aged beige xuan paper, presented as a clean flat scan or photograph of a single hanging scroll page with no frame. The composition is entirely vertical Chinese cursive script, bold expressive grass-script brushwork in deep black ink with dynamic stroke variation, flying-white texture, dry-brush breaks, and elegant rhythm. Write the full poem {argument name="poem text" default="怒发冲冠，凭栏处、潇潇雨歇。抬望眼，仰天长啸，壮怀激烈。三十功名尘与土，八千里路云和月。莫等闲，白了少年头，空悲切。\n靖康耻，犹未雪；臣子恨，何时灭！驾长车，踏破贺兰山缺。壮志饥餐胡虏肉，笑谈渴饮匈奴血。待从头，收拾旧山河，朝天阙。"} in large vertical columns arranged right to left, about 8 main poem columns across the page, each column flowing freely with slight variations in spacing and tilt. Leave a wide left margin containing a smaller vertical inscription with 3 narrow columns: the title and attribution reading {argument name="inscription text" default="岳飞 满江红 甲辰書月 某元"}, written in a more restrained but still cursive hand. Add exactly 3 small red seal stamps: 2 stacked square seals in the lower-left margin beneath the inscription, and 1 small oval seal near the upper-right edge beside the first main column. The paper should have subtle warm tan mottling, soft fibers, faint age marks, and natural uneven tone. Overall mood is heroic, scholarly, and museum-quality, with authentic Song-inspired Chinese calligraphy aesthetics, minimal background, high detail, and faithful brush texture.

items.title: Sci-Fi Mech Blueprint Hangar
items.titleZh: A cinematic ultra-detailed sci-fi mech hangar interior at night, shown in a wide-angle view from slightly above a massive horizontal holographic planning table. The glowing blue tabletop dominates the foreground and center, displaying an intricate engineering blueprint for a humanoid combat robot labeled {argument name="mech name" default="ARGONAUT"}. The blueprint includes exactly 3 large full-body orthographic mech drawings across the table, one front view, one side view, and one rear view, plus many smaller component diagrams for hands, joints, feet, armor segments, and circular mechanical parts, dense technical callouts, graphs, measurement lines, and blocks of Japanese annotation text mixed with alphanumeric labels. Around the table are exactly 5 engineers in light gray industrial jumpsuits studying the design, leaning over the edges and holding rugged tablets; their faces are intentionally indistinct and partially obscured. In the deep background, exactly 1 towering real humanoid mech stands upright in a maintenance gantry, suspended or docked in a cavernous factory bay filled with catwalks, scaffolding, pipes, heavy cables hanging from the ceiling, illuminated control panels, glass partitions, and a few tiny distant workers for scale. Use a cold steel-and-cyan color palette, dramatic volumetric lighting, reflective metallic surfaces, subtle mist, high contrast shadows, and a serious military-industrial mood. The environment should feel dense, realistic, and operational, like a secret advanced robotics facility. Emphasize scale, technical complexity, and the contrast between the flat luminous blueprint and the massive constructed mech behind it. Render in photorealistic concept-art style with crisp linework on the holographic display, cinematic depth, and extreme detail.
items.promptZh: 夜间电影般的超详细科幻机甲机库内部，从巨大的水平全息规划台上方以广角视图显示。发光的蓝色桌面占据了前景和中心，展示了一个人形战斗机器人的复杂工程蓝图，标记为{argument name="mech name" default="ARGONAUT"}。该蓝图包括桌子上的 3 张大型全身正交机械图、一张前视图、一张侧视图和一张后视图，以及许多较小的手部、关节、脚、装甲部分和圆形机械零件的组件图、密集的技术标注、图表、测量线以及与字母数字标签混合的日语注释文本块。桌子周围正好有 5 位穿着浅灰色工业连身服的工程师，他们靠在桌子边缘，拿着坚固的平板电脑，研究设计。他们的脸被故意模糊并部分遮挡。在深处的背景中，恰好有一台高耸的真实人形机甲直立在维护龙门上，悬挂或停靠在一个巨大的工厂车间里，里面充满了走道、脚手架、管道、从天花板垂下来的重型电缆、发光的控制面板、玻璃隔板，以及一些远处的微小工人。使用冷钢和青色调色板、引人注目的体积照明、反光金属表面、微妙的雾气、高对比度阴影和严肃的军工氛围。环境应该让人感觉密集、真实且可操作，就像一个秘密的先进机器人设施。强调规模、技术复杂性以及平面发光蓝图与其背后庞大的机械结构之间的对比。以逼真的概念艺术风格进行渲染，在全息显示上呈现清晰的线条、电影般的深度和极致的细节。

items.title: Hand-drawn Travel Journal Illustration
items.titleZh:
Please draw a brightly colored, vertical (9:16) hand-drawn style "{argument name="city name" default="Beijing"} Travel Journal Illustration." The style should look as if it were created with crayons by a curious child. Use a soft and warm light-colored background (such as light yellow), paired with bright tones like red, blue, and green, to create a cozy, child-like, and travel-inspired atmosphere.

I. Main Image: Journal-style Travel Route

Draw a "winding travel route" in the center of the illustration, connecting multiple locations with arrows and dashed lines. Recommended attractions will be automatically generated based on a {argument name="number of days" default="1"}-day itinerary:

Example format (automatically replaced with {argument name="city name" default="Beijing"} related content):

- "Stop 1: {Attraction 1 recommendation + short fun description}"
- "Stop 2: {Attraction 2 recommendation + short fun description}"
- "Stop 3: {Attraction 3 recommendation + short fun description}"
- ...
- "Final Stop: {Local signature food/souvenir + warm closing statement}"

> The number of travel stops is automatically generated based on the number of days. If no days are input, a 1-day/highlights route will be generated by default.

II. Fun Surrounding Elements (Automatically replaced based on the city)

Add plenty of child-like elements around the route, such as:

- Cute travel characters: "A child holding local snacks," "An adventurous kid wearing a backpack," etc.
- Child-like Q-version hand-drawings of local landmarks: such as "{landmark 1}," "{landmark 2}," "{landmark 3}."
- Fun signboards: "Watch out for getting lost!", "Mind the crowds!", "Good food ahead!" (Adjusted according to city context).
- Sticker-style slogans: "{argument name="city name" default="Beijing"} Travel Memories Unlocked!", "{argument name="city name" default="Beijing"} Food Adventure!", "Where to next?"
- Cute small icons of local delicacies: such as "{food 1}," "{food 2}," "{food 3}."
- Exclamations (maintaining a child-like tone): "{argument name="city name" default="Beijing"} is so much fun!", "I want to go again!"

III. Overall Style Requirements

- Hand-drawn crayon style / children's travel log style
- Bright colors, full but warm composition
- Emphasis on the joy and exploration of travel
- All text uses cute handwritten fonts
- Make the entire image look like a travel journal page full of child-like wonder.
items.prompt:
请绘制一张色彩鲜艳、竖版（9:16）手绘风格的《{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}旅行手账插画》，画风仿佛由一位充满好奇心的孩子用蜡笔创作，整体使用柔和温暖的浅色背景（如浅黄色），搭配红色、蓝色、绿色等明亮色调，营造温馨、童趣、满满旅行气息的氛围。

一、主画面：手账式旅行路线

在插画中央绘制一条“蜿蜒曲折的旅行路线”，路线用箭头 + 虚线连接多个地点，由 {argument name="天数" default="1"} 日行程自动生成推荐景点：

示例格式（自动替换为{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}相关）：

- “第 1 站：{景点 1 推荐 + 简短趣味描述}”
- “第 2 站：{景点 2 推荐 + 简短趣味描述}”
- “第 3 站：{景点 3 推荐 + 简短趣味描述}”
- …
- “最终站：{当地招牌美食/纪念品 + 温馨结束语}”

> 旅程站点数量随天数自动生成：
> 若用户未输入天数，则按默认 1 日 / 精华线路生成。

---

二、周围趣味元素（全部根据城市自动替换）

在路线周围加入大量充满童趣的小元素，例如：

- 可爱的旅行角色：
  “拿着当地特色小吃的小朋友”、
  “背着旅行包的冒险小孩”等。

- 当地标志性建筑的童趣 Q 版手绘：
  如 “{城市地标1}”、“{城市地标2}”、“{城市地标3}”。

- 有趣的提示牌：
  “小心迷路！”、“注意人流！”、“前方好吃的！”（可根据城市语境调整）。

- 贴纸式小标语：
  “{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}旅行记忆已解锁！”
  “{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}美食大冒险！”
  “下一站去哪儿？”

- 当地美食的可爱小图标：
  如 “{城市美食1}”、“{城市美食2}”、“{城市美食3}”。

- 感叹句（保持童真风）：
  “原来{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}这么好玩！”
  “我要再来一次！”

---

三、整体风格要求

- 手绘蜡笔风 / 儿童旅行日志风格
- 色彩鲜艳、构图饱满但温暖
- 强调旅行的欢乐与探索感
- 所有文字采用可爱的手写字体
- 让整个画面像一本童趣满满的旅行手账页面

items.title: Photoreal Schoolgirl Shrine Portrait
items.titleZh: A photorealistic upper-body portrait of a {argument name="character type" default="Japanese high school girl"} standing outdoors in bright natural sunlight, framed from mid-torso up in a vertical composition. She has long, straight {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair with a glossy sheen, a clean center part, and soft strands catching the light. Her pose is calm and slightly angled to the side, with her head turned subtly away from the camera for a candid fashion-portrait feel. She wears a crisp white short-sleeve school shirt and a navy blue striped necktie, with a detailed embroidered crest patch on the left chest pocket featuring a crown and heraldic shield. The background is a shallow-depth-of-field scene of vivid red shrine or temple architecture with bold vertical pillars and hints of blue and gold decorative elements, creating strong color contrast against the white shirt and dark hair. Emphasize realistic skin, natural fabric folds, high-end DSLR portrait photography, soft bokeh, sharp focus on hair and clothing, polished commercial beauty styling, and an elegant, refined mood.
items.promptZh: 一幅{argument name="character type" default="Japan High School Girl"}站在室外明亮的自然阳光下的逼真上半身肖像，从躯干中部向上拍摄，采用垂直构图。她有一头又长又直的{argument name="hair color" default="dark Brown"}头发，散发着光泽，中间干净，发丝柔软，闪闪发亮。她的姿势很平静，稍微向一侧倾斜，头巧妙地转离镜头，营造出一种坦率的时尚肖像感觉。她穿着一件清爽的白色短袖校服和一条海军蓝色条纹领带，左胸口袋上有一个精致的刺绣徽章补丁，上面有皇冠和纹章盾牌。背景是浅景深场景，生动的红色神社或寺庙建筑，大胆的垂直柱子和蓝色和金色的装饰元素，与白衬衫和深色头发形成强烈的色彩对比。强调真实的皮肤、自然的织物褶皱、高端单反人像摄影、柔和的散景、对头发和服装的锐利聚焦、精致的商业美感造型以及优雅、精致的意境。

items.titleZh: A breathtaking Japanese anime movie poster in the style of a blockbuster theatrical key visual, ultra-detailed and emotionally grand, with a delicate luminous sky reminiscent of prestige modern anime cinema. The scene shows 2 characters from behind on a flower-covered cliff overlooking a glowing coastal fantasy city at sunset and twilight: a teenage boy in a dark school uniform with a loosened tie and windblown short dark hair stands on the left, and a teenage girl in a long flowing pale dress with very long silver-white hair stands on the right. Both face the horizon in awe. Above them, an enormous celestial sky fills most of the composition, painted with vivid deep blue, indigo, violet, magenta, and gold clouds, a brilliant comet-like meteor streak slashing diagonally from upper center toward the horizon, scattered stars, sparkling particles, and a glowing circular magic-like ring constellation in the upper right sky. The sea and city below shimmer with reflected light, with slender fantasy skyscrapers and towers rising from the coastline and a radiant sunlit gap at the center horizon. Foreground flowers are saturated blue and purple with glowing highlights, and white-pink petals drift through the air. Use dramatic rim light, cinematic backlighting, lens-glow sparkle effects, highly polished anime rendering, crisp linework, atmospheric depth, and a vertical poster composition. Include Japanese poster typography integrated into the design: giant embossed gold headline text across the top reading {argument name="top headline text" default="興行収入100億円突破"}, a gold subheadline block at upper left reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="大ヒット上映中"}, a vertical white tagline on the upper right reading {argument name="tagline text" default="あの日、君と見上げた空が、世界を変える。"}, and a very large glowing white-lavender Japanese film title at the bottom center reading {argument name="movie title" default="星屑の約束"}. Add 2 gold laurel emblems flanking the top headline, one on the left and one on the right. items.title: Steampunk Ship Cabin Interior
items.titleZh: A highly detailed cinematic interior of a cramped Victorian steampunk ship cabin engine room, viewed from standing eye level in a narrow corridor. The scene is packed wall-to-wall with aged polished brass pipes, copper tubes, riveted metal tanks, valves, gauges, and dark varnished wooden cabinets. On the left foreground, a steep wooden staircase with curved banister enters the frame diagonally. Along both sides of the corridor are heavy antique drawers and machinery consoles covered with small metal instruments, teapots, kettles, and mechanical fittings. At the back center is a small square-paned porthole window with 6 visible panes, showing a pale overcast exterior and a faint distant industrial skyline. Beneath the window is a narrow shelf unit with 3 open levels and a small drawer. On the right wall near the window hangs 1 round analog clock. The walls are painted teal-green metal with peeling paint and weathered patina. The floor is dark wood with a narrow worn patterned rug runner. Lighting is warm and moody, primarily from 1 glowing amber industrial wall lamp near the upper left of center, mixed with soft cold daylight from the porthole. Emphasize rich material texture, tarnished brass, oxidized copper, chipped paint, dust, age, and a lived-in mechanical atmosphere. Symmetrical depth, dense environmental storytelling, ultra-detailed, realistic, cinematic composition, shallow contrast but sharp focus throughout, no people.
items.promptZh: 在狭窄的走廊里，从与视线齐平的位置观察，可以看到狭窄的维多利亚蒸汽朋克船舱发动机室的高度细节化的电影内部。场景中到处都是陈旧的抛光黄铜管、铜管、铆接的金属罐、阀门、仪表和深色清漆的木柜。在左边的前景，一个带有弯曲栏杆的陡峭的木楼梯斜向进入框架。走廊两侧是沉重的古董抽屉和机械控制台，上面布满了小型金属仪器、茶壶、水壶和机械配件。后面中央是一扇小方玻璃舷窗，有 6 块可见玻璃，显示出苍白阴暗的外观和隐约遥远的工业天际线。窗户下方是一个狭窄的架子单元，有 3 个开放层和一个小抽屉。靠近窗户的右墙上挂着 1 个圆形模拟时钟。墙壁被漆成青绿色的金属，油漆剥落，铜锈已风化。地板是深色木地板，上面有一条窄窄的、有磨损图案的地毯。灯光温暖而喜怒无常，主要来自中心左上方附近的一盏发光的琥珀色工业壁灯，与舷窗发出的柔和的冷日光混合在一起。强调丰富的材料质感、失去光泽的黄铜、氧化的铜、剥落的油漆、灰尘、年代和生活中的机械氛围。对称的深度、密集的环境故事讲述、超详细、现实的电影构图、浅对比度但贯穿始终的清晰焦点，没有人物。

items.title: Cyber Streetwear Manga Splash Art
items.titleZh: A dynamic manga-style action illustration of a single androgynous young woman shot from a dramatic low angle, as if the viewer is beneath her while she drops or steps forward through an explosive burst of ink and debris. She has a short platinum-blonde bob haircut with long side-swept bangs partly covering one side of her face, pale skin, and a cool, rebellious streetwear aesthetic. Her face is obscured by a simple light-gray rectangular censor block. She wears 5 main clothing items: an oversized black hooded jacket with bright cyan geometric markings on the sleeve and inner lining, a fitted white tank top, loose black cargo-style pants with straps and zipper details, a black belt with a hanging cyan tag, and chunky white-and-black sneakers with small cyan accents. Add extra accessory details including dangling straps, buckles, and street-tech trims. Her pose is relaxed but dominant, one knee raised toward the viewer, torso leaning back slightly, one hand tucked into a pocket, jacket flaring outward in motion. The composition should feel aggressive and kinetic, with a monochrome palette of black, white, and gray, punctuated by vivid electric cyan paint slashes. Fill the background with explosive abstract brushwork, ink splatter, speed lines, torn black shards, and chaotic manga energy radiating outward from behind her. High contrast, gritty texture, rough inked linework, painterly splashes, urban dystopian anime key visual, extremely detailed fabric folds, stylish editorial framing, wide cinematic composition.
items.promptZh: 动态漫画风格的动作插图，描绘了一位雌雄同体的年轻女子，从戏剧性的低角度拍摄，仿佛观众就在她下方，而她在墨水和碎片的爆炸性爆发中跌落或前进。她留着白金金色的鲍勃短发，长长的侧扫刘海遮住了脸的一侧，皮肤苍白，有着酷炫、叛逆的街头服饰审美。她的脸被一个简单的浅灰色矩形检查块遮挡。她穿着 5 件主要服装：一件超大号黑色连帽夹克，袖子和内衬上有亮青色几何标记；合身白色背心；带有肩带和拉链细节的宽松黑色工装裤；一条带有悬挂青色标签的黑色腰带；以及带有小青色装饰的厚实黑白运动鞋。添加额外的配饰细节，包括悬挂带、带扣和街头科技装饰。她的姿势放松但占主导地位，一只膝盖向观众抬起，躯干稍微向后倾斜，一只手插在口袋里，夹克向外张开。构图应该给人一种侵略性和动感的感觉，采用黑、白、灰的单色调色板，并点缀着生动的电青色油漆斜线。背景充满爆炸性的抽象笔触、墨水飞溅、速度线、撕裂的黑色碎片，以及从她身后向外辐射的混乱漫画能量。高对比度、粗糙的纹理、粗糙的墨迹线条、绘画般的泼溅、城市反乌托邦动漫的主视觉、极其细致的织物褶皱、时尚的编辑框架、宽广的电影构图。
