items.title: Minimal SaaS Ad With Invoice Mockup
items.titleZh: Create a minimalist static SaaS ad on a warm off-white background with elegant editorial typography and clean, high-fidelity text rendering. At the top, place a large black serif headline in two lines reading: "{argument name="headline text" default="Your dev team shouldn’t be your analytics team."}" The words “dev team” should appear in italic serif while the rest remains bold high-contrast serif, with generous spacing and a luxury magazine-style layout. Centered below, show a slightly tilted white paper invoice sheet with a soft drop shadow and a subtle vertical fold crease down the middle, as if photographed from above. The invoice uses black monospaced typewriter-style text and reads exactly: “INVOICE — DEV HOURS, OCTOBER” as the header, then 5 line items with hours and prices aligned in columns: “A/B test setup on pricing page   8 hrs   $1,200”, “GTM tag install (3 events)   4 hrs   $600”, “Funnel tracking debug   6 hrs   $900”, “Meta pixel mapping   3 hrs   $450”, and “Attribution reporting build   12 hrs   $1,800”. Under the 5 items, add a dashed divider line, then a bold monospaced “TOTAL” on the lower left and the total price “$4,950” on the lower right. Draw a hand-drawn yellow line striking through the total price. Add 4 doodle-style annotation elements around the invoice: on the left, handwritten yellow text saying “every month??” with a yellow arrow pointing right toward the paper; on the upper right of the paper, a yellow starburst scribble; below the total, a green curved arrow pointing up toward the crossed-out price; and on the lower right, a green hand-drawn circle containing the handwritten words “zero devs,” connected to the green arrow. At the bottom center of the ad, add a smaller black sans-serif body copy in 2 lines reading: “{argument name="body text" default="Marketers ship tests and track revenue themselves.\nNo tickets. No tag manager. One script."}" Keep the composition airy, premium, and conversion-focused, blending modern startup ad design with tactile paper realism and playful marker annotations.
items.promptZh: 使用优雅的编辑排版和干净、高保真的文本渲染，在温暖的灰白色背景上创建简约的静态 SaaS 广告。在顶部，将一个大的黑色衬线标题分成两行：“{argument name =“headline text”默认=“您的开发团队不应该是您的分析团队。”}““开发团队”一词应以斜体衬线显示，而其余部分仍为粗体高对比度衬线，具有宽敞的间距和豪华杂志风格的布局。下方居中，显示一张稍微倾斜的白色发票纸，带有柔和的阴影，中间有一条微妙的垂直折叠折痕，就像从上方拍摄的一样。发票使用黑色等宽打字机样式的文本，内容准确：“发票 — 十月开发时间”作为标题，然后是 5 个行项目，其中时间和价格在列中对齐：“定价页面上的 A/B 测试设置 8 小时 1,200 美元”、“GTM 标签安装（3 个事件）4 小时 600 美元”、“漏斗跟踪调试 6 小时 900 美元”、“元像素映射 3 小时” 450 美元”和“归因报告构建 12 小时 1,800 美元”。在 5 个项目下，添加虚线分隔线，然后在左下角添加粗体等宽“TOTAL”，在右下角添加总价“$4,950”。画一条手绘黄线贯穿总价。在发票周围添加 4 个涂鸦式注释元素：左侧手写黄色文字，写着“每个月？”黄色箭头向右指向纸张；在纸的右上方，有黄色的星爆字迹；在总计下方，有一个绿色弯曲箭头向上指向划掉的价格；右下角是一个绿色手绘圆圈，其中包含手写文字“零开发者”，与绿色箭头相连。在广告的底部中心，添加两行较小的黑色无衬线正文：“{argument name="body text" default="营销人员自行进行测试并跟踪收入。\n没有门票。没有标签管理器。一个脚本。"}" 保持构图通风、优质且以转化为重点，将现代创业广告设计与触觉纸张现实主义和有趣的标记注释融为一体。

items.title: Minimal Slot Machine Attribution Ad
items.titleZh: Create a clean minimalist static ad on an off-white light gray studio background with a centered editorial layout. At the top, place a large luxury-fashion-style serif headline in black reading {argument name="headline text" default="Stop gambling with your ad spend."}, with the word "gambling" set in italic serif for emphasis. In the middle, show a vintage metal slot-machine window viewed straight on, slightly weathered and realistic, with 3 vertical reels inside a rectangular steel housing and a lever with a black knob on the right side. The 3 reels must display, from left to right, "$", "$", and "?". Make the rightmost reel background pale pink while the first 2 reels are aged white. Add a hand-drawn neon-pink annotation style over the image: 1 arrow-and-note on the left pointing to the first reel reading {argument name="left annotation" default="your attribution"}, 1 starburst scribble above the pink question-mark reel, 1 arrow from the question-mark reel to a circled note on the right reading {argument name="right annotation" default="actual revenue"}, and 1 large curved arrow in the lower left pointing toward the body copy area. Below the slot machine, center a short sans-serif paragraph in black reading {argument name="body text" default="See which campaigns drive revenue, not just clicks. Connect Meta, Google, and Stripe in 60 seconds."}. At the bottom center, place a simple black analytics-style bar logo icon followed by the bold sans-serif brand name {argument name="brand name" default="Humblytics"}. Use strong text fidelity, polished product-ad composition, soft studio shadows, restrained palette of black, steel gray, off-white, and hot pink, and a modern direct-response ad aesthetic.

items.title: Blurred Deer in Green Forest
items.titleZh: A painterly wildlife photograph with strong intentional motion blur, showing 1 deer-like animal in a lush green forest clearing. The animal stands slightly left of center in side profile facing left, with a pale tan to cream body, slender legs, and a soft indistinct head and ears, partially emerging from a dark shadowy opening in dense foliage. The entire image is heavily smeared with diagonal and vertical camera motion, creating an impressionistic, dreamlike effect rather than sharp detail. Surround the subject with saturated summer greenery: deep emerald bushes in the background, darker forest shadows near the upper left, and bright vivid grass across the foreground. Use natural outdoor daylight, rich green tones, soft contrast, and an abstract photographic style that feels like a fleeting glimpse of wildlife captured while moving. No people, no text, no buildings, no extra animals.
items.promptZh: 一张带有强烈有意运动模糊的绘画野生动物照片，展示了郁郁葱葱的绿色森林空地上的一只类似鹿的动物。该动物的侧面轮廓面向左侧，站立位置稍偏左，身体呈浅棕褐色至奶油色，腿细长，头部和耳朵柔软模糊，部分从茂密树叶中的深色阴影开口中露出。整个图像严重涂抹了对角线和垂直的相机运动，创造了一种印象派、梦幻般的效果，而不是清晰的细节。用饱和的夏季绿色植物围绕主题：背景是深翠的灌木丛，左上方附近较暗的森林阴影，前景是明亮生动的草丛。使用自然的户外日光、丰富的绿色色调、柔和的对比度和抽象的摄影风格，感觉就像在移动时捕捉到的野生动物的一瞥。没有人，没有文字，没有建筑物，没有多余的动物。

items.title: Anime Maid Thriller Movie Poster
items.titleZh: A dramatic anime theatrical movie poster in a tall vertical composition, centered on 2 young women in classic black-and-white maid uniforms standing back-to-back and facing opposite directions. The left maid has a short silver bob haircut with straight bangs and a white maid headband; the right maid has a short vivid pink bob haircut with straight bangs and a matching white maid headband. Both wear fitted black dresses with puff sleeves, white aprons with ruffled trim, white collars and cuffs, and black ribbon accents at the neck. Their poses are confident and tense, with one hand lowered at their sides, suggesting mystery and rivalry. Place them large in the foreground, filling most of the poster height. Behind them, create a split-color night sky: deep electric blue on the left and saturated magenta-pink on the right, blending at the center. In the upper left, show a bright full moon and a small helicopter with a searchlight. Along the horizon and lower sides, include a glowing city skyline, blue-lit on the left and pink-lit on the right. In the center background, place a gothic mansion or castle with pointed towers at the end of a path, illuminated with warm lights. In front of the mansion, show 2 smaller full-body figures of the same maids from behind, walking toward the building side by side. Add 4 supporting characters around the lower edges: 1 dark-haired man in a suit at bottom left, 1 older stern man in a suit at lower right-center, 1 young woman with long dark hair at bottom right, and the 2 small maid figures in the center distance, for a total of 6 visible human figures in the poster. Scatter bright pink flower petals across the image as if blown by the wind. Use intense cinematic lighting, glossy anime rendering, high contrast, sharp linework, glowing rim light, and a suspenseful psychological thriller mood. Include vertical Japanese tagline text on both sides, a large stylized title at the bottom center reading {argument name="title text" default="Re:maid"}, smaller Japanese subtitle text beneath it, and release text at the lower left reading {argument name="release date text" default="7.25 [FRI] ROADSHOW"}. Add a final Japanese tagline line along the bottom. Overall style: premium anime key visual, mystery thriller, neon blue and hot pink dual-color palette, polished poster typography, highly detailed background, dynamic petals, and theatrical film-poster finish.

items.title: Tim Cook MMO Raid Boss Screen
items.titleZh: Create a cinematic fantasy MMO raid boss loading-screen-style illustration with a full custom game UI overlay. The scene is set at dusk in front of the glass cube Apple Store, with the glowing white Apple logo centered on the building facade. In the middle of the plaza stands a giant raid boss version of {argument name="boss name" default="Tim Cook"}, labeled as "The Architect," wearing a fitted black turtleneck, dark pants, and sneakers, holding a glowing smartphone in one hand and posing calmly with the other hand open. His face is intentionally blurred or anonymized. The overall tone is epic, satirical, and high-production, like a World of Warcraft raid encounter screen mixed with corporate tech parody. Around him, exactly 20 fantasy raiders in a semicircle battle formation face inward toward the boss, with varied races and silhouettes including armored warriors, rogues, mages, shamans, hunters, and orc-like and human-like characters. Several are casting bright spells in orange fire, blue lightning, green energy, and purple void magic. Include exactly 3 small robotic adds near the boss, each labeled "Supplier Add," with squat industrial bodies and Apple logos on their fronts. Also include 2 active encounter mechanic bubbles: one blue spherical shield labeled "Margin Shield" on the right side of the boss, and one purple circular dome labeled "Closed System" farther right with a humanoid enemy trapped inside. Build the image as a complete raid UI composition. Top left: a large expansion-style title reading "SIEGE OF THE INFINITE LOOP" with subtitle "20-MAN HORDE RAID." Far left: a vertical "RAID FRAMES" panel listing exactly 20 player names in numbered rows from 1 to 20 with colored health bars. Top center: a boss portrait frame with the boss name {argument name="boss name" default="Tim Cook"}, subtitle "The Architect," and a red health bar at 100%. Top right: a large encounter guide panel titled "ENCOUNTER: {argument name="boss name" default="TIM COOK"} – \"THE ARCHITECT\"" containing exactly 3 phases. Phase 1 title: "SUPPLY CHAIN DOMINANCE (100% – 70%)" with 3 abilities: "Logistics Surge – Summons waves of Supplier Adds.", "Margin Shield – Reduces incoming damage by 40% for 10 sec.", and "Quarterly Pressure – Stacking debuff, explodes if not dispelled." Phase 2 title: "ECOSYSTEM LOCK-IN (70% – 30%)" with 3 abilities: "Closed System – Isolates 3 players, puzzle to return.", "Subscription Drain – Raid-wide damage over time.", and "Device Sync – Stack in correct formations to avoid spikes." Phase 3 title: "ONE MORE THING (30% – 0%)" with 3 abilities: "Surprise Launch – Massive AoE burst every 20 sec.", "Reality Distortion Field – Reverses controls briefly.", and "Enrage: Market Collapse – Boss enrages at 3:00." Bottom right: a "POTENTIAL LOOT" panel listing exactly 4 items with rarity-colored text: "Executive Cloak of Efficiency (Epic)", "Keynote Blade (Epic)", "Ecosystem Ring (Epic)", and "Investor's Favor (Bonus – Hard Mode)." Below that, add a small red-black badge reading "HARD MODE" and the line "Activate \"Investor Call\" during the fight to" with the remaining text cut off or obscured. Bottom left: a "CHAT" box with 4 lines, including taunting boss dialogue and a player response, such as "{argument name="boss quote" default="Tim Cook yells: Innovation. Discipline. Excellence. That is how we win."}", "Tim Cook yells: Our ecosystem is unbreakable.", "Tim Cook yells: One more thing...", and "Lok'tarbrok: Lok'tar ogar!" Along the bottom center: a fantasy action bar with exactly 12 ability icons in ornate slots, some numbered, some showing cooldown text including "2m" and "1m". Use dramatic volumetric lighting, glossy reflections on the wet plaza, realistic environment rendering, highly detailed fantasy characters, exaggerated spell effects, dark vignette, sharp UI typography, and polished AAA game key art composition.

items.title: Cheesy Chips Snack Ad Poster
items.titleZh: Create a dramatic studio food advertisement poster on a dark black textured background with moody, high-contrast lighting and rich warm orange tones. The composition is vertical and split visually: bold stacked ad copy on the left, hero food action on the right. Show a deep rustic bowl overflowing with triangular cheddar corn chips in the lower center-right, with thick glossy cheese sauce being poured in a continuous stream from a tilted dark metal saucepan entering from the upper right. The cheese lands heavily on top of the chips and drapes over them in thick molten folds. Behind the bowl on the left, place 1 upright red snack bag with a large yellow-orange starburst graphic and the brand text {argument name="brand name" default="CRUNCHY CHIPZ"} in big white outlined letters, plus smaller flavor text {argument name="flavor text" default="ZESTY CHEDDAR"} and tiny subtitle "FLAVORED CORN SNACKS". Print tiny text near the lower left of the bag: "SAVORY TRIANGLES". Add 2 small condiment bowls on the dark tabletop: 1 shallow bowl of shredded cheddar in the bottom left corner and 1 tiny bowl of reddish seasoning near the bottom center-right. Scatter a few crumbs and cheese shreds across the table, with a dark napkin tucked under the main bowl. Include bold distressed condensed uppercase typography in a vintage poster style. On the upper left, stack the headline in 5 lines reading: {argument name="headline text" default="THE ULTIMATE MUNCH."} with "THE" on line 1, "ULTIMATE" on line 2, and "MUNCH." on line 3 in large type, followed by line 4 "EXPERIENCE" and line 5 "TRUE UMAMI." in smaller white text. Beneath that, add 2 promotional lines in orange: {argument name="review text" default="OVER 300 REVIEWS."}. In the bottom right, place a 3-line orange callout reading {argument name="tagline text" default="DIP, POUR, MUNCH."}. Use cinematic food photography styling, sharp focus on chips and cheese stream, appetizing glossy textures, commercial packaging realism, premium snack-brand ad aesthetic.

items.titleZh: Create a premium minimalist keynote-style presentation cover slide in an Apple-inspired industrial design aesthetic. Use a wide 16:9 layout with a deep matte black upper background and a pale concrete-gray lower platform occupying the bottom quarter of the frame. Place a large photorealistic floating rectangular slab in the right-center foreground, resembling a thin black glass device or polished obsidian platform with mirror-like reflections, chamfered chrome-metal edges, and precise industrial finishing. The slab should hover above the light surface and cast a soft elongated shadow directly beneath it. Add a tall vertical gray metallic wall or pillar on the far right edge to frame the composition. Use extremely sparse, high-end art direction, lots of negative space, cinematic studio lighting, subtle gradients, and crisp contrast between black and silver materials. On the left side, set clean white sans-serif typography with a clear hierarchy: a tiny top caption reading "{argument name="system label" default="Apple-inspired presentation system"}", a very large bold headline reading "{argument name="headline text" default="Clarity At Scale"}", and a medium subtitle reading "{argument name="subtitle text" default="The strongest slides behave like products."}". Below that, include exactly 3 numbered principles in a vertical list with thin separators and refined spacing: "01 | {argument name="principle 1" default="One focal object"}", "02 | Binary light / dark rhythm", and "03 | Blue only for signal". Add a short thin horizontal rule above the list and a tiny blue accent line below the list. Draw a very fine horizontal guide line near the top spanning most of the slide, with the small page number "01" at the upper right. Repeat the small caption "Apple-inspired presentation system" once again at the bottom left on the light surface. Overall look: luxury tech presentation, editorial product-launch slide, ultra-clean Swiss grid, restrained monochrome palette with only one subtle blue accent, photorealistic rendering blended with presentation design.

items.titleZh: Create a refined editorial presentation cover slide in a warm, Claude-inspired design system. Use a landscape 16:9 composition with a parchment-paper background, subtle paper grain, soft shadows, and layered torn-paper collage elements. The overall palette should be warm ivory, cream, sand, charcoal, muted black, and terracotta accent. On the left half, place a small top label reading "{argument name="system label" default="Claude-inspired presentation system"}" with a small terracotta dot and a thin horizontal divider line. Below it, set an oversized elegant high-contrast serif headline in black that reads "{argument name="main headline" default="Thoughtful Systems"}", split across two lines and dominating the left side. Under the headline, add a smaller serif subheadline in terracotta reading "{argument name="subheadline" default="Warmth can still feel precise."}". Beneath that, create a vertical list of exactly 4 design principles, each on its own row with thin divider lines and a small icon at left: 1) a rectangular parchment-sheet icon with the text "Parchment canvas", 2) a serif capital T icon with the text "Serif-led hierarchy", 3) a filled terracotta circle icon with the text "Terracotta for signal", 4) a chain-link icon with the text "Organic diagrams over cold chrome". Add a tiny footer caption at bottom left reading "CLAUDE-INSPIRED PRESENTATION SYSTEM" in spaced small caps. On the right half, build a layered collage of exactly 3 paper cards: first, a tall off-white art card with a fine border containing the heading "A more considered approach", a short body paragraph about complex problems yielding to clarity, a minimal landscape line drawing with a terracotta sun, and a vertical terracotta botanical branch overlapping the card; second, a dark charcoal rectangular card partially behind it with the lowercase title "thinking process" and an exact 5-step numbered list: "01 Observe", "02 Interpret", "03 Connect", "04 Synthesize", "05 Act with care", plus a delicate circular orbital diagram in dotted lines and terracotta highlight; third, a torn off-white note card in front near the bottom with a hand-drawn overlapping-circles diagram where one crescent-shaped intersection area is shaded in terracotta, alongside a handwritten quote reading "{argument name="quote" default="Clarity emerges when systems are designed with intention."}". items.titleZh: A moody surreal painting of a woman leaning forward through an old window frame, shown from behind and cropped tightly so the composition centers on her wildly windblown {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown with copper highlights"} hair streaming left across the image in long tangled strands. Her bare shoulders and upper back are mostly hidden by her hair, and both hands rest on a worn wooden windowsill at the bottom center, with 2 visible fingers on each side gripping the ledge. The face is completely obscured by hair and angle. Behind her is a weathered multi-pane window with 6 rectangular panes in a 3-by-2 grid, painted in cold gray-blue tones with grime, scratches, drips, and distressed edges. Use an expressive mixed-media style combining charcoal, ink, dry brush, scratched lines, and textured oil paint on rough canvas, with sketchy white and black linework layered over muted industrial colors. The mood is introspective, stormy, and haunting, as if wind or emotion is pulling the figure apart. Soft diffused light, subtle contrast, painterly realism fused with abstract expressionism, square composition.
items.promptZh: 这是一幅喜怒无常的超现实主义画作，画中一位女士向前倾身穿过旧窗框，从后面展示，剪裁紧凑，因此构图以她狂风吹动的{argument name="hair color" default="深棕色，带有铜色高光"}头发为中心，长长的纠结的发丝在图像中流淌。她裸露的肩膀和上背部大部分都被头发遮住了，双手放在底部中央一个破旧的木制窗台上，两侧都有两个可见的手指抓住窗台。脸完全被头发和角度遮住了。她身后是一扇饱经风霜的多窗格窗户，有 6 个矩形窗格，呈 3 x 2 网格，涂成冷灰蓝色调，有污垢、划痕、滴水和做旧的边缘。使用富有表现力的混合媒体风格，在粗糙的画布上结合木炭、墨水、干画笔、划痕线和纹理油画，并在柔和的工业色彩上叠加粗略的白色和黑色线条。气氛是内省的、暴风雨般的、令人难以忘怀的，仿佛风或情感正在将人物撕裂。柔和的漫射光、微妙的对比、绘画现实主义与抽象表现主义的融合、方形构图。

items.title: Girl on Window Seat in Rain
items.titleZh: A moody storybook-style digital painting of a {argument name="character age" default="young girl"} sitting sideways on a cushioned window seat inside an old European attic room, hugging her knees and gazing out through a large rain-streaked window. She has {argument name="hair color" default="chestnut brown"} slightly messy shoulder-length hair, a cozy oversized cable-knit sweater, and soft striped socks, with bare legs tucked close to her body. The composition is intimate and contemplative, viewed from inside the room at a slight angle, with the child placed in the lower left foreground and the rainy city filling the right side and background. Outside the window is a dense cluster of steep-roofed old town houses, chimneys, crooked rooftops, and 2 tall vintage street lamps visible near the window, all under a dramatic overcast sky with heavy layered storm clouds and visible falling rain. The glass is covered with raindrops, rivulets, and wet reflections, and the rooftops outside are mostly muted gray, while the interior glows with warm amber light from the left, creating a strong contrast between the cozy room and the cold storm outside. Include a patterned cushion behind her, a worn upholstered bench with subtle floral fabric, dark curtains framing the left edge, and soft painterly textures with detailed brushwork on wood, fabric, hair, and rain. Color palette: warm browns, beige, muted gold, slate gray, charcoal, and soft silver. Atmosphere: melancholic, quiet, nostalgic, cinematic, whimsical, and emotionally tender. Highly detailed, painterly illustration, children’s book fantasy realism, dramatic lighting, depth through layered rooftops, no text, no watermark.

The child has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} wild tangled messy hair, huge expressive eyes, pale skin with a few freckles, and a worried, lonely expression, hugging their knees tightly to their chest. They wear oversized {argument name="pajama pattern" default="muted blue-gray pajamas with small orange patches or floral shapes"} and soft worn slippers. Outside the window is a bleak rainy city street with 4 leaning old buildings visible, 4 wind-bent trees, a slick winding road, and dramatic swirling storm clouds, all painted in an exaggerated crooked perspective. The composition places the child on the left and the window view dominating the right, creating a feeling of isolation and melancholy. items.title: Japanese Fantasy Winged Pig Film Poster
items.titleZh: A dramatic Japanese fantasy movie poster in a painterly, ultra-detailed cinematic illustration style. The poster is vertically composed like a theatrical key visual, with a warm gold title at the bottom and multiple emotional vignettes layered into one unified scene. The central character is a small fluffy pig-like creature with soft pale cream fur, oversized pink inner ears, a tiny snout, a curled tail, and large feathered angel wings glowing with golden light. It stands upright on a rooftop or elevated wooden platform overlooking a vast Tokyo cityscape at sunset, holding a whiskey glass in one hoof with the other hoof on its hip, posed like a weary but resilient middle-aged salaryman. In the distance are the Tokyo skyline, water, bridges, floating lanterns, and Tokyo Tower glowing orange-red under a radiant sky filled with clouds lit in gold, peach, violet, and deep blue. Around the center are 4 supporting vignette scenes: 1) top left, the winged pig sits alone at a narrow bar counter in a nostalgic lantern-lit Japanese alley at night, looking exhausted and melancholy, with a bottle and a glass nearby; 2) top center, the winged pig sits drinking with 2 human adults in an izakaya-like nightlife setting, warm lights surrounding them; 3) upper right, the winged pig walks away down railway tracks toward a brilliant ocean sunset, carrying a small suitcase, seen from behind; 4) left middle, the winged pig walks alone through a rain-slick neon-lit city street at night, seen from behind, surrounded by glowing signs and reflections. The whole image should feel bittersweet, magical, lonely, and hopeful, like a prestige animated film poster about adulthood, solitude, and emotional survival. Use lush lighting, dense environmental detail, sparkling reflections, glowing lanterns, cinematic atmosphere, and rich blue-orange color contrast. Include Japanese poster typography integrated into the art: at the very top, the tagline "ひとりで生きてきた。だけど、ひとりじゃ涙は止まらない。"; above the title, the line "独身オヤジ、最後の青春。"; a very large main title at the bottom center reading "翼のオヤジ" in bold brushed calligraphic characters; below it, the tagline "笑って、泣けて、明日また頑張れる。この冬、いちばんやさしい奇跡。"; on the bottom right, a circular badge reading "秋公開" and "今"; add small fine-print credits across the lower edge in the style of a Japanese film poster. Include 2 visible vertical lantern/shop signs in the street scenes reading "居酒屋" and 1 bottle label reading "黒豚". High detail, emotional fantasy poster, premium animated-film aesthetic, Japanese urban nostalgia mixed with magical realism.

items.titleZh: Create a richly detailed nostalgic Chinese retro poster collage in warm sepia, faded red, and aged paper tones, designed like a memory scrapbook spread on an old desk. The composition is vertical and packed with miniature diorama scenes embedded inside a large irregular paper cutout path, while a realistic adult hand at the upper right holds a black fountain pen with a gold nib, as if writing the memories into existence. At the top, large distressed Chinese headline text reads {argument name="headline text" default="8090的记忆"}, with smaller handwritten-style subtitle text beneath it reading “那些简单、热闹、发亮的日子”. The paper surface should look cracked, yellowed, stained, and worn, with old magazine clippings, notebooks, marbles, ribbon, pencils, enamel mug, and children’s illustrated books scattered around the edges. Include exactly 8 numbered memory scenes arranged from top to bottom on the central paper path, each with a red circle number and Chinese handwritten annotations beside it: scene 1 is a boy crouching outdoors aiming a slingshot under a tree; scene 2 is two children running with a metal hoop and stick in an alley; scene 3 is two children crouching over small firecrackers on the ground with smoke and red paper debris; scene 4 is a tiny old-fashioned neighborhood shop counter labeled “供销社”, with one child buying snacks from the shopkeeper and shelves packed with goods; scene 5 is a bustling market fair with many adults, baskets, poultry, produce, and a bicycle vendor; scene 6 is an open-air village opera stage with red curtains, performers in colorful traditional costumes, and a seated audience; scene 7 is two children at a tree, one climbing or reaching into a nest while another watches below, with a green tin frog toy nearby; scene 8 is a man riding a motorcycle with a child passenger down an old street at sunset. Add surrounding retro printed items with visible vintage Chinese cover text, including a left-side old children’s book, a right-side magazine titled “儿童画报 1985 5”, a small blue booklet near the lower left, and a worn exercise notebook near the lower right. At the bottom, place a bold red banner with large cream-colored Chinese text reading {argument name="bottom quote" default="那时候日子不快，但快乐很满。"} and a second smaller line reading {argument name="sub quote" default="很多东西都旧了，可一想起来还是会发亮。"}. The entire image should feel tactile, cinematic, and emotionally warm, combining photorealistic objects with handcrafted poster design, dense storytelling details, tiny human figures, nostalgic 1980s–1990s Chinese childhood atmosphere, and soft golden lighting.

items.title: Find Kyle in a Seoul Market
items.titleZh: A richly detailed vertical editorial travel illustration of a bustling Seoul market alley rendered in polished hand-drawn realism with warm cinematic lighting, dense urban storytelling, and highly legible signage. The scene is packed with a large crowd of pedestrians, shoppers, diners, street-food customers, musicians, and commuters in a narrow neighborhood market street, viewed from a slightly elevated eye level so the full alley feels layered and alive. At the top left, a large illustrated poster reads “WHERE IS {argument name="character name" default="KYLE"}?” with the subtitle “Can you find Kyle in Seoul?” in bold playful English typography, styled like a search-and-find book cover. The environment should clearly be Seoul, with a visible Namsan tower in the distant skyline, tangled overhead power lines, rooftop seating, stacked low-rise buildings, shop signs in Korean, and a subway entrance sign on the right showing line numbers 4, 2, 4, 4 and the bilingual text “서울역 방면 / To Seoul Station.” Include exactly 15 major visible signs or text panels: 1) the “WHERE IS {argument name="character name" default="KYLE"}?” poster, 2) “할머니 손칼국수”, 3) a hanging vertical sign “낙원상가 2F”, 4) a small blue street sign, 5) a vertical sign “이름 떡볶이”, 6) the large market arch sign “황진다운시장 영”, 7) a vertical orange sign “커피”, 8) a wall mural map with “남산 가는길”, 9) the subway sign with “출입구 4” and “서울역 방면 / To Seoul Station”, 10) the produce sign “경성 야채”, 11) the lower produce sign “신선한 채소”, 12) a handwritten busker sign, 13) the street-food cart sign “호떡·어묵·붕어빵”, 14) the menu board “오늘의 추천 김밥 떡볶이 순대 튀김”, and 15) the delivery box text “빠른 배달”. Populate the alley with exactly 8 vendor or activity zones: 1) a noodle restaurant at left under a red-and-white awning with seated diners, 2) a vegetable stall with stacked produce crates, 3) a busking duo with guitar and percussion, 4) a central street-food cart selling hotteok, fish cake, and bungeoppang, 5) a standing crowd eating snacks and holding cups, 6) a small magic performance table in the lower center with cards and cups, 7) a painter at an easel near the lower left, and 8) a scooter delivery cluster at the lower right. Add exactly 6 notable background accents: 1) rooftop diners on the upper right terrace, 2) a cat lounging on a roof ledge upper left, 3) colorful market umbrellas in the middle distance, 4) stairways and narrow side passages, 5) dense balconies and windows full of plants and people, and 6) the distant tower and skyline. The crowd should feel extremely varied in age and clothing, mostly casual contemporary Korean street fashion in jackets, hoodies, backpacks, skirts, slacks, and sneakers, with a few office workers and students. Hide a single subtly distinct person meant to be the findable target, {argument name="target outfit" default="a young man in a blue hoodie with yellow lettering"}, integrated naturally among the central crowd rather than spotlighted. Use a vibrant but grounded palette of brick red, teal, forest green, cream, mustard, asphalt gray, and sky blue. Emphasize intricate linework, readable Korean text, observational city details, lively human gestures, and the playful feel of a premium “Where’s Waldo?” style Seoul search poster. Aspect ratio 2:3.
items.promptZh: 一幅详细的垂直编辑旅行插图，描绘了繁华的首尔市场小巷，以精美的手绘现实主义风格呈现，配有温暖的电影灯光、密集的城市故事和高度清晰的标牌。狭窄的邻里市场街道上挤满了一大群行人、购物者、食客、街头小吃顾客、音乐家和通勤者，从稍微抬高的视线高度观看，整个小巷感觉层次分明、充满活力。左上角，一张大型插图海报上写着“{argument name="character name" default="KYLE"}在哪里？”副标题是“你能在首尔找到凯尔吗？”采用大胆有趣的英文版式，风格就像搜索和查找书籍的封面。环境显然应该是首尔，远处的天际线中有一座可见的南山塔，纠结的架空电线，屋顶座位，堆叠的低层建筑，韩语的商店招牌，右侧的地铁入口标志显示4、2、4、4号线和双语文字“서울역 방면/前往首尔站”。包含 15 个主要可见标志或文本面板：1) “哪里是{argument name="character name" default="KYLE"}？”海报, 2) “할머니 손칼국수”, 3) 悬挂式竖牌“낙원상і 2F”, 4) 蓝色小路牌, 5) 竖式牌“ Shoulder”, 6) 大型市场拱门牌“황진다운시장 영”, 7) 垂直橙色标志“커피”，8) 带有“남산 і는길”的壁画地图，9) 带有“출입구 4”和“서울역 방면 / 前往首尔站”的地铁标志，10) 农产品标志“경성 야채”，11) 下部农产品标志“신선한 채소”, 12) 手写的街头艺人标牌, 13) 街头小吃车标牌“호떡·어묵·붕어빵”, 14) 菜单板“오늘의 추천 김밥 떡볶і 순대 튀김”，15) 送货箱文本“빠른 배달”。胡同里正好有 8 个摊贩或活动区：1) 左边红白相间的遮阳篷下有一家面馆，有就座的食客；2) 一个蔬菜摊，堆满了农产品箱；3) 一个拿着吉他和打击乐器的街头二人组；4) 一个中央街头小吃车，出售火锅、鱼饼和 Bungeoppang；5) 一群站着吃小吃和拿着杯子的人；6) 街边的一个小型魔术表演桌。中下部有卡片和杯子，7）左下角附近画架上的画家，8）右下角有一个踏板车交付组。添加 6 个值得注意的背景重点：1) 右上露台上的屋顶餐厅，2) 一只猫懒洋洋地躺在左上角的屋顶壁架上，3) 中距离色彩缤纷的市场雨伞，4) 楼梯和狭窄的侧通道，5) 密集的阳台和窗户，布满植物和人，以及 6) 远处的塔楼和天际线。人群的年龄和服装应该感觉非常不同，大多数是休闲的当代韩国街头时尚，包括夹克、连帽衫、背包、裙子、休闲裤和运动鞋，还有一些办公室职员和学生。隐藏一个微妙独特的人，本应成为可找到的目标，{argument name="target dress" default="a young man in a blue hoodie with Yellow letter"}，自然地融入中心人群而不是聚光灯下。使用砖红色、青色、森林绿色、奶油色、芥末色、沥青灰色和天蓝色等充满活力但接地气的调色板。强调复杂的线条、可读的韩文文字、观察性的城市细节、生动的人类手势，以及优质《沃尔多在哪里？》的俏皮感。风格首尔搜索海报。长宽比 2:3。

items.title: Vitamin C Skincare Ad
items.titleZh: Create a clean luxury skincare product advertisement in a square 1:1 layout with a warm beige studio background and strong natural sunlight casting soft palm-leaf shadows across the wall. Place 1 amber glass dropper bottle on the left-center, standing upright on a round cream stone pedestal. The bottle has a glossy gold collar and a matte white rubber dropper top. Add a white rectangular label with elegant minimal typography: brand name "{argument name="brand name" default="NATURELLE SKINCARE"}" at the top, a large orange product name "{argument name="product name" default="VITAMIN C"}", then black text reading "BRIGHTENING SERUM" and smaller subtext "With Hyaluronic Acid & Niacinamide". Surround the pedestal with 3 visible glossy green tropical leaves, arranged from the left edge and behind the bottle for a fresh botanical look. On the right side, place a large bold black serif headline in 3 stacked lines reading "{argument name="headline text" default="Glow Naturally. Every Day."}". Beneath it, add a smaller clean sans-serif benefits line reading "{argument name="benefits text" default="Brightens | Hydrates | Protects"}". Below that, include 3 circular black outline ingredient or values icons in a horizontal row, each with a simple leaf-style symbol inside; add tiny caption text beneath them with the same slightly imperfect ad-like wording seen in the original, including "Barban Free", "Dermicologyg", and "Creuty-free". At the lower right, place a glossy rounded green call-to-action button with white bold text "{argument name="button text" default="Shop Now"}". Add 1 sliced orange on the far right edge, partially cropped, with vivid juicy texture to reinforce the vitamin C theme. Include a small white "Pollo.ai" watermark in the top-right corner. Style the whole image as a polished commercial product mockup, photorealistic, high-end beauty branding, soft warm highlights, subtle shadows, balanced composition, sharp label detail, premium ecommerce social ad aesthetic.

items.title: Fashion Height Comparison of Four Women
items.titleZh: A clean fashion comparison studio photo of 4 adult East Asian women standing side by side against a plain light gray seamless background, full body visible from head to shoes, photographed straight-on with soft diffused lighting and a polished commercial look. Above each woman, centered over her head in black serif text, place height labels reading exactly: 145cm, 155cm, 165cm, 175cm. Emphasize realistic proportional differences in height while keeping all four women slim, elegant, and similarly styled, with long dark brown to black softly wavy hair and neutral expressions. Their faces are obscured by smooth rectangular blur blocks. The women stand very close together in a friendly pose, with subtle arm contact and one woman lightly resting an arm around another. Use a coordinated beige, cream, taupe, and soft blush wardrobe palette with smart casual feminine outfits and matching ivory loafers. Woman 1 under the 145cm label wears a short-sleeve cream ribbed knit top tucked into high-waisted light beige shorts with a fabric belt, plus a small quilted shoulder bag with a chain strap. Woman 2 under the 155cm label wears a white long-sleeve blouse with a bow tie at the collar and a taupe mini skirt with a slight flared hem, carrying a small light beige crossbody handbag. Woman 3 under the 165cm label wears a sleeveless blush-beige ribbed knit top and a simple ivory mini skirt. Woman 4 under the 175cm label wears a draped white V-neck blouse with sleeves rolled to the forearms, high-waisted taupe belted shorts, and a medium taupe shoulder bag. All 4 women wear cream or ivory horsebit loafers. Composition is vertical, centered, minimal, stylish, realistic, like a fashion catalog image comparing female heights.
items.promptZh: 一张干净的时尚比较工作室照片，4 名成年东亚女性并排站在浅灰色无缝背景下，全身从头部到鞋子都可见，采用柔和的漫射灯光和抛光的商业外观直接拍摄。在每位女性上方，以黑色衬线文字居中放置身高标签，其读数准确：145 厘米、155 厘米、165 厘米、175 厘米。强调现实的身高比例差异，同时保持所有四位女性的苗条、优雅和相似的风格，留着深棕色到黑色的柔软波浪形长发和中性的表情。他们的脸被光滑的矩形模糊块遮挡。两位女士以友好的姿势站得很近，手臂有微妙的接触，其中一位女士轻轻地用手臂搂着另一位女士。使用协调的米色、奶油色、灰褐色和柔和的腮红衣柜调色板搭配时尚休闲女性服装和相配的象牙色乐福鞋。 145cm标签下的女性1穿着短袖奶油色罗纹针织上衣，塞进高腰浅米色短裤中，配有织物腰带，再加上带有链条带的小号绗缝单肩包。 155cm标签下的女性2身穿白色长袖衬衫，领口系有领结，下身搭配灰褐色微喇叭形迷你裙，拎浅米色小斜挎包。 165cm标签下的女人3穿着无袖腮红米色罗纹针织上衣和简约的象牙色迷你裙。 175cm 标签下的女性 4 身穿垂坠白色 V 领衬衫，袖子卷至前臂，搭配高腰灰褐色束带短裤，背中号灰褐色单肩包。所有 4 名女性均穿着奶油色或象牙色马衔扣乐福鞋。构图是垂直的、居中的、简约的、时尚的、现实的，就像比较女性身高的时装目录图像。

items.title: Korean Rice Drink Parody Ad Poster
items.titleZh:
Create a bold Korean-style beverage advertisement poster with a warm golden splash background and dramatic commercial lighting. Show a {argument name="celebrity spokesperson" default="Donald Trump-like older male politician"} from the chest up, wearing a navy suit, white dress shirt, bright red tie, and a small American flag lapel pin, facing camera with a confident sales-pitch expression. His face is obscured by a flat rectangular censor block in a skin-toned color. In his left hand, extended close to the camera in forced perspective, he holds a yellow aluminum can of Korean rice punch drink labeled prominently in Korean, with red top and bottom bands and the main product text "비락 식혜" and "Since 1993" on the can. The can also includes smaller Korean copy, an image of sweet rice drink near the bottom, and the volume text "238 ml (120 kcal)". His right hand gives a thumbs-up.

Use an energetic retro-commercial composition, with splashing sweet rice beverage and droplets behind him, glowing golden highlights, and a slightly low-angle heroic framing. At the top, include 3 distinct headline text groups: a small handwritten-style black slogan on the upper left reading "전통의 맛, 한국의 DRINK!", a huge central headline in distressed bold Korean type reading "걸죽는 땐?" in dark brown-black and "비락 식혜!" in vivid red, and a brand logo on the upper right reading "비락" with small red text "Since 1993" beneath it. Add 2 callout badges: on the left, a yellow circular seal with a tiny crown icon and the text "대한민국 국민음료 No.1"; on the right, a white speech bubble with handwritten Korean text "한국이 만든 맛있는 전통!" and red English text "I LOVE IT!".

At the bottom foreground, place 2 food elements: a brass bowl filled with sweet rice drink and floating rice grains on the left, and a wooden bowl piled with white rice on the right. Across the lower middle, add 2 lines of large brush-style promotional text, the first in white reading "달콤하게! 시원하게!" and the second in mixed white and yellow reading "속까지 시~원하게!" with an energetic yellow underline stroke. Along the very bottom, include 3 circular feature icons with captions in Korean: "국내산 쌀 엄선된 재료", "시원하게 갈증해소", and "부드러운 단맛 속 편한 식혜". In the lower right corner, add tiny disclaimer text "연출된 이미지입니다". Make the overall look glossy, exaggerated, funny, and convincing like a viral parody print ad.

以温暖的金色飞溅背景和戏剧性的商业灯光打造大胆的韩式饮料广告海报。展示一位{argument name="celebrityspoken" default="唐纳德·特朗普式的老年男性政客"}从胸部以上的角度，穿着海军蓝西装、白色正装衬衫、鲜红色领带，别着美国国旗小翻领别针，面对镜头，露出自信的推销表情。他的脸被肤色的扁平矩形检查块遮挡。他的左手以强制视角靠近镜头，手里拿着一个黄色铝罐，装着韩国大米宾治饮料，上面有韩语醒目标签，顶部和底部有红色条带，罐上有主要产品文字“비락 식혜”和“Since 1993”。该罐还包括较小的韩文副本、底部附近的甜米饮料图像以及体积文字“238 毫升（120 kcal）”。他的右手竖起了大拇指。

采用充满活力的复古商业构图，身后是飞溅的甜米饮料和水滴，泛着金色的亮点，略低角度的英雄取景。在顶部，包括 3 个不同的标题文本组：左上方有一个小的手写式黑色标语，上面写着“전통의 맛，한국의 DRINK！”，一个巨大的中央标题，以粗体韩文字体写着“걸죽는 땐？”深棕黑色和“비락 식혜!”鲜艳的红色，右上角有一个品牌标志，上面写着“비락”，下面有红色小文字“Since 1993”。添加 2 个标注徽章：左侧是一个黄色圆形印章，带有小皇冠图标和文字“대한민국 국민음료 No.1”；右侧是一个白色的气泡，上面有手写的韩文文字“한국 Been 만든 맛있는 전통!”和红色英文文字“我喜欢它！”。

底部前景放置2个食物元素：左边是装满甜米饮料和漂浮米粒的黄铜碗，右边是堆满白米的木碗。在中下方，添加两行大毛笔式促销文字，第一行是白色的“달콤하게！시원하게！”第二个是白色和黄色混合的，写着“속까지 시~원하게！”带有充满活力的黄色下划线。沿着最底部，包括 3 个带有韩语标题的圆形功能图标：“국내산 쌀 엄선된 재료”、“시원하게 갈증해소”和“부드러운 단맛 속 편한” 식혜”。在右下角，添加微小的免责声明文本“연출된 Been 지입니다”。让整体看起来有光泽、夸张、有趣且令人信服，就像病毒式模仿平面广告一样。

items.title: Vintage Malta Travel Poster
items.titleZh: A vintage travel poster illustration for {argument name="destination name" default="MALTA"}, with the subtitle {argument name="tagline" default="MEDITERRANEAN PARADISE"} centered near the top. The composition is a sunlit Mediterranean coastal cityscape viewed from a curving seaside road in the foreground, painted in a richly textured retro poster style with warm cream stone architecture, saturated turquoise-blue sea, and a bright azure sky with soft white clouds. On the left, a hillside of tightly packed historic limestone buildings rises above the waterfront, including colorful enclosed wooden balconies, a large domed church with a reddish terracotta roof, and a slender church spire. In the foreground on the road, place a classic mid-century white sedan seen from the rear three-quarter angle, driving along the curve, with a dark license plate reading {argument name="license plate text" default="MTA 1964"}. A low stone seawall runs along the right edge of the road beside the harbor. In the bay, include exactly 4 boats: 2 colorful Maltese luzzu fishing boats in the near and mid water, plus 2 smaller distant boats farther back. Add exactly 4 white seagulls gliding across the sky above the water. Frame the scene with lush flowering bougainvillea branches in vivid magenta-pink arching across the upper right and lower right corners, and leafy tree branches along the upper left edge; include a spiky agave plant in the lower left foreground. The distant shoreline across the bay should show a pale sunlit city stretching along the horizon. Use a nostalgic 1950s–1960s tourism poster aesthetic, painterly brushwork, crisp composition, romantic travel mood, and elegant typography with the main title in large cream serif capitals and the subtitle in smaller dark sans-serif capitals.
items.promptZh: {argument name="destination name" default="MALTA"} 的复古旅行海报插图，副标题 {argument name="tagline" default="MEDITERRANEAN PARADISE"} 位于顶部附近的中心位置。构图是从前景弯曲的海滨道路上看到的阳光明媚的地中海沿海城市景观，以质感丰富的复古海报风格绘制，温暖的奶油色石头建筑，饱和的绿松石蓝色大海，以及明亮的蔚蓝天空和柔软的白云。左边，一座山坡上矗立着一座座历史悠久的石灰岩建筑，矗立在海滨之上，其中包括色彩缤纷的封闭式木制阳台、一座带有微红色赤土屋顶的大型圆顶教堂，以及一座细长的教堂尖顶。在道路前景中，放置一辆从后四分之三角看去的经典中世纪白色轿车，沿着曲线行驶，深色车牌上写着 {argument name="licenseplate text" default="MTA 1964"}。港口旁边道路的右边缘有一座低矮的石头海堤。海湾中正好有 4 艘船：2 艘色彩缤纷的马耳他 luzzu 渔船位于近水区和中水区，再加上 2 艘较小的远处船，位于较远的后方。添加正好 4 只白色海鸥，它们在水面上的天空中滑翔。用茂盛的开花九重葛树枝和生动的洋红色拱形横跨右上角和右下角，以及沿着左上边缘的绿叶树枝来构筑场景；在左下前景中包括一株带刺的龙舌兰植物。海湾对面的遥远海岸线应该显示出一座阳光明媚的苍白城市沿着地平线延伸。使用怀旧的 20 世纪 50 年代至 60 年代的旅游海报美学、绘画性的笔触、清晰的构图、浪漫的旅行心情和优雅的排版，主标题采用大号奶油色衬线大写字母，副标题采用较小的深色无衬线大写字母。

items.title: Packaging Design Proposal Board Prompt
items.titleZh:
Please generate a "hand-drawn packaging proposal board style" product introduction poster for {argument name="product name" default="milk powder"}.

If I provide a product image, please use it as the main reference, retaining the core visual characteristics, packaging form, colors, materials, brand identity, and overall temperament of the product. Prioritize the main color tone and color relationships from the product image for the design.
If I do not provide a product image, please automatically generate a product appearance and packaging design that fits the positioning of {argument name="product name" default="milk powder"}, and automatically match natural and reasonable main, auxiliary, and background colors based on the product attributes, category characteristics, and temperament.

Overall poster style requirements:
This is not a standard e-commerce detail page or a simple studio-shot poster, but a creative proposal board that integrates "product finished image + packaging design sketches + brand concept development process." The overall presentation is a high-aesthetic, high-completion brand design display image, as if a designer is presenting a packaging concept proposal.

Visual requirements:
- Vertical composition
- Use a unified background with a brand feel; the background color should be naturally determined by the product itself and not fixed to any one color.
- Color schemes should coordinate with product attributes: if there is a reference image, prioritize inheriting its main and brand colors; if not, automatically generate a reasonable color scheme based on the product name.
- Place the most complete and eye-catching product main visual in the center, with realistic textures, 3D lighting, and commercial finish effects.
- Surround the product with multiple auxiliary visual elements: packaging sketches from different angles, structural sketches, local form explorations, hand-held display drafts, packaging unfolding ideas, and brand lettering layout experiments.
- Add natural and casual black or dark hand-drawn line art, arrows, circles, symbols, and handwritten Chinese annotations to give the image a strong sense of "design process" and "creative proposal."
- The finished product image should be relatively refined and realistic, while the sketch parts should be relatively casual and dynamic, creating a contrast between the "finished product + design sketches."
- The layout should look relaxed and free, but overall it must have order, rhythm, and a visual center, reflecting a high-end graphic design feel.
- Small graphics, symbols, or interesting elements related to the product can be added appropriately to enhance brand memory points.
- The final effect should have a sense of branding, creativity, process, and visual impact.

Color principles:
- Do not fix a yellow background.
- Automatically select the main color tone based on product type, material, use, consumer experience, and brand temperament.
- The background color, product color, text color, and sketch line art color should coordinate with each other.
- High-saturation monochromatic backgrounds or soft, unified color schemes can be used, as long as the overall image has a brand feel and visual impact.
- Colors should naturally serve the product rather than overshadow it.

Style keywords:
Packaging design proposal board, brand concept development, hand-drawn sketches, design process feel, moodboard, creative review draft, product finished rendering, visual experimentation, commercial design poster.

Special notes:
- If there is a reference product image, prioritize following it and do not deviate from the product itself.
- If there is no reference image, automatically generate reasonable product appearance, packaging, and color schemes based on the product name, maintaining overall style consistency.
- The focus of the image is "product introduction + creative design process display."
- Do not make it look like a common e-commerce detail page, a promotional poster, or overly neat and stiff; do not lack sketches and handwritten annotations; avoid a cheap feel or an immature cartoon style.
items.prompt:
请为【{argument name="产品名称" default="奶粉"}】生成一张“手绘包装提案板风格”的产品介绍海报。 

如果我提供了产品图片，请以该图片为主要参考，保留产品的核心外观特征、包装形态、颜色、材质、品牌识别和整体气质，并优先沿用产品图中的主色调与配色关系进行设计。
如果我没有提供产品图片，请根据【{argument name="产品名称" default="奶粉"}】自动生成符合该产品定位的产品外观与包装设计，并根据产品属性、品类特征和气质，自动搭配自然合理的主色、辅助色和背景色。

海报整体风格要求：
这不是普通电商详情页，也不是单纯棚拍海报，而是一张融合“产品成品图 + 包装设计草图 + 品牌概念开发过程”的创意提案板。整体呈现为高审美、高完成度的品牌设计展示图，像设计师正在展示一个包装概念方案。

画面要求：
- 竖版构图
- 使用统一且有品牌感的主色调背景，背景颜色根据产品本身自然决定，不固定为某一种颜色
- 配色应与产品属性协调：如果有参考图，优先继承参考图的主色和品牌色；如果没有参考图，则根据产品名称自动生成合理的色彩方案
- 画面中央放置一个最完整、最吸睛的产品主视觉，具有真实质感、立体光影和商业成品效果
- 产品周围加入多个辅助视觉元素：不同角度的包装草图、结构草图、局部造型探索、手持展示小稿、包装展开思路、品牌字样排版试验
- 加入自然随性的黑色或深色手绘线稿、箭头、圈画、符号、手写中文批注，让画面具有强烈“设计过程感”和“创意提案感”
- 成品图要相对精致真实，草图部分要相对随性灵动，形成“完成品 + 设计草图”的对比
- 版式看起来松弛自由，但整体要有秩序、有节奏、有视觉中心，体现高级平面设计感
- 可以适度加入与产品相关的小图形、小符号或趣味元素，增强品牌记忆点
- 最终效果应具有品牌感、创意感、过程感和视觉冲击力

配色原则：
- 不要固定黄色背景
- 要根据产品类型、材质、用途、消费感受和品牌气质自动选择主色调
- 背景色、产品色、文字色、草图线稿色应彼此协调
- 可以使用高饱和单色背景，也可以使用柔和统一色系背景，只要整体有品牌感和视觉冲击力
- 色彩应自然服务于产品，而不是喧宾夺主

风格关键词：
包装设计提案板、品牌概念开发、手绘草图、设计过程感、moodboard、创意评审稿、产品成品渲染、视觉实验、商业设计海报

请特别注意：
- 如果有参考产品图，优先遵循参考图，不要偏离产品本身
- 如果没有参考图，则根据产品名称自动生成合理的产品外观、包装和配色方案，并保持整体风格统一
- 画面重点是“产品介绍 + 创意设计过程展示”
- 不要做成普通电商详情页，不要做成促销海报，不要过度整齐呆板，不要缺少草图和手写批注，不要廉价感，不要低幼卡通感

items.title: Chinese VPS Comparison Cover
items.titleZh: Create a clean modern Chinese tech blog cover in a wide 16:9 layout with a soft light-gray background, rounded-corner canvas, and minimalist dashboard aesthetic. On the left, place a small rounded category pill near the top with a yellow dot icon and the text “VPS 实测 · 购买参考”. Below it, set a very large bold dark navy Chinese headline in two stacked lines: “DMIT涨价之后” and “我把搬瓦工”. Under the headline, add a short yellow underline accent and then a medium-gray subheading reading “先看重点再下单”. The typography should feel premium, editorial, and highly legible, with strong contrast and generous spacing. On the right, show a floating desktop-app style server monitoring panel with a white card body, subtle shadow, rounded corners, and a pale beige browser top bar with three small circular window buttons. The panel header should read “BandwagonHost – CN2 GIA”, with a smaller line underneath “洛杉矶 · CN2 GIA” and a green status label “运行中”, plus on the top-right a small clock icon and the text “运行时长 27 天”. Inside the panel, include exactly 5 metric cards across the top row labeled “CPU” showing “12%”, “内存” showing “28%”, “硬盘” showing “18%”, “带宽” showing “1.2 Mbps”, and “延迟（本地）” showing “156 ms”, each with a small teal icon and a thin teal progress bar. Below, place a large line chart card on the left titled “稳定性（近 7 天）” with a top-right annotation “可用性 99.92%”, a teal fluctuating line, a vertical scale from 97% to 100%, and date labels from “05-13” through “05-19”. To the right of the chart, add a specs card titled “配置摘要” listing exactly 5 rows: “CPU 2 vCPU”, “内存 2 GB”, “硬盘 40 GB SSD”, “流量 1 TB/月”, and “系统 CentOS 7.9 64bit”. In the lower-left area overlapping between the text block and the dashboard, add a smaller white recommendation card with rounded corners and shadow. Its title line should include a yellow bookmark icon and read “购买参考 · 重点看这几项”. Inside, list exactly 4 rows: “线路质量  CN2 GIA”, “稳定性  ★★★★☆”, “性价比  中上”, and “适用场景  建站 / 中转 / 轻应用”. Add soft decorative elements in the background: a pale mint abstract rounded shape in the bottom-left corner, a faint dotted mint pattern above it, and a light dotted curved connector line arcing from the left text area toward the top of the dashboard, with a small yellow dot on the curve. Place a small rounded yellow name tag in the bottom-right corner of the canvas with the text “小墨同学”. Use a restrained palette of dark navy, teal, yellow, white, and light gray, with crisp vector-style rendering, subtle shadows, spacious composition, and a polished AI-generated editorial cover look for a VPS comparison article.

items.title: Luxury Bag Meets Discount Chaos Poster
items.titleZh: A vertical 9:16 luxury-fashion parody advertising poster with a single centered handbag as the hero product, designed as a brutal collision between ultra-premium maison branding and chaotic Chinese e-commerce discount graphics. The top half should feel like an elegant Hermes-style campaign: a warm beige and taupe atelier interior with soft morning window light, shallow depth of field, refined wall paneling, a wooden worktable, and visible artisan tools including exactly 6 workshop elements around the bag: a brush cup with several brushes on the left, a small ceramic vase on the far left, a leather awl or burnishing tool on the table front left, a knife-like leather tool on the table front left edge, an adjustable desk lamp on the right, and a spool of thread on the right. At the top center place a gold luxury logo with a horse-and-carriage icon above the word HERMÈS and PARIS beneath it, followed by one giant serif headline reading BIRKIN in gold. In the center, show one large structured crocodile-embossed Birkin-style handbag in {argument name="bag color" default="warm greige taupe"}, front-facing, highly detailed leather texture, polished gold hardware, upright handles, sitting on the tabletop, photographed like a premium product shot. Across the right-middle of the bag, add one torn-paper rip effect revealing aggressive discount advertising underneath; around the tear add exactly 5 digital glitch accents in neon magenta, green, cyan, black, and white. On the torn area place exactly 3 visible Chinese promo stickers layered diagonally: a small red sticker reading 福利价, a large red sticker reading 百亿补贴, and a black sticker with bright outline reading 亿补贴. The bottom third of the poster should erupt into a loud comic-book and livestream-sale visual explosion with torn-paper separation from the luxury upper half. Use saturated red, yellow, white, black, and cyan with sharp starburst shapes, speed lines, heavy outlines, and flying gold coins. Include exactly 7 bottom promotional text blocks: 1 large central red banner reading 百亿补贴, 1 red rounded rectangle below it with the Pinduoduo logo and the text 拼多多, 2 side banners partially cropped with 拼多多, 2 additional yellow-red 百亿补贴 bursts at the lower left and lower center, and 1 handwritten black calligraphy slogan at the lower right reading 砍一刀. Add one extra handwritten black phrase at the lower left reading 只需9.9元!. The overall composition must feel like an elite fashion campaign violently invaded by cheap viral bargain marketing, with cinematic lighting, strong visual hierarchy, realistic product rendering, premium typography above, explosive discount chaos below, and intentional aesthetic contrast between sophistication and low-cost internet commerce. Make it look like a high-end brand collaboration key visual poster for {argument name="collaboration brand text" default="拼多多 × 爱马仕"} promoting {argument name="promo text" default="百亿补贴铂金包"}.

items.title: Luxury x E-commerce Split Poster
items.titleZh: Create a vertical 9:16 luxury-campaign poster for a fictional crossover product, a disruptive co-branded handbag advertisement between {argument name="brand one" default="HERMÈS PARIS"} and {argument name="brand two" default="拼多多"}. The composition is a violently split, collage-style fashion key visual with a torn-paper seam running vertically down the center, dividing two clashing aesthetics: on the left, refined premium luxury branding in warm Hermes orange, cream paper, and elegant editorial minimalism; on the right, aggressive Chinese e-commerce promotion energy in black and metallic red foil, with loud sale graphics, confetti, ripped stickers, and explosive discount typography. At the top center, place both brands prominently with a large collaboration headline in Chinese, the left logo area styled like a classic luxury house with serif typography and horse-and-carriage emblem, the right logo area in bold red Chinese branding. Below that, add the main headline text in huge Chinese characters: {argument name="headline text" default="颠覆性联名款"}, and a boxed subheadline: {argument name="subheadline text" default="百亿补贴铂金包"}. The centerpiece is one Birkin-style luxury handbag shown front-facing and large, perfectly centered but visually split in half along the torn seam: the left half is orange pebbled leather with gold hardware, the right half is crinkled metallic silver leather with silver hardware, both halves seamlessly merged into one surreal bag. The bag should include 5 clearly visible accessory/product elements around or on it: 1 orange clochette hanging on the left, 1 metallic silver hanging strap with lock on the right, 1 central turn-lock closure with padlock, 1 orange Hermes-style gift box with dark ribbon at lower left, and 1 beige dust bag with small logo near the bottom left. Behind the bag on the left is a painterly orange brushstroke on textured cream paper; behind the bag on the right is a crushed reflective red metallic wrapper surface with spark-like highlights and falling confetti. On the right half, add 8 aggressive promotional text bursts and stickers layered diagonally like an online shopping festival poster: 1 giant white Chinese slogan "百亿补贴 全网最低", 2 "限时秒杀!!", 3 a torn price sticker reading "补贴价 ¥999?!", 4 "万件疯抢", 5 "百亿补贴 官方直补", 6 "直降到底", 7 a large bottom torn banner repeating "补贴价 ¥999?!", and 8 small text "建议零售价 ¥1000000+". On the left margin, add a slim vertical editorial text column with 4 grouped text blocks in a luxury layout: 1 "限量发售 / 全球瞩目 / 2024 LIMITED EDITION", 2 "HERMÈS PARIS MADE IN FRANCE", 3 "CRAFTED FOR ELEGANCE", and 4 "DESIGNED TO DEFY THE ORDINARY". At the bottom, create a black app-like information bar with 3 feature blocks from left to right: 1 a red brand icon with "拼多多" and a search-bar style pill containing "百亿补贴铂金包", 2 a lightning icon with the text "百亿补贴 官方补贴 所以低价", and 3 a shield icon with the text "正品保障 假一赔十 3期免息". Add a thin final slogan line across the very bottom in small Chinese text. Use hyper-detailed commercial product photography, premium graphic design, sharp lighting, embossed textures, foil reflections, paper tears, and strong depth. The overall mood must feel like a world-class art director forced a heritage luxury campaign and a chaotic discount-shopping poster to collide in one image, producing extreme visual tension, irony, and high-impact contrast.

items.title: One Piece Manga Coloring Cover Page
items.titleZh: A clean manga-coloring test page styled like an official One Piece chapter cover on a light gray background. At the very top, place the large black-and-white ONE PIECE logo with the skull wearing a yellow straw hat with a red band, integrated rope elements, and the silhouette inside the lettering. Centered beneath it, add the subtitle text {argument name="chapter title" default="Chapter 1177: FURIOUS"} in bold black serif italics. Below that, create one large rectangular full-color illustration framed by a thin black border. The scene shows Nico Robin, a young woman with long straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair and pale skin, seated in a garden with her knees drawn up, planting flowers. items.titleZh: A cleanly colored manga page in a modern romantic-comedy style, presented as a 6-panel comic layout with crisp black panel borders on a white page. The scene takes place outdoors on a bright day with blue sky, soft clouds, leafy green trees, paved walkway, and queue posts with chain barriers. The main subject is a teenage anime girl with a short blond bob haircut, loose windblown strands, large golden-brown eyes, light blush, and a serious slightly embarrassed expression. She wears a floppy dog-ear hat with cream fur and a small blue polka-dot cap detail, a blue school-style cardigan or blazer over a white shirt, and a red patterned necktie, while holding a pink swirled soft-serve ice cream cone. A teenage boy in a dark blue sweater and white collared shirt appears in 3 panels, his face obscured by a soft rectangular blur, also wearing a matching floppy dog-ear hat. The page should have exactly 6 panels: 2 small panels across the top row, 1 large central close-up panel spanning the width, and 3 panels along the bottom row. Top-left panel: the boy faces forward with the girl turning sharply toward him, her hair and hat flaring from motion, outdoor background with a signboard, and hand-drawn manga sound effects in black. Top-right panel: a small chibi-style version of the girl stands near the chain barrier, looking smug and flustered while holding the ice cream, with a speech bubble that says "THAT'S A LOOK OF ACCOMPLISHMENT." and small floating sound-effect text near her head. Center panel: a dramatic close-up portrait of the girl against open sky, hair blowing across her face, one strand crossing her mouth, dog ears visible, staring forward with a calm, stunned look; include a vertical speech bubble on the right with Japanese text and a small English sound effect reading "PLOP". Bottom-left panel: the boy, face blurred, speaking with a speech bubble that says "I'VE BEEN THINKING THIS FOR A WHILE, BUT..." Bottom-middle panel: the girl in side view lifting a hand toward her mouth while holding the pink ice cream in the other hand, with a speech bubble saying "THANKS." Bottom-right panel: the boy reaches toward the girl's mouth or cheek with his hand as if wiping off cream, with a speech bubble that says "YOU GOT SOME CREAM OVER HERE." Keep all visible comic text and sound effects integrated into the art, including "WAH!", "FWSH", and the English dialogue. Use polished manga coloring over inked line art: soft cel shading, slightly textured watercolor-like fills, warm skin tones, glossy eyes, fine crosshatching accents, and expressive linework. Emphasize romantic tension, wind movement, and the contrast between comedic chibi reaction and tender close-up drama.
items.promptZh: 现代浪漫喜剧风格的色彩干净的漫画页面，以 6 面板漫画布局呈现，白色页面上有清晰的黑色面板边框。场景发生在晴朗的户外，蓝天、软云、绿树成荫、铺好的人行道和带有铁链屏障的排队柱。主角是一位十几岁的动漫女孩，留着金色短发，被风吹散的发丝，金棕色的大眼睛，淡淡的腮红，表情严肃而略显尴尬。她戴着一顶带有奶油色毛皮和蓝色小圆点细节的松软狗耳帽，白色衬衫外面套着蓝色学校风格的羊毛衫或西装外套，打着红色图案的领带，手里拿着一个粉色漩涡状的软冰淇淋筒。一个身穿深蓝色毛衣和白领衬衫的十几岁男孩出现在 3 个画面中，他的脸被柔和的矩形模糊遮挡，还戴着一顶相配的松软狗耳帽。该页面应恰好有 6 个面板：顶行有 2 个小面板，横跨整个宽度的 1 个大型中央特写面板，以及底行有 3 个面板。左上面板：男孩面朝前方，女孩猛地转向他，她的头发和帽子因动作而飘扬，户外背景上有一块招牌，还有手绘的黑色漫画音效。右上面板：一个赤壁风格的小女孩站在铁链屏障附近，手里拿着冰淇淋，看上去得意又慌乱，还有一个对话气泡，上面写着“这是一种成就”。以及她头部附近浮动的小音效文字。中心面板：一幅戏剧性的特写肖像，画中的女孩在开阔的天空下，头发飘过她的脸，一根头发穿过她的嘴，狗耳朵清晰可见，凝视着前方，表情平静而震惊；右侧包括一个带有日语文本的垂直对话气泡和一个小的英文音效“PLOP”。左下图：男孩，脸部模糊，说话时有一个对话气泡，上面写着“我已经想这个有一段时间了，但是……”中下图：侧视图中的女孩将一只手伸向嘴边，另一只手拿着粉红色的冰淇淋，对话气泡上写着“谢谢”。右下图：男孩把手伸向女孩的嘴或脸颊，就像擦奶油一样，并带有一个对话气泡，上面写着“你这里有一些奶油”。将所有可见的漫画文本和声音效果融入艺术中，包括“WAH！”、“FWSH”和英语对话。在墨水线条艺术上使用抛光的漫画着色：柔和的卡通阴影、略带纹理的水彩般的填充、温暖的肤色、有光泽的眼睛、精细的交叉影线口音和富有表现力的线条。强调浪漫的张力、风的动作，以及喜剧赤壁反应和温柔的特写戏剧之间的对比。

items.titleZh: A fully colored shonen manga action page in the style of a high-energy pirate battle comic, presented as a single comic page with 4 visible panels separated by thick white gutters and slightly tilted panel borders. Use bold black ink lines, dense crosshatching, speed lines, cel-style coloring, dramatic foreshortening, and exaggerated impact effects. The scene shows a muscular, towering giant warrior with tan skin, a horned helmet, wild black hair and beard, fur-trimmed black clothing, a wide studded metal belt, and a massive spiked club, battling a swordsman in dark blue clothing and armor-like headgear. Top panel: an extreme close-up of a huge clenched fist thrusting toward the viewer with explosive perspective, the giant shouting “GUNGNIR !!!” in a jagged speech balloon, and another balloon reading “GWOAH !!!”; add large red Japanese sound effects and a small “DOOM!!” impact text. Middle wide panel: the giant swings upward and roars “IKOKU SOVEREIGNTY !!!” while the blue-clad opponent recoils at left; include a speech balloon saying “GAH!” and large purple Japanese sound effects with a small “WHONK!!”. Bottom left narrow panel: a cropped close-up setup panel with two stacked speech balloons reading “THREE SWORD STYLE.” and “RED OGRE…”, with the speaker mostly off-frame and partially obscured. Bottom right large panel: the giant drives a massive wooden spiked club across the frame in a violent horizontal smash, shouting “GIANT TROMMA !!!”; include smaller impact balloons reading “DWUAH !!!” and “THWAM!!”, plus oversized red Japanese sound effects. Backgrounds should be mostly pale sky blue with heavy motion lines and flying debris. Preserve the feel of a professionally colored weekly manga page: saturated reds, blues, purples, tan skin tones, cream fur textures, black shadows, and crisp white speech balloons with hand-lettered comic text.

items.titleZh: A full-color manga page in the style of a dramatic sports manga, showing an intense soccer match inside a huge domed stadium packed with a blue-and-white crowd. Use sharp ink lines, dense crosshatching, screentone texture, dynamic speed lines, and vivid anime coloring as if a black-and-white manga page has been professionally colorized. The composition is a single page with 3 panels: 1 large main panel covering most of the page, plus 2 narrow diagonal inset panels stacked along the left side. In the main panel, show a steeply tilted wide-angle view of the penalty area and goal from an elevated sideline perspective, with the green grass stretched by perspective and filled with directional hatching. Count 6 visible players in the main panel: 4 blue-uniform players and 2 white-uniform players, plus 1 goalkeeper in yellow at the goal. The most prominent player is seen from behind in the lower center-right wearing a blue jersey with “HUGO” and the number 9, running toward the play with one arm extended. Near him on the lower right edge, show another player in a white jersey labeled “ISAGI” with the number 11, also running forward. In the midground, show 4 more field players contesting the ball: 3 in blue and 1 in white, with one white-uniform player diving or lunging horizontally from the right toward the center. The goal stands near the top center-left, with the yellow goalkeeper bracing in front of the net. Add 3 speech bubbles in the main panel, large white manga balloons with hand-lettered uppercase English text: “BUT I WANT TO WIN THE WORLD CUP...”, “...AS THE SECOND-BEST AND AS A MID-FIELDER.”, and “...THE WORLD RECORD FOR MOST TIMES WINNING THE WORLD CUP...”. In the left-side inset area, create 2 diagonal panels. The upper inset panel shows a close-up of a dark-haired character in blue, partly obscured by a soft rectangular blur over the center of the face and torso area, with a small speech bubble that says, “YOICHI ISAGI, DID YOU KNOW...”. The lower inset panel shows a close-up of a reddish-haired character with a wide blue eye, sweat on the face, and a pale blue background, looking surprised or stunned. items.title: Japanese Jungle Theme Park Parody Poster
items.titleZh: A hyper-detailed vertical Japanese theme park advertisement poster set in a lush tropical jungle under a vivid blue sky with scattered clouds and strong golden sunlight flaring from the upper right. The style is cinematic, photorealistic, dramatic, and slightly absurdist, like a premium satirical travel ad. At the top, huge three-dimensional stone-textured gold Japanese headline text reads {argument name="headline text" default="ジャンキリア沖縄"}, with a smaller white Japanese tagline underneath that reads "— やんばるの大自然に包まれた、超本格ジャングル・テーマパーク —". In the center foreground, a giant modern smartphone stands upright, slightly tilted, dominating the composition like a monument. Its screen shows a lottery waiting-ticket interface with a safari silhouette header and large bold Japanese text "整理券抽選中", a dotted loading circle, smaller text "結果発表まで30分", and a tiny note "※この画面を閉じずにお待ちください". The phone status bar shows 10:00. To the left midground, a roaring Tyrannosaurus rex emerges from dense jungle foliage behind a huge aged concrete sign with oversized red Japanese text "待ち時間 180分". To the right midground, an ornate extravagant gold entrance gate to a premium area rises above the trees, with a black signboard reading "プレミアムパス入口" and a red-carpeted queue lane beyond it. A long crowded line of park visitors stretches from the foreground deep into the background along rope barriers; the visitors wear summer vacation clothing, hats, towels, backpacks, handheld fans, water bottles, and parasols, showing exhaustion, heat, and anticipation. In the lower left foreground, 3 stacked rustic wooden signboards are visible: the top board says "駐車場 2,000円" with a parking icon, the middle board says "アプリ必須 ダウンロードしてね!" with a smartphone icon, and the bottom board says "当選者だけが冒険へ" with a dinosaur silhouette. Along the right side, large vertical white brush-style Japanese copy reads {argument name="side slogan" default="待つこと、それが冒険だ。"}. Near the lower right are 3 circular gold icon callouts with short Japanese promotional lines: 1 dinosaur icon with "抽選に選ばれし者だけが、恐竜に会える。", 1 smartphone battery icon with "スマホの充電が尽きる前に、夢は始まる。", and 1 VIP icon with "プレミアムな近道も、ご用意しました。". At the very bottom center, include a small black strip with white Japanese disclaimer text: "このポスターは架空のパロディ広告です". The jungle should be dense and glossy with large tropical leaves framing the foreground, warm rim lighting, high contrast, and a polished blockbuster-poster composition. Keep all Japanese typography crisp, clean, and perfectly legible.

items.title: Tang Dynasty Aesthetic CG Illustration
items.titleZh:
{argument name="style" default="Chinese style CG illustration"}, Tang Dynasty aesthetics, {argument name="character description" default="exquisite ancient woman"}, half-body close-up shot, focus on face and upper body, high-end portrait composition, cinematic camera language and spatial perspective.

Character Setting:
East Asian classical beauty, cold white transparent skin, fine and real skin texture, soft shimmer; exquisite and three-dimensional facial features but natural and not exaggerated, narrow phoenix eyes, slightly tilted eye corners, affectionate and shy eyes, slightly tipsy and hazy, long eyelashes casting subtle shadows; lip color like rouge, slightly parted lips, soft and emotional tension, presenting 'subtle Oriental beauty'.

Styling Design:
Pink-toned gorgeous Tang-style clothing, softly fitting the body curves, rich layers but not over-stacked; moderate low-neck design emphasizing collarbone and neck-shoulder lines, natural visual guidance; exquisite phoenix crown (metal, pearls, gems, tassels), realistic material reflection, moving slightly with action.

Dynamics and Pose:
Slightly side-turned or lightly rotating posture, neck extension, shoulder lines stretched, hands forming soft guide lines, enhancing picture rhythm and feminine soft tension.

Lighting System:
Cinematic lighting. Key light: warm gold front-side light focusing on face and skin highlights. Fill light: cold ambient light shaping volume and space. Rim light outlining hair and neck silhouette. Highlights controlled without overexposure, shadows retaining details, soft transition of facial light and shadow.

Art Style:
Ultra-realistic CG portrait merged with Oriental freehand charm, slight hazy aesthetics.

Atmosphere and Texture:
Dreamy, subtle, high-end atmosphere of Oriental aesthetics; blurred background to weaken environment and strengthen character; slight film grain + soft focus glow to enhance emotion and texture.

Color System:
Main colors: rouge pink, gold. Auxiliary colors: cold blue-gray. Overall low saturation and high quality, avoiding gaudiness.

Lens parameters:
85mm portrait lens, f1.4–f2, shallow depth of field, cinematic framing.

Quality:
ultra detailed, 8K–16K, extreme detail, high resolution, cinematic lighting.

Aspect Ratio:
{argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"}

items.title: Dust-Drawn Symbol on Car Hood
items.titleZh: A photorealistic close-up of the hood of a dark blue or black car parked outdoors, covered in a thick layer of beige-brown dust and pollen. In the center of the hood, a large clean emblem-like shape has been finger-drawn through the dust, revealing the glossy paint underneath. The symbol is a circular logo with 8 segmented bars around a raised circular center: 1 wide curved segment across the top, 3 horizontal bar segments on the left side, 3 horizontal bar segments on the right side, and 1 wide angled segment across the bottom. A realistic adult human hand with dirty fingernails rests on the lower right area of the hood, as if it has just finished drawing the symbol. Show streaks, smudges, and finger-trace texture in the dust around the edges of the design. Include part of the windshield and 1 windshield wiper at the top left, with soft reflections of trees in the glass and paint. Background is a slightly blurred parking lot with sunlit pavement, curb, and 3 tree trunks. Warm late-afternoon natural lighting, shallow depth of field, high-detail automotive surface reflections, candid documentary-style composition, vertical smartphone photo framing.
items.promptZh: 一辆停在户外的深蓝色或黑色汽车引擎盖的逼真特写镜头，上面覆盖着一层厚厚的米棕色灰尘和花粉。在引擎盖的中央，用手指在灰尘中画出了一个大而干净的徽章状形状，露出了下面光滑的油漆。该符号是一个圆形标志，在凸起的圆形中心周围有 8 个分段条：顶部有 1 个宽弯曲段，左侧有 3 个水平条段，右侧有 3 个水平条段，底部有 1 个宽角段。一只指甲很脏的真实成年人手放在引擎盖的右下区域，就好像刚刚完成了符号的绘制一样。在设计边缘周围的灰尘中显示条纹、污迹和手指痕迹纹理。包括左上方的部分挡风玻璃和 1 个挡风玻璃刮水器，玻璃和油漆中树木的柔和反射。背景是一个稍微模糊的停车场，有阳光照射的人行道、路缘石和 3 个树干。温暖的午后自然光、浅景深、高细节的汽车表面反射、坦率的纪实风格构图、垂直的智能手机相框。

items.title: Steampunk ElectroVid Homepage
items.titleZh: A richly detailed steampunk-inspired vintage video platform homepage shown as a full-screen web interface mockup in dark brass, aged bronze, black iron, and sepia tones, designed like a Victorian industrial machine with ornate filigree, pipes, rivets, gears, gauges, and glowing Edison bulbs built into the frame. The top left shows a modern overlay logo reading Pollo AI and GPT Image 2. Centered across the top is a large engraved metal site title, {argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"}, with a smaller plaque subtitle reading {argument name="tagline text" default="THE FUTURE IN MOTION"}. A navigation bar directly beneath contains 6 visible items: a home icon button, TRENDING, INNOVATIONS, DOCUMENTARIES, ENTERTAINMENT, and a search box on the right with placeholder text similar to Search ElectroVid.... On the upper right corner of the frame there is 1 round analog clock gauge. On the left sidebar, a framed section titled Popular Channels contains exactly 3 channel cards stacked vertically, each with a circular emblem, subscriber count, and a SUBSCRIBE button: The Patent Office with 27.4K subscribers, The Royal Society with 18.7K subscribers, and General Electric with 35.1K subscribers. The main content area features 1 large central video player with a sepia historical scene of two men in suits debating in front of a chalkboard marked AC vs. DC with lightning-like chalk effects; one man points while the other gestures with open hands, and a glowing light bulb plus early electrical apparatus sit on the table between them. Add a realistic video player UI with a play button, timeline with partial red progress, volume icon, elapsed and total time reading 08:47 / 22:31, settings icon, theater icon, and fullscreen icon. Beneath the player, show the featured video title as {argument name="featured video title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}, with channel metadata below: The Electrical Age, 142K views, 3 days ago, plus a small circular profile portrait and a brass LIKE button showing 5.8K. Below that, a section header reading LATEST VIDEOS contains exactly 3 thumbnail cards in one row: 1) My New Incandescent Bulb, showing a man holding a lit bulb, duration 10:12, channel Thomas Edison, 89K views, 5 days ago; 2) The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower, showing a Tesla tower under electrical arcs, duration 15:36, channel Nikola Tesla, 120K views, 1 week ago; 3) The Automobile Revolution, showing an early vintage car with a driver on a city street, duration 12:08, channel Henry Ford, 110K views, 1 week ago. Centered below the thumbnails is a brass button reading VIEW ALL VIDEOS. At the bottom center, add a footer plaque reading © 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. All rights reserved. Decorate the outer border with additional pipes, cogs, mechanical joints, embossed corners, and 1 more circular pressure gauge near the bottom right. Use symmetrical, highly polished antique UI design, cinematic warm lighting, realistic texture, impeccable serif typography, dense ornamental craftsmanship, and a believable fusion of modern streaming layout with 19th-century industrial aesthetics.

items.title: Steampunk Vintage Video Platform UI
items.titleZh:
A highly detailed full-page steampunk video streaming website interface themed around the Victorian electrical age, designed like an antique brass-and-iron machine panel with dark bronze metal textures, rivets, pipes, gears, ornate filigree, glowing Edison bulbs, and sepia-toned imagery. At the top left, place a modern white logo reading "Pollo" with a small pink-red rounded badge containing "AI", and directly below it the text "GPT Image 2" in white, overlaid on the vintage interface. Center the header with a large embossed brass title reading "{argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"}" on a dark metal plaque, and a smaller engraved tagline underneath reading "{argument name="tagline" default="THE FUTURE IN MOTION"}". Add a horizontal navigation bar with exactly 5 items: a home icon, "TRENDING", "INNOVATIONS", "DOCUMENTARIES", and "ENTERTAINMENT", plus a search field on the right containing the placeholder text "Search ElectroVid..." and a square search button. In the upper right corner, include a round analog gauge or clock built into the frame.

Use a three-column vintage web layout. In the left sidebar, create a panel titled "POPULAR CHANNELS" containing exactly 3 circular channel emblems stacked vertically, each with a name, subscriber count, and a "SUBSCRIBE" button: 1) "THE PATENT OFFICE" with "27.4K SUBSCRIBERS", 2) "THE ROYAL SOCIETY" with "18.7K SUBSCRIBERS", 3) "GENERAL ELECTRIC" with "35.1K SUBSCRIBERS". The emblems should look heraldic and industrial, with aged metallic borders.

In the main content area, feature a large video player showing a dramatic sepia debate scene between two late-19th-century inventors in suits, facing each other across a table with electrical apparatus, a glowing bulb, and lightning on a chalkboard behind them reading "AC vs. DC". The left figure points accusingly; the right figure gestures back. Keep both faces obscured by soft rectangular blur blocks. Add a video control bar with a play button, progress bar, volume icon, timecode "08:47 / 22:31", settings icon, and fullscreen icon. Beneath the player, place the large serif video title "{argument name="main video title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}". Below that, show the channel row with a small circular avatar, the channel name "The Electrical Age", and metadata "142K views • 3 days ago". On the right side of this row, add a brass button reading "LIKE 5.8K".

Below the featured video, add a section header "LATEST VIDEOS" and exactly 3 video cards in one row. Card 1: a sepia thumbnail of a man holding up a glowing light bulb, face obscured by a blur block, duration label "10:12", title "My New Incandescent Bulb", creator "Thomas Edison", and metadata "89K views • 5 days ago". Card 2: a sepia thumbnail of a Wardenclyffe-style tower crackling with electricity, duration "15:36", title "The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower", creator "Nikola Tesla", and metadata "120K views • 1 week ago". Card 3: a sepia thumbnail of an early automobile on a city street, duration "12:08", title "The Automobile Revolution", creator "Henry Ford", and metadata "110K views • 1 week ago". Under the cards, center a brass button reading "VIEW ALL VIDEOS".

At the bottom, add a metal footer plaque with the text "© 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. All rights reserved." Surround the whole composition with decorative mechanical borders, exposed pipes, pressure gauges, cogs, corner ornaments, and warm amber lighting. The overall style should blend a YouTube-like video platform layout with a luxurious Victorian steampunk machine aesthetic, using dark brass, copper, blackened steel, parchment beige, and sepia photography, with crisp readable typography and a polished cinematic UI mockup look.
