使用三列复古网页布局。在左侧边栏中，创建一个标题为“流行频道”的面板，其中包含 3 个垂直堆叠的圆形频道标志，每个标志都有名称、订阅者数量和“订阅”按钮：1)“专利局”和“27.4K 订阅者”，2)“THE ROYAL SOCIETY”和“18.7K 订阅者”，3)“一般” ELECTRIC”，拥有“35,100 名订阅者”。标志应具有纹章和工业风格，并带有陈旧的金属边框。

在主要内容区域中，有一个大型视频播放器，展示了两位 19 世纪末身着西装的发明家之间戏剧性的深褐色辩论场景，他们隔着桌子面对面，桌上摆着电器、发光的灯泡，身后黑板上写着“交流电与直流电”的闪电。左图指责地指出；右图示意回来。让两张脸都被软矩形模糊块遮挡。添加视频控制栏，其中包含播放按钮、进度条、音量图标、时间码“08:47 / 22:31”、设置图标和全屏图标。在播放器下方，放置大衬线视频标题“{argument name="main video title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}”。在其下方，显示带有小圆形头像的频道行、频道名称“电气时代”和元数据“142K 观看次数• 3 天前”。在此行的右侧，添加一个黄铜按钮，上面写着“LIKE 5.8K”。

在特色视频下方，添加一个部分标题“最新视频”，并在一行中添加 3 个视频卡。卡 1：一个男人举着发光灯泡的深褐色缩略图，脸部被模糊块遮挡，持续时间标签“10:12”，标题“我的新白炽灯泡”，创建者“托马斯·爱迪生”，元数据“89K 次浏览• 5 天前”。卡 2：Wardenclyffe 风格塔的深褐色缩略图，电力噼啪作响，持续时间“15:36”，标题“Wardenclyffe 塔的奇迹”，创建者“Nikola Tesla”，元数据“12 万次浏览• 1 周前”。卡 3：城市街道上一辆早期汽车的深褐色缩略图，持续时间“12:08”，标题“汽车革命”，创建者“亨利·福特”，元数据“11 万次浏览• 1 周前”。在卡片下方，中间有一个黄铜按钮，上面写着“查看所有视频”。

在底部添加一个金属页脚牌，上面写有“© 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. 保留所有权利。”用装饰性机械边框、外露管道、压力表、齿轮、角落装饰品和温暖的琥珀色灯光包围整个构图。整体风格应将类似 YouTube 的视频平台布局与奢华的维多利亚蒸汽朋克机器美学融为一体，使用深色黄铜、红铜、黑钢、羊皮纸米色和棕褐色摄影，具有清晰易读的排版和精美的电影 UI 模型外观。

items.title: Vintage Korean Gimbap Recipe Poster
items.titleZh: Create a vintage Korean food poster infographic on aged beige parchment paper with worn texture, darkened edges, subtle stains, and an ornate traditional frame in muted green. The design is a single vertically stacked poster with 4 clearly separated sections and all text rendered sharply in Korean and English calligraphy. At the top, place a large ribbon banner with bold black Korean brush lettering reading "정통 한국 김밥" and a smaller ribbon subtitle reading "Traditional Korean Gimbap". In the upper-left corner, include a small modern badge that says "Pollo AI" and "GPT Image 2". The centerpiece of the top section is a large blue-and-white porcelain platter piled with exactly 12 sliced gimbap pieces, each showing white rice, yellow egg, orange carrot, green spinach, and dark seaweed wrapping, illustrated in a hand-drawn ink-and-watercolor style. To the right of the platter, add a small blue-and-white bowl of kimchi and a handwritten Korean note reading "간단해 보여도 정성이 들어간 한국의 맛!" with a small red heart, plus a small red seal stamp containing Korean characters. Add faint traditional landscape and floral ink painting details in the background, including a flowering branch on the left and misty mountains on the right. The second section is an ingredient row under a ribbon label reading "재료", showing exactly 6 numbered ingredients in separate compartments from left to right: 1. "김 (건김)" as a stack of dark seaweed sheets, 2. "밥 (양념 밥)" as a bowl of white rice, 3. "계란 (지단용)" as yellow egg strips on a plate, 4. "당근 (채썰어볶기)" as orange julienned carrots on a plate, 5. "시금치 (데쳐서 무치기)" as seasoned green spinach in a bowl, 6. "단무지 (김밥용)" as yellow pickled radish strips on a plate. The third section is a 6-panel step-by-step tutorial under a ribbon label reading "만드는 순서", arranged in two rows of three with arrows indicating flow. Panel 1 is labeled "1 밥 간하기" and shows a bowl of rice with a wooden spoon, a bottle of sesame oil, and salt, with caption "밥에 참기름 소금으로 간하기". Panel 2 is labeled "2 속재료 준비하기" and shows a cutting board with yellow egg strips, orange carrots, green spinach, and a knife, with caption "재료 볶아 속재료 준비하기". Panel 3 is labeled "3 김과 밥 펴기" and shows a bamboo mat with a seaweed sheet covered with white rice and a wooden rice paddle, with caption "김에 밥 얇게 펴기". Panel 4 is labeled "4 속재료 얹기" and shows the rice-covered seaweed with neat horizontal rows of yellow egg, orange carrot, and green spinach, with caption "속재료를 차례로 얹기". Panel 5 is labeled "5 단단하게 말기" and shows two hands rolling the bamboo mat tightly, with caption "김밥을 단단하게 말기". Panel 6 is labeled "6 썰어 완성하기" and shows a chef knife slicing a roll into pieces on a cutting board, with caption "먹기 좋게 썰어 완성!". At the bottom, add a wide banner with large expressive Korean brush calligraphy reading "정성 가득한 한 줄의 행복!" and a small red heart, surrounded by floral decorations and a red square seal with the character "福". Overall style: traditional Korean folk poster mixed with cookbook infographic, detailed pen-and-ink outlines, watercolor fills, warm sepia palette, nostalgic handmade print aesthetic, balanced composition, crisp legible typography, highly accurate Korean text rendering.

items.title: Detailed multilingual Chinese manga prompt
items.titleZh:
Generate a full color Chinese-text manga about this {argument name="character" default="OpenAI researcher, Chen Boyuan"} (first picture), who works on improving the text rendering capability of ChatGPT Image 2 model for the upcoming release. (in the background there is boba tea and a banana taped to the wall with a single slice of duct tape). The model can render insanely small Chinese text when he tried generating some detailed and beautiful multilingual infographics handdrawn-style poster about his hometown, {argument name="location" default="Wuxi"} on his computer screen. His hard work pays off and the team was impressed by the absurdly good quality of multilingual text performance of his model, seeing all the languages it can write. When he takes a break with one hand holding his phone, he received a translated text message from Sam Altman on his phone (avatar attached as second picture), asking him to take a look at the rendered multilingual text in an image he just generated to congrat the team, since Sam only knows English. However, make it funny by let Boyuan outrage (typical manga style) at the end by seeing Sam's generated image contains a "稳稳地接住你" phrase at the central location in an otherwise perfectly rendered image that's used to congrat the team, because this sentence has been memed as an unnatural but funny Chinese sentence GPT likes to use on Chinese internet. Boyuan should rage "God! It learned to 'catch' again!" (with teammates as tiny heads on the side, sweating and saying in Chinese "we are working hard to fix it!"). At the very bottom of the manga, add a tiny line of footnote (very tiny)in Chinese that "note: the entire manga, including this footnote and picture in picture, are all generated with gpt image 2 at once without editing or multiple steps."

Additional Instructions: Use vertical 1440x2560 image layout, with first row about this researcher working hard, second row about his result on {argument name="location" default="Wuxi"} with multiple languages, third row shows the team excitement, fourth row split into left and right where left shows he takes a break and the phone received a message, right panel shows Sam's text message, and fifth row shows Sam's picture and Chen Boyuan's reaction. No narration except for the first row. Avoid Chinese map. All characters should be in manga style. The banana background should only appear in the first panel and the tape should be a single slice of tape, not a cross tape. The banana and tape decoration should be small as a insignificant easter egg for people to find. OpenAI logo shall only appear on Chen Boyuan's cloth, not elsewhere. No mugs in the scene since we already have the boba. Sam should only appear in the text message panel. The entire manga should be appear as a professional photo of a physical page in a manga book. In the lower right most corner of the poster there is a small "Ultra-small Chinese is also clearly readable:" with a paragraph of much smaller Chinese that begins with "(This is an ultra-small font size test) Wuxi is the author's hometown, so I made this poster, and the Chinese is finally fixed. Haven't been home for many years, really want to eat hairy crabs!" (ultra small).

items.title: Steampunk ElectroVid Homepage
items.titleZh: Create a full-page steampunk video platform homepage mockup in a dark antique bronze, brass, and sepia palette, styled like a Victorian industrial version of YouTube. The interface should be vertically oriented like a poster or website screenshot, richly decorated with gears, pipes, engraved metal borders, filigree, gauges, screws, and glowing Edison bulbs. At the top left, place a modern overlay logo reading "Pollo AI" with smaller text "GPT Image 2" beneath it. Center the main site title in large ornate serif lettering: "{argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"}", with a smaller engraved tagline below: "{argument name="tagline" default="THE FUTURE IN MOTION"}". Add a horizontal navigation bar under the title with exactly 6 items: a home icon button, "TRENDING", "INNOVATIONS", "DOCUMENTARIES", "ENTERTAINMENT", and a search box on the right showing the placeholder "Search ElectroVid..." and a search icon. On the left sidebar, add a section titled "POPULAR CHANNELS" containing exactly 3 vertically stacked channel cards with circular emblems and subscribe buttons: 1) "THE PATENT OFFICE" with "27.4K SUBSCRIBERS", 2) "THE ROYAL SOCIETY" with "18.7K SUBSCRIBERS", 3) "GENERAL ELECTRIC" with "35.1K SUBSCRIBERS". Each card should have an ornate vintage badge logo and a rectangular button labeled "SUBSCRIBE". In the main content area, place one large featured video player with a sepia still image of two late-19th-century inventors in suits arguing in front of a chalkboard marked "AC vs. DC" with lightning motifs; one man points while the other gestures back, and a light bulb plus early electrical apparatus sit on the table between them. Intentionally obscure both faces with soft rectangular blur blocks. Add a video progress bar, playback controls, and timestamp "08:47 / 22:31". Beneath the player, show the video title "{argument name="featured title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}". Below that, include a channel row with a circular avatar, the channel name "The Electrical Age", metadata "142K views • 3 days ago", and on the right a like button reading "LIKE" with count "5.8K". Under this, add a section header "LATEST VIDEOS" and exactly 3 video thumbnails in one row. Thumbnail 1: a sepia portrait of Thomas Edison holding a glowing bulb, face obscured with a blur block, duration "10:12", title "My New Incandescent Bulb", creator "Thomas Edison", metadata "89K views • 5 days ago". Thumbnail 2: a dramatic sepia image of the Wardenclyffe Tower under lightning, duration "15:36", title "The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower", creator "Nikola Tesla", metadata "120K views • 1 week ago". Thumbnail 3: a sepia photo of an early automobile with Henry Ford seated in it, duration "12:08", title "The Automobile Revolution", creator "Henry Ford", metadata "110K views • 1 week ago". Below the thumbnails, add a centered metal button labeled "VIEW ALL VIDEOS". At the bottom footer, include the text "© 1893 {argument name="company name" default="ElectroVid, Ltd."}" on one line and "All rights reserved." on the next. items.title: Visual Polyglot Magazine Collage
items.titleZh: I am creating a magazine page with the theme of "visual polyglot". The title in the center of the image should be "{argument name="title" default="Create Everything at Once"}". Create a piece of art celebrating visual creations, not limited to beautiful photographs but also across the full breadth of human visual culture and natural visual elements. There should be curated collage representing the diverse distribution: scientific diagrams, the periodic table, the solar system, medieval manuscript pages, botanical illustrations, anatomical drawings, old maps, climate charts, engineering schematics, transit signage, multilingual text, comic panels, UI screenshots, a camera photo, a butterfly specimen, pie charts, architectural blueprints, and façade drawings. The text frames the model as fluent across languages, notation systems, interfaces, cultural forms, and visual conventions—able to move from utility to beauty, from document understanding to artistic generation. Also feature artistic elements like pixel art, styles, history, sculpture, nature, photography, paintings, and all art forms. These are just examples, I need you to actively think about other elements / styles that may fit in a good design that's not limited to these concepts. The overall effect is that of a premium research announcement or museum-style manifesto: elegant, ambitious, and designed to argue that image intelligence should be trained on the whole visual world, not just polished aesthetics. Use an unstructured, creative and artistic layout, such as but not limited to fan out, avoid grid-like layouts. Portrait 4:5 aspect ratio. Don't add any content text beside the "Create Everything at Once" title. Text as part of the art is okay. Avoid a beige tint of the overall style, since we want vibrant elements to be vibrant.
items.promptZh: 我正在创建一个主题为“视觉多语言”的杂志页面。图像中心的标题应为“{argument name="title" default="Create Everything at Once"}”。创作一件庆祝视觉创作的艺术作品，不仅限于美丽的照片，还涵盖人类视觉文化和自然视觉元素的全部内容。应该有代表不同分布的精选拼贴画：科学图表、元素周期表、太阳系、中世纪手稿页、植物插图、解剖图、旧地图、气候图、工程示意图、交通标牌、多语言文本、漫画面板、用户界面屏幕截图、相机照片、蝴蝶标本、饼图、建筑蓝图和立面图。文本将模型构建为跨语言、符号系统、界面、文化形式和视觉惯例的流畅性——能够从实用转向美观，从文档理解转向艺术生成。还具有像素艺术、风格、历史、雕塑、自然、摄影、绘画和所有艺术形式等艺术元素。这些只是示例，我需要您积极思考可能适合良好设计的其他元素/样式，而不仅限于这些概念。整体效果就像一份高级研究公告或博物馆风格的宣言：优雅、雄心勃勃，旨在论证图像智能应该在整个视觉世界上进行训练，而不仅仅是精美的美学。使用非结构化、创造性和艺术性的布局，例如但不限于扇出，避免网格状布局。纵向 4:5 宽高比。不要在“一次创建所有内容”标题旁边添加任何内容文本。文字作为艺术的一部分是可以的。避免整体风格采用米色，因为我们希望充满活力的元素充满活力。

items.title: Monochrome Tennis Streetwear Moodboard
items.titleZh: A clean editorial fashion concept board on a pale powder-blue background with a minimalist green monochrome palette, combining 4 full-body lifestyle photos of the same youth streetwear tennis-inspired character arranged in a horizontal layout. On the far left, a tall vertical photo panel partially overlaps the background, showing a standing model in an oversized light gray-blue Nike windbreaker, mint green shorts, white crew socks, and white sneakers, holding a white tennis racket at their side and a small mint towel or accessory in the other hand. The character’s head is replaced by a large white doodle coffee-cup face icon with a smiling expression and ruler-like tick marks across the top rim. To the right are 3 rounded-rectangle photo panels, evenly spaced. In panel 1, the model sits in a folding chair reading a magazine and holding a green mug, with a dark Nike duffel bag on the floor and a few scattered cups nearby; the white doodle cup head has 2 steam squiggles rising above it. In panel 2, the model stands beside a pyramid made of approximately 28 stacked green and white paper cups, one arm resting on the top; they wear a soft green Nike T-shirt and shorts set, white socks, and white sneakers; a small white typographic logo in the upper left reads like a cafe or service-court brand mark. The doodle cup head here is a simple smiling cup with a wide rim. In panel 3, the model leans casually with crossed legs, holding a green cup, next to a small wire cart containing green tennis balls and topped with a retro CRT television; they wear a white polo shirt, mint shorts, white socks, and white sneakers. The doodle cup head in this panel has horizontal stripe bands across the top. Keep all faces fully replaced by the graphic cup icons, with no real facial features visible. Use a soft studio setup, flat even lighting, subtle shadows, matte textures, and a highly consistent mint, sage, olive, and white color story. Add thin white horizontal guide lines across the blue background near the top and bottom. Place small gray editorial footer text at the bottom: on the left, “{argument name="left footer text" default="MJ REFERENCE"}”; on the right, “{argument name="right footer text" default="KREA // GPT 2"}”. items.title: Minimalist AI Fashion Comparison Board
items.titleZh: A minimalist fashion moodboard on a pale sage green background, laid out as a wide horizontal comparison sheet with four portrait panels of young male models wearing oversized white sports T-shirts. Use a soft editorial studio look with cool periwinkle-blue backdrops inside the portrait frames, subtle film grain, muted contrast, and a highly consistent color palette of sage green, cyan trim, off-white, deep shadow, and blue-lavender. On the far left, include 1 large cropped reference portrait that is partially cut off by the canvas edge, showing the left side of a dark-skinned male model’s shaved or closely buzzed head, ear, jawline, neck, and shoulder in profile, wearing a white shirt with a bright aqua ribbed collar; place 2 overlapping semi-opaque rectangular blocks over the face area, creating a graphic censorship/collage effect. To the right, place 3 rounded-corner portrait cards in a row, evenly spaced, each featuring a different young male model from the chest up against the same blue studio background: card 1 shows a light- to medium-skinned man with short slicked-back dark hair, facing slightly left, wearing a white athletic shirt with aqua collar trim and a small Nike swoosh on the lower right chest; card 2 shows a light-skinned man with medium dark hair swept back, turned three-quarters left, wearing a white Nike shirt with a black swoosh centered on the chest; card 3 shows a dark-skinned man with a short fade haircut, turned three-quarters right, wearing a white Adidas shirt with a cyan Adidas logo centered on the chest and a small hoop or cross earring. Add 3 face-obscuring gradient rectangles, one over each smaller portrait face, in dark green fading to gray-green, aligned vertically like graphic overlays. Include 2 thin horizontal divider lines across the full composition, one near the top and one near the lower third, in a slightly lighter sage tone. At the bottom, add small uppercase monospaced editorial text: near the lower center-left write "MJ REFERENCE" and near the lower right write "KREA  //  GPT 2". items.promptZh: 淡鼠尾草绿色背景上的简约时尚情绪板，布局为宽水平比较表，其中有四个穿着超大白色运动 T 恤的年轻男模特的肖像面板。使用柔和的编辑工作室外观，肖像框架内有凉爽的长春花蓝色背景，微妙的胶片颗粒，柔和的对比度，以及高度一致的鼠尾草绿、青色镶边、灰白色、深阴影和蓝紫色调色板。最左边包括一张被画布边缘部分切掉的大型裁剪参考肖像，展示了深色皮肤男模特的左侧剃光或剃光的头部、耳朵、下巴、颈部和肩膀的轮廓，穿着一件带有明亮水绿色罗纹领的白色衬衫；将 2 个重叠的半透明矩形块放置在面部区域上，创建图形审查/拼贴效果。在右侧，将 3 张圆角肖像卡排成一排，间隔均匀，每张都有一个不同的年轻男性模特，从胸部到胸部，在相同的蓝色工作室背景下：卡 1 展示了一个浅色到中等肤色的男性，留着向后梳的深色短发，面朝左，穿着一件带有水领饰边的白色运动衬衫，右下胸口有一个小 Nike 旋风；卡 2 展示了一名浅肤色男子，中等深色头发向后梳，左转四分之三，身穿白色耐克衬衫，胸前有一个黑色旋风图案；图 3 显示的是一名深色皮肤的男子，留着褪色短发，右转四分之三，身穿白色阿迪达斯衬衫，胸口中央有青色阿迪达斯标志，戴着小圈形或十字耳环。添加 3 个面部模糊渐变矩形，每个较小的人像面部各有一个，颜色为深绿色渐变为灰绿色，垂直对齐，就像图形叠加一样。在整个构图中包括 2 条细水平分隔线，一条靠近顶部，一条靠近下三分之一，颜色略淡的鼠尾草色调。在底部，添加小的大写等宽编辑文本：靠近下中左写“MJ REFERENCE”，靠近右下写“KREA // GPT 2”。整体图像应该感觉像一个优质的人工智能时尚比较板、图形设计演示或概念一致性表，具有干净的间距、平坦的背景和精美的艺术指导。

items.title: Japanese Eco-Community Promo Poster
items.titleZh: A polished Japanese promotional poster for a community and sustainability project called {argument name="project name" default="セカイムラ"}, designed like a premium eco-lifestyle campaign flyer. Vertical layout, clean and elegant, with a soft cream paper background and a luminous, aspirational mood. The top half is dominated by a giant translucent globe centered in the composition, glowing with warm sunrise light from the upper right. Inside the globe is a breathtaking aerial landscape of a green mountain valley opening to a calm blue bay or lake, with tiny villages and fields below, cinematic and utopian. Over the globe, place a smaller Japanese slogan line reading {argument name="tagline text" default="世界は1つの村になる。"} and beneath it the large main title in bold dark navy Japanese calligraphic lettering: {argument name="main title text" default="セカイムラ"}. Around the globe, create a collage of exactly 8 candid lifestyle photos fading into the edges: 1) top left, two people in conversation outdoors under trees; 2) upper left-mid, several people working together in a rice paddy; 3) left middle, a circle gathering inside a rustic wooden structure at night; 4) lower left, two portrait-style figures in nature; 5) top right, a group sharing a meal at a long table in warm indoor light; 6) right middle, a person tending plants or crops; 7) right lower-mid, a line of people holding hands on a ridge at sunset; 8) lower right, a close portrait of a person eating or holding food. The photographic style should feel human, communal, slightly idealized, with soft depth of field, natural skin tones, golden-hour highlights, and smooth ad-poster compositing. The bottom half contains 3 evenly spaced feature cards on a light cream background, separated by subtle vertical dividers. Card 1 on the left has the heading "セカイムラ 新月会" in dark blue, a circular photo of a nighttime campfire circle, and a short block of Japanese descriptive text below. Card 2 in the center has the heading "セカイムラ 満月会" in warm gold, a circular photo of an indoor evening gathering under string lights, decorative radiating sunburst lines around the circle, and a short block of Japanese descriptive text below. Card 3 on the right has the heading "セカイムラ 米部が今の一押し" in green, small rice plant illustrations near the title, a circular photo of a wooden bowl of white rice, and a short block of Japanese descriptive text below. Under these cards, add a centered Japanese statement line in dark blue: {argument name="footer slogan" default="人・自然・文化がつながり、循環する未来を一緒につくる。"}. Beneath that, place 4 small icon-and-text items in a horizontal row, each with a simple thin-line icon and two-line Japanese label: 1) people icon with "つながる 仲間と出会える"; 2) house icon with "まなぶ 暮らしを学べる"; 3) sprout icon with "つくる 未来を共につくる"; 4) globe icon with "ひろがる 世界にひろげる". At the very bottom center, include a circular logo mark followed by the project name in Japanese, and underneath a website URL: {argument name="website URL" default="www.sekaimura.com"}. Add a small QR code at the bottom right with tiny Japanese text indicating details are on the website. Use a refined palette of deep navy, forest green, gold, cream, and sky blue. Overall style: high-end Japanese nonprofit poster, eco-community branding, inspirational, harmonious, photoreal collage with subtle graphic design elements, balanced typography, soft glows, and magazine-quality print finish.

items.title: Minimalist Anime Portrait with Censored Face
items.titleZh: A clean minimalist anime portrait of a young woman from the chest up, centered in frame, with her face fully obscured by a large vertical soft-edged gray rectangle covering the entire facial area as a censorship block. She has very long flowing hair split into two tones, with deep navy blue on one side and pale silver-gray on the other, the strands sweeping outward as if moved by a gentle breeze. Add a few thin coral-pink accent streaks in the hair. She wears a high-collared, structured off-white coat or uniform jacket with a dark navy inner collar panel and two small gold buttons, giving a sleek modern sci-fi fashion feel. Her visible skin is pale, and one ear shows a tiny stud earring. Use a flat, elegant illustration style with smooth vector-like shading, no heavy texture, and a restrained pastel palette dominated by powder blue, cream, navy, and coral pink. items.title: Steampunk ElectroVid Video Platform UI
items.titleZh:
A highly detailed full-screen steampunk video-streaming website interface in a dark bronze, brass, and sepia color palette, designed like an antique Victorian industrial dashboard. The page is framed by ornate metal borders, rivets, pipes, gears, pressure gauges, and glowing Edison bulbs, with rich engraved textures and warm low-key lighting. At the top left, a modern white and red brand mark reads "Pollo AI" with smaller white text "GPT Image 2" beneath it, overlaid on the interface. Centered across the top is a large embossed brass title plaque reading "ElectroVid" with a smaller engraved tagline below, "THE FUTURE IN MOTION". A horizontal navigation bar sits under the title with exactly 6 items: a home icon button, "TRENDING", "INNOVATIONS", "DOCUMENTARIES", "ENTERTAINMENT", and a search field showing placeholder text "Search ElectroVid..." followed by a search icon. On the upper right, include 1 round vintage gauge dial built into the metal frame.

The main content area is split into 2 columns. The left sidebar is a framed panel titled "POPULAR CHANNELS" containing exactly 3 stacked channel cards, each with a circular emblem, a channel name, subscriber count, and a brass subscribe button labeled "SUBSCRIBE". Card 1: emblem with an eagle seal, channel name "THE PATENT OFFICE", subscriber text "27.4K SUBSCRIBERS". Card 2: emblem with a royal crest, channel name "THE ROYAL SOCIETY", subscriber text "18.7K SUBSCRIBERS". Card 3: blue circular GE-style logo, channel name "GENERAL ELECTRIC", subscriber text "35.1K SUBSCRIBERS".

The large central featured video panel has an ornate metal frame and shows a sepia historical scene of two famous inventors in suits debating in front of a chalkboard marked "AC vs. DC" with lightning illustrations. Their faces are obscured by 2 soft rectangular blur blocks, one over each face. Add an old-film, archival-photo look. Along the bottom of the video frame, show a player control bar with exactly 7 visible UI elements: play icon, volume icon, red progress bar, timestamp "08:47 / 22:31", settings gear, small rectangle screen icon, and fullscreen icon. Beneath the video, show the title "The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate". Below that, display channel metadata with a small circular avatar, channel name "The Electrical Age", and stats text "142K views • 3 days ago". On the right side of this metadata row, place a brass like button labeled "LIKE" with count "5.8K".

Below, add a section header "LATEST VIDEOS" above exactly 3 thumbnail cards in one row. Card 1: title "My New Incandescent Bulb", thumbnail of a man holding a glowing bulb with his face obscured by 1 blur block, duration label "10:12", creator "Thomas Edison", stats "89K views • 5 days ago". Card 2: title "The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower", thumbnail of a dramatic Tesla tower under lightning, duration "15:36", creator "Nikola Tesla", stats "120K views • 1 week ago". Card 3: title "The Automobile Revolution", thumbnail of an early automobile with driver in a city street, duration "12:08", creator "Henry Ford", stats "110K views • 1 week ago". Under the thumbnails, add a centered brass button reading "VIEW ALL VIDEOS".

At the bottom center, include a footer plaque with the text "© 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. All rights reserved.". Add additional decorative machinery in the corners and edges, including exposed pipes, cogs, filigree, and 1 more round gauge near the bottom right. The whole composition should feel like a believable antique YouTube homepage reimagined as a Victorian steampunk invention, with crisp readable typography, symmetrical layout, parchment panels, embossed brass UI components, and cinematic sepia contrast.
items.promptZh:
一个非常详细的全屏蒸汽朋克视频流网站界面，采用深青铜色、黄铜色和棕褐色调色板，设计得像古董维多利亚时代的工业仪表板。该页面由华丽的金属边框、铆钉、管道、齿轮、压力表和发光的爱迪生灯泡构成，具有丰富的雕刻纹理和温暖低调的灯光。在左上角，现代的白色和红色品牌标记写着“Pollo AI”，其下方有较小的白色文字“GPT Image 2”，覆盖在界面上。顶部中央是一个巨大的浮雕黄铜标题牌，上面写着“ElectroVid”，下面刻着一个较小的标语“THE FUTURE IN MOTION”。标题下方有一个水平导航栏，其中包含 6 个项目：主页图标按钮、“趋势”、“创新”、“文档”、“娱乐”，以及一个显示占位符文本“搜索 ElectroVid...”的搜索字段，后跟一个搜索图标。在右上角，包括 1 个内置于金属框架中的圆形复古仪表盘。

主要内容区域分为两栏。左侧边栏是一个标题为“流行频道”的框架面板，其中包含 3 个堆叠的频道卡，每个频道卡都有一个圆形标志、频道名称、订阅者数量和标有“订阅”的黄铜订阅按钮。卡 1：带有鹰印章的徽章，频道名称“THE PATENT OFFICE”，订阅者文本“27.4K SUBSCRIBERS”。卡 2：带有皇家徽章的徽章，频道名称“THE ROYAL SOCIETY”，订阅者文本“18.7K SUBSCRIBERS”。卡 3：蓝色圆形 GE 风格徽标，频道名称“GENERAL ELECTRIC”，订阅者文本“35.1K SUBSCRIBERS”。

中央的大型视频面板有一个华丽的金属框架，展示了两位穿着西装的著名发明家在一块标有“AC vs. DC”和闪电插图的黑板前辩论的深褐色历史场景。他们的脸被 2 个柔软的矩形模糊块遮挡，每张脸上各有一个。添加老电影、档案照片的外观。沿着视频帧的底部，显示一个播放器控制栏，其中包含 7 个可见的 UI 元素：播放图标、音量图标、红色进度条、时间戳“08:47 / 22:31”、设置齿轮、小矩形屏幕图标和全屏图标。视频下方显示标题“AC 与 DC 的真相：最后的辩论”。在其下方，显示带有小圆形头像的频道元数据、频道名称“电气时代”和统计文本“142K 观看次数• 3 天前”。在此元数据行的右侧，放置一个类似黄铜的按钮，标记为“LIKE”，计数为“5.8K”。

下面，在一行中的 3 个缩略图卡上方添加一个节标题“最新视频”。卡 1：标题“我的新白炽灯泡”，一个男人拿着发光灯泡的缩略图，他的脸被 1 个模糊块遮挡，持续时间标签“10:12”，创建者“托马斯·爱迪生”，统计数据“89K 次浏览• 5 天前”。卡 2：标题“Wardenclyffe 塔的奇观”，闪电下戏剧性的特斯拉塔的缩略图，持续时间“15:36”，创建者“Nikola Tesla”，统计数据“1 周前 12 万次浏览”。卡 3：标题“汽车革命”，城市街道上有司机的早期汽车的缩略图，持续时间“12:08”，创建者“亨利·福特”，统计数据“1 周前 11 万次浏览”。在缩略图下方，添加一个居中的黄铜按钮，上面写着“查看所有视频”。

在底部中心，包括一个页脚牌，上面写着“© 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. 保留所有权利。”。在角落和边缘添加额外的装饰机械，包括裸露的管道、齿轮、金银丝和右下角附近的 1 个圆形仪表。整个构图应该感觉像是一个可信的古董 YouTube 主页，被重新想象为维多利亚时代的蒸汽朋克发明，具有清晰易读的排版、对称布局、羊皮纸面板、浮雕黄铜 UI 组件和电影棕褐色对比。

items.titleZh:
A cinematic high resolution action portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young man riding a modern motocross dirt bike"} across {argument name="setting" default="rough rocky terrain during golden hour sunset"}. He is leaning aggressively forward while turning, showing focus and intensity on his face. He has messy windswept dark hair, light stubble, sharp jawline, athletic build, wearing a fitted black compression t shirt, dark cargo pants, black motocross gloves with orange details, and black racing boots with orange accents.

Strong sunlight creates dramatic rim lighting around the rider and bike, with rich shadows and warm highlights.
Foreground has textured gravel, dirt, scattered stones, motion debris, sharp ground detail. Shot from a low angle for a heroic powerful perspective. Shallow depth of field keeps the rider sharp while background remains creamy and cinematic.

这辆自行车是一款时尚的哑光黑色和灰色越野越野车，配有精致的悬架、坚固的多节轮胎、可见的发动机零件、逼真的泥浆飞溅、旋转的车轮以及后轮胎飞扬的灰尘。捕捉骑手的动态能量和速度。

前景有纹理的砾石、泥土、散落的石头、运动碎片、尖锐的地面细节。从低角度拍摄，呈现出英雄般的强大视角。浅景深使骑手保持敏锐，而背景则保持奶油色和电影感。

items.title: Hand-drawn Infographic Card Prompt
items.titleZh:
Create a hand-drawn style infographic card with a 9:16 vertical aspect ratio. The card has a clear theme and the background is beige or off-white with a paper texture. The overall design reflects a simple and friendly hand-drawn aesthetic.

The top of the card features a large brush cursive font in alternating red and black with sharp contrast to highlight the title and attract visual focus. The text content is all in Chinese cursive, and the overall layout is divided into 2 to 4 clear sections, each using short, concise Chinese phrases to express core points. The font maintains the smooth rhythm of cursive, being both legible and artistic.

The card is dotted with simple, fun hand-drawn illustrations or icons, such as characters or symbolic signs, to enhance visual appeal and trigger thought and resonance in the reader. The overall layout pays attention to visual balance, reserving enough white space to ensure the image is concise, clear, and easy to read and understand.

The theme is: "{argument name="theme content" default="Building an IP is long-term compound interest. Keep setting up your stall every day, keep doing it, and there will definitely be results, because 99% of people can't stick to it."}"
items.prompt:
创作一张手绘风格的信息图卡片，比例为9:16竖版。卡片主题鲜明，背景为带有纸质肌理的米色或米白色，整体设计体现质朴、亲切的手绘美感。

卡片上方以红黑相间、对比鲜明的大号毛笔草书字体突出标题，吸引视觉焦点。文字内容均采用中文草书，整体布局分为2至4个清晰的小节，每节以简短、精炼的中文短语表达核心要点。字体保持草书流畅的韵律感，既清晰可读又富有艺术气息。

卡片中点缀简单、有趣的手绘插画或图标，例如人物或象征符号，以增强视觉吸引力，引发读者思考与共鸣。整体布局注意视觉平衡，预留足够的空白空间，确保画面简洁明了，易于阅读和理解。

主题是：“{argument name="主题内容" default="做IP是长期复利，坚持每日出摊，持续做，肯定会有结果，因为99%都坚持不住的。"}”

items.title: Japanese Hospital Comedy DVD Cover
items.titleZh: A photorealistic Japanese DVD cover styled like a commercial live-action comedy-thriller release, shot vertically with glossy retail packaging design. The cover shows a hospital room interior with soft beige walls, a bed, curtains on the right, and subtle medical fixtures in the background. In the center foreground, 1 seated young Japanese woman in a loose light-blue hospital gown sits on a bed, looking confused and vulnerable. Around her stand 3 young Japanese female medical staff: 2 nurses in pale pink uniforms with matching nurse caps and ID badges, and 1 doctor in a white coat with a stethoscope. Each of the 3 standing women is holding up a smartphone toward the camera, and each phone screen shows the seated woman’s face or body as if her consciousness has been transferred into their devices, creating a body-jack possession theme. The overall tone is playful, absurd, and slightly eerie, like a Japanese idol movie or hospital comedy DVD jacket. Use a polished magazine-quality layout with bold Japanese typography and colorful pop graphics. At the very top, place a small blue publisher logo on the left reading {argument name="studio name" default="DRILL PRESENTS"} with a heart icon, and a blue DVD VIDEO logo on the top right. Across the top center, add a pink Japanese banner line reading "シリーズ最新作！". Below it, make the main title huge, rounded, glossy, and bubbly in pink and blue Japanese text: {argument name="main title" default="ボディジャック"}. Under the title, add a pink subtitle in Japanese: {argument name="subtitle" default="～私のカラダ、乗っ取られました～"}. Add 3 comic-style speech bubbles near the upper characters: one saying "あなたのカラダ、私たちが使わせてもらうわね", one saying "これで私たちの思い通り♡", and 1 yellow startled reaction near the seated woman that reads "?!". On the left spine area, create a white vertical strip with blue and pink Japanese text repeating the title and subtitle, plus a small pink circle label reading "新作". At the bottom center, place a large flashy Japanese catchphrase in mixed pink, blue, white, and yellow outlined lettering: "人気アイドルのカラダと魂をめぐる、ドタバタ病院コメディ！" with small stars and heart doodles around it. On the lower right, add a blue circular burst with yellow and white Japanese text: "笑って、ドキドキ！悪ノリ注意の病院乗っ取り大作戦♡". Along the bottom edge, include exactly 4 small rectangular preview stills from the film, each bordered like DVD scene thumbnails, showing the same hospital characters in slightly different poses; add short Japanese captions on each thumbnail, including lines similar to "計画はバッチリ！", "え…どういうこと…？", "さあ、始めましょうか♡", and "助けて…私のカラダ…！". In the lower left margin include DVD package metadata in black text such as catalog number "DBJ-002", duration "120min.", "COLOR", and price "¥3,980 (税抜)", plus a small blue-and-pink DRILL logo. Bright retail-ready composition, realistic people, commercial Japanese movie jacket aesthetics, slightly campy, high-resolution, clean print design.

items.title: Out the Window meme comic prompt
items.titleZh:
Create an "{argument name="meme style" default="Out the Window"}" meme-style four-panel comic titled "{argument name="title" default="How to Improve Development Efficiency with AI? 如何借助 AI 提升开发效率？"}", featuring dialogues in speech bubbles. 

--ar 9:16

Characters:

- Boss: Asian male wearing a suit, with neatly parted hair.
- Employee Xiaoming: Male, wearing a blue checkered shirt.
- Employee Xiaohong: Female.
- Employee Xiaohu: Female, Asian, straight bangs hairstyle, wearing red-framed glasses.

Panel Descriptions:

- Top panel (single wide panel):
  The boss asks during a meeting: "How can we use AI to improve development efficiency? 我们要如何借助 AI 提升开发效率？"

  Three employees sit listening.

- Second panel (single wide panel):
  Each employee responds individually:

  - Xiaoming: "We use AI to write unit tests. 我们用 AI 写单元测试"
  - Xiaohong: "We use AI for code reviews. 我们用 AI 做代码审查"
  - Xiaohu: “Vibe Coding。”

- Third row (two panels):
  - Left panel: The boss looks furious.
  - Right panel: Employee Xiaohu is humorously kicked out of a high-rise window.

items.title: Minimalist Cinematic Vertical Poster with Character Reference
items.titleZh:
Using the attached character, generate the following:

# Instructions
Create a minimalist theater-style vertical poster for {argument name="user input" default="[user input]"} using monochrome + {argument name="accent color" default="one accent color"}.

# Layout Requirements
- Place the title largely in the bottom 1/4 area, with the Japanese title at maximum size and the English subtitle small directly underneath.
- Place a catchphrase (1-2 lines) in the top center.
- Stack 3-4 awards/official certification badges vertically in the top-left corner.
- Place a vertical catchphrase (2-3 lines) along the right edge.
- Position the main character as a silhouette from behind, slightly left of the center.
- Represent fantastical elements (floating islands, giant creatures) in the background as silhouettes.
- Place staff credits, release date, and distribution info in a small horizontal line at the bottom.
- Highlight the release date in a large font at the bottom right.

# Design Requirements
- Keep the background monochrome (black to gray gradient).
- Use only one accent color (e.g., vivid cobalt blue or gold).
- Combine silhouette and thin line art styles.
- Emphasize the title text with white + the accent color.
- Create a cinematic and artistic atmosphere overall.
- Avoid colorful backgrounds, excessive decoration, or heavy use of gradients.
- Format: Vertical, aspect ratio 2:3, high resolution.
items.prompt:
添付のキャラを使い、以下を生成

# 指示
{argument name="ユーザー入力" default="[ユーザーが入力]"}について、モノクロ＋{argument name="アクセントカラー" default="1アクセントカラー"}のミニマルシアター系縦型ポスターを作成せよ。

# レイアウト要件
・タイトルは画面下部1/4エリアに大きく配置し、和文タイトルを最大サイズ・英文サブタイトルを小さく直下に添える
・上部中央にキャッチコピー（短文1〜2行）を配置する
・左上コーナーに受賞歴・公式認定バッジを縦積みで3〜4点並べる
・右端縦方向に縦書きキャッチコピー（2〜3行）を配置する
・画面中央やや左寄りにメインキャラクターを後ろ姿でシルエット的に立たせる
・背景には幻想的な要素（浮遊する島・巨大生物）をシルエットで表現する
・最下部に制作スタッフクレジット・公開日・配給情報を小さく横並びで配置する
・公開日は右下に大きなフォントで目立たせる

# デザイン要件
・背景はモノクロ（黒〜グレーグラデーション）で統一する
・アクセントカラーは1色のみ（例：鮮やかなコバルトブルーまたはゴールド）
・イラストスタイルはシルエット＋細いラインアートの組み合わせ
・タイトル文字はホワイト＋アクセントカラーで強調する
・全体的にシネマティック・アーティスティックな雰囲気を演出する
・カラフルな背景・過度な装飾・グラデーション多用は避ける
・フォーマット：縦型、アスペクト比 2:3（例：800×1200px）、高解像度

items.title: Geometric Bird Riding Bicycle
items.titleZh: A minimalist flat vector illustration on a light gray background showing a whimsical bird riding a bicycle, built entirely from simple geometric shapes with thick black outlines. The bicycle is a black line-drawn road bike in side view facing left, with 2 large wheels, each wheel divided by a vertical and horizontal spoke cross, a simple triangular frame, a small black saddle, pedals, and a thin black ground line running horizontally beneath the bike. The rider is a stylized white bird with a large round body, a smaller round head, a pointed orange beak opened wide, and a pink lower beak interior. The bird has 1 visible black eye, a simple curved black line on top of the head, 1 teardrop-shaped wing behind the neck, and 1 angled white tail feather shape pointing backward. The bird leans forward over the bicycle as if actively riding. It has 2 long narrow orange legs with black outlines extending downward over the frame toward the pedals. Keep the composition centered, playful, clean, and abstract, with no shading, no texture, and a modern icon-like graphic style.

items.titleZh: A bright, hyper-energetic Japanese movie poster illustration in a polished anime chibi style, set in a sparkling tropical ocean adventure scene. Center the composition on 2 cute chibi children riding a smiling blue shark that leaps diagonally upward through swirling seawater and white splash effects. The left child is a boy with short black hair, huge glossy blue eyes, a happy open-mouth smile, a black T-shirt, dark shorts, white sneakers, and a light blue shark hoodie with a tooth-edged hood framing his face; he points upward with one hand and hugs the shark with the other. The right child is a girl with orange hair, large glossy purple eyes, a joyful open-mouth smile, an orange dress, pink shoes, and a pink shark hoodie with a tooth-edged hood; she throws one arm wide in excitement while holding on with the other. Make the shark large and friendly with a rounded body, pale belly, tiny black eyes, and a wide open mouth. Surround them with a vivid underwater-and-surface world: schools of small tropical fish, exactly 1 sea turtle on the left, exactly 1 dolphin on the right, exactly 1 pink octopus on the right, exactly 1 pufferfish on the lower left, coral reefs and sea plants along the bottom edges, air bubbles throughout, and strong blue water motion lines. In the upper background, show a sunny sky with dramatic sun rays streaming into the water, fluffy clouds, 2 seagulls flying, a rocky tropical island with palm trees on the upper left, and a pirate ship on the upper right with white sails and a cute shark emblem. Add a ship wheel partly visible behind the main title. Use a dense, exciting Japanese kids-anime promotional layout with oversized 3D lettering and explosive effects. At the top, place the giant Japanese title text {argument name="headline text" default="サメなの ワクワク 大作戦"} in stacked lines, with glossy blue, orange-pink, and yellow-orange gradient letters, thick white outlines, dark blue shadows, water splashes, and sparkles. Beneath the title, add a smaller curved Japanese tagline in white with blue outline: {argument name="tagline" default="さあ、海のむこうへ！最高の冒険がはじまる！"}. At the bottom, place huge release text in Japanese, {argument name="release text" default="2026年 夏公開"}, in bold red-to-yellow gradient 3D letters with white and blue edging, sitting over a radiant orange burst. On the lower right, add a blue starburst badge with the Japanese text {argument name="badge text" default="ドキドキ！ワクワク！いっしょに出発だ！"} in white and yellow. Include exactly 2 treasure-themed corner props: an open treasure chest with gold coins at the lower left and a compass at the lower right. The overall look should be glossy, saturated, family-friendly, whimsical, cinematic, and toy-like, with crisp outlines, exaggerated expressions, high contrast, and a poster-ready vertical composition. No photorealism, no muted colors, no minimalism.

The right child is a girl with orange hair, large glossy purple eyes, a joyful open-mouth smile, an orange dress, pink shoes, and a pink shark hoodie with a tooth-edged hood; she throws one arm wide in excitement while holding on with the other. Make the shark large and friendly with a rounded body, pale belly, tiny black eyes, and a wide open mouth. Surround them with a vivid underwater-and-surface world: schools of small tropical fish, exactly 1 sea turtle on the left, exactly 1 dolphin on the right, exactly 1 pink octopus on the right, exactly 1 pufferfish on the lower left, coral reefs and sea plants along the bottom edges, air bubbles throughout, and strong blue water motion lines. In the upper background, show a sunny sky with dramatic sun rays streaming into the water, fluffy clouds, 2 seagulls flying, a rocky tropical island with palm trees on the upper left, and a pirate ship on the upper right with white sails and a cute shark emblem. Add a ship wheel partly visible behind the main title. Use a dense, exciting Japanese kids-anime promotional layout with oversized 3D lettering and explosive effects. At the top, place the giant Japanese title text {argument name="headline text" default="サメなの ワクワク 大作戦"} in stacked lines, with glossy blue, orange-pink, and yellow-orange gradient letters, thick white outlines, dark blue shadows, water splashes, and sparkles. Beneath the title, add a smaller curved Japanese tagline in white with blue outline: {argument name="tagline" default="さあ、海のむこうへ！最高の冒険がはじまる！"}. At the bottom, place huge release text in Japanese, {argument name="release text" default="2026年 夏公開"}, in bold red-to-yellow gradient 3D letters with white and blue edging, sitting over a radiant orange burst. On the lower right, add a blue starburst badge with the Japanese text {argument name="badge text" default="ドキドキ！ワクワク！いっしょに出発だ！"} in white and yellow. Include exactly 2 treasure-themed corner props: an open treasure chest with gold coins at the lower left and a compass at the lower right. The overall look should be glossy, saturated, family-friendly, whimsical, cinematic, and toy-like, with crisp outlines, exaggerated expressions, high contrast, and a poster-ready vertical composition. No photorealism, no muted colors, no minimalism.

items.title: Three Beauty Mobile Landing Pages
items.titleZh: A polished promotional mockup showing 3 tall smartphone screens displayed side by side in a vertical triptych layout, each presenting a modern beauty brand landing page for a lip product. The overall composition is editorial, minimal, and premium, designed like a social media showcase of mobile web designs. The left panel sits on a soft lavender-to-blush gradient background and shows a black-framed phone with a cream and blush beauty website for {argument name="brand name" default="Kosas"}. At the top of this panel, small elegant serif text reads {argument name="left headline" default="Fresh Pout."}. The phone screen features a cropped close-up beauty image at the top, a bold headline reading “Lips in their fullest expression.” with “fullest” in italic serif styling, a rounded dark call-to-action button, a strip of 3 lip close-up thumbnails, 3 labeled benefit tabs reading “Plumps,” “Tingles,” and “Shines,” and a row of 5 shade or effect icons underneath. The middle panel sits on a lavender-to-deep-violet gradient background and shows a second black-framed phone with a more typographic landing page. Above it, serif text reads {argument name="middle headline" default="Claude Code"}. The screen includes a cropped portrait image at top, a very large bold black stacked title reading “LIP PULSE.” with a pink italic script-style line “is here.” beneath it, a rounded dark button, a dark section with the phrase “Lips in their fullest expression.”, and a product grid near the bottom containing 6 shade cards arranged in 2 rows of 3. The right panel sits on a dark navy textured background and shows a third black-framed phone with a pink-forward e-commerce style page. Centered above it, monospaced white text reads {argument name="right headline" default="GPT Images 2.0"}. This screen prominently displays the product hero section with the brand name “Kosas,” a large title “The Lip Pulse,” a pink lip gloss tube angled to the right, small feature icons, a shade strip of 6 lip swatches near the middle, and a lower promotional block with additional pink product imagery. Keep the layout symmetrical with exactly 3 phones, one per panel, each fully visible and vertically oriented. Use high-end cosmetic campaign aesthetics, clean spacing, fashion-web typography mixing serif and bold sans serif, soft pink and cream UI palettes, subtle shadows, and a sleek product-design presentation suitable for showcasing AI-generated mobile website concepts.

items.title: Four-Panel Romantic Comedy Manga Page
items.titleZh: Create a black-and-white manga page with 4 stacked horizontal panels, clean black gutters, screentone shading, dramatic speed lines, and polished seinen-style linework. The page features two youthful anime characters with modern casual clothing and short dark hair, with the face area of both characters obscured by a soft square blur censor block. Panel 1: a slim young person with messy short dark hair and a collared shirt clenches one fist near their chest, body angled left, surrounded by an intense fiery aura effect in the background, looking emotional and defensive. On the right side, place a large jagged vertical speech balloon containing this Japanese text: 「何十時間も魂を削って描いた一枚と、プロンプト打ち込んで数秒で出した画像が同じ価値なわけないでしょ！ふざけないで！」. Panel 2: a second young person with slightly taller build, short dark hair, a dark zip jacket over a light shirt, raises one index finger calmly as if explaining a point. Add a rounded rectangular speech box on the right with this Japanese text: 「投下した労働時間で価値が決まるという典型的な“労働価値説の誤謬”だ。市場における価値は、出力された結果を受け手がどう評価するかで決まる」. Panel 3: the taller character gently pats the shorter character on the head; include a small hand-pat sound effect near the hand reading 「ポン」. The shorter character looks up in surprise. On the right side, add a large oval vertical speech balloon with this Japanese text: 「でも俺の市場価値基準はすごくシンプルだよ。君が俺のために照れてくれるこの数秒間に、何十時間分の価値も感じてるから」. Panel 4: close-up of the shorter character blushing intensely with spiral eyes, sweat drops, trembling expression, open mouth, and dense hatching on the cheeks, overwhelmed with embarrassment. Fill the background with dramatic radiating speed lines. Add a large jagged vertical speech balloon on the right with this Japanese text: 「だ、誰がアンタのために照れるか…っ！自意識過剰よ！」. Add two sound effects: a small 「プル…」 near the shoulder and a larger shaky handwritten 「カァァァ」 along the lower left side. Keep the whole page monochrome, highly expressive, romantic-comedy manga tone, with strong emotional contrast between heated argument, cool explanation, teasing affection, and flustered payoff.

On the left and right midground, place thick stands of leafy green trees and dark pine trees, framing the open valley center. In the background, show a dramatic mountain range with exactly 7 visible peaks: 1 dominant tall snow-capped peak slightly right of center, 2 medium purple peaks to its left, 2 smaller snowy blue peaks in the far center distance, 1 smaller purple peak to the right, and 1 cropped rocky mountain edge at the far left. Add exactly 4 small flying bird silhouettes in the sky. The whole image should feel colorful, nostalgic, scenic, and richly layered, with heavy halftone comic shading, retro print grain, no text, no UI, no characters, and no buildings.

items.titleZh: A sleek futuristic Japanese tech advertisement in a dark sci-fi showroom with glossy reflective floors and soft blue neon bokeh lights in the background. On the right side, show a tall black rectangular hologram device with transparent glass front and sides, rounded edges, and subtle camera-like sensors across the top. The device is labeled Gatebox3 and glows with cyan-blue light, including a bright cyan logo on the base. Inside the chamber, display a full-body anime virtual girl hologram floating slightly above the bottom platform, rendered as a luminous translucent blue projection with particle sparkles. She has very long twin-tail hair, a youthful idol-like design, and a futuristic white and cyan outfit with detached sleeves, short skirt, thigh-high stockings, and heeled shoes. Her face is intentionally simplified or softly obscured, and she poses with one leg bent and both arms open in a welcoming gesture. Add glowing circular projection rings at the top and bottom inside the chamber. On the left side, place a clean Japanese promotional text layout with large headline text reading 「すべてのキャラクターを輝かせる」, with the single kanji 「輝」 emphasized in bright cyan and the rest in white. Beneath it, place the Gatebox3 logo and product name in white, followed by smaller tagline text 「物語が、そこにいる。」. Along the bottom left, include exactly 4 feature icons with Japanese labels in white and cyan: 1 hologram icon with 「高精細 3Dホログラム」, 1 audio waveform icon with 「キャラクターとの 自然な会話」, 1 sun-like ambient light icon with 「空間に溶け込む 洗練デザイン」, and 1 heart icon with 「あなたのそばに いつも一緒に」. items.title: Censored Office Manga Confrontation
items.titleZh: A dramatic black-and-white manga page in a seinen style, rendered with dense screentones, sharp ink lines, high contrast lighting, and expressive Japanese comic layout. The page has 4 stacked panels with vertical Japanese speech bubbles and bold sound effects, showing a tense confrontation between two office workers in a modern workspace. In the top panel, a young woman with a short messy bob haircut, slim but curvy build, wearing a fitted button-up blouse with rolled sleeves and a dark pencil skirt, slams one hand hard onto a desk in anger, leaning forward toward the viewer with explosive impact lines and a large jagged speech bubble. In the second panel, a young man with dark tousled hair, slim build, wearing a black leather jacket over a light shirt and a necklace, is shown from the chest up in a calm, confident pose, touching his face while speaking. In the third panel, the man pins the woman against a wall in a close, intimate kabedon pose, one arm braced beside her head; she looks flustered and tense while he speaks near her face, creating a sudden romantic-comedic shift in mood. In the bottom panel, an overhead view reveals the office setting: 2 characters standing near a desk with 1 computer monitor, 1 keyboard, 1 mouse, 1 office chair, and scattered papers on a tiled floor; the woman is curled inward shyly and trembling while the man stands relaxed beside her. Include exactly 4 panels, exactly 4 visible speech bubbles total, and visible Japanese manga typography throughout. Add a rectangular mosaic censor blur over each character's face in every panel, as if anonymized for sharing online. Background details should include office walls, desk edges, speed lines, burst effects, and tonal gradients. The overall feeling is intense argument turning into manipulative flirtation, like a viral out-of-context manga screenshot.

items.prompt: A dramatic black-and-white manga page in a seinen style, rendered with dense screentones, sharp ink lines, high contrast lighting, and expressive Japanese comic layout. items.title: Cute Morning Greeting Figure Sticker
items.titleZh: A cute sticker-style 3D figurine illustration on a clean light gray background, designed like a glossy collectible toy render. Show 1 chibi woman and 1 large cat side by side. The woman is a super-deformed vinyl-figure style character with an oversized head, shoulder-length dark brown to black hair with a side part and smooth shine, wearing a simple bright red long-sleeve top, dark charcoal leggings or slim pants, and white shoes. She stands on the left, facing forward, with her left hand raised in a friendly waving pose and a cheerful morning-greeting vibe. Her face should be simple, cute, and youthful in toy-figure style. To her right, place 1 plump silver tabby cat with white fur on the chest, belly, legs, and muzzle, gray stripes on the head, back, and tail, green eyes, pink inner ears, and a relaxed loaf-like lying pose with paws tucked forward, facing slightly toward camera. Add Japanese handwritten text at the top in 2 lines, dark brown rounded brush lettering: line 1 says "おはよう", line 2 says "ございます!". Place 1 simple orange sun doodle with 8 short rays on the upper right. The composition should feel like a personalized morning greeting stamp for social media, with soft studio lighting, subtle shadows under the figures, polished surfaces, cute proportions, high detail, and a warm playful mood.
items.promptZh: 干净的浅灰色背景上的可爱贴纸式 3D 雕像插图，设计得像光滑的收藏玩具渲染。并排展示 1 个赤壁女人和 1 个大猫。女子是一个超级变形的黑胶人物风格角色，有着超大的头部，齐肩的深棕色至黑色头发，侧分，光泽光滑，穿着简单的亮红色长袖上衣，深炭色打底裤或修身裤，脚踩白色鞋子。她站在左边，面朝前，举起左手，做出友好的挥手姿势，营造出愉快的早晨问候氛围。她的脸应该是简单、可爱、年轻的玩具人物风格。在她的右边，放着一只丰满的银色虎斑猫，胸部、腹部、腿部和口吻上有白色毛皮，头部、背部和尾巴上有灰色条纹，绿色的眼睛，粉红色的内耳，以及放松的面包状躺姿，爪子向前折叠，稍微面向镜头。在顶部添加日语手写文字，分两行，深棕色圆形毛笔字体：第 1 行写“おはよう”，第 2 行写“ございます！”。在右上角放置 1 个带有 8 条短光线的简单橙色太阳涂鸦。构图应该感觉像是社交媒体上的个性化早晨问候邮票，具有柔和的工作室灯光、人物下微妙的阴影、抛光的表面、可爱的比例、高细节和温暖俏皮的情绪。

items.title: VINCO Editorial Moodboard Screenshot
items.titleZh: Create a 4:5 editorial fashion lookbook moodboard for a fictional brand called {argument name="brand name" default="VINCO"}. The image is a dark-interface screenshot-style composition with a large rounded charcoal text panel across the upper half and a 2-by-3 grid of six fashion/editorial images in the lower left quadrant. The overall aesthetic blends Italian archival graphic design with late-1990s Southern California streetwear, mixing natural wine culture, skate utility, and sun-faded documentary fashion photography. Use gritty but precise art direction, midday outdoor light, slightly chaotic but disciplined typography, and real-person casting rather than polished fashion-model energy. In the top text panel, show a long white sans-serif creative-direction paragraph describing the shoot, with multiple lines of copy, like an AI prompt or design brief displayed inside a rounded dark gray bubble on a near-black background. In the image grid, include exactly 6 tiles: tile 1 shows a young man in an oversized faded olive T-shirt and dark pants standing in front of an off-white poster-like backdrop with bold {argument name="logo text" default="VINCO"} branding, barcode graphics, and small editorial text; tile 2 is a close-up still life of a dark wine bottle with a minimalist white label reading {argument name="bottle label" default="VINCO"}, photographed in warm sunlight with tactile paper texture and shadow; tile 3 shows a person from the back in a washed olive long-sleeve shirt with large subtle chest or back branding, white shorts, and a yellow hanging tag or sticker element near the top right, posed against a pale wall with blue stripe detail and editorial layout text; tile 4 shows a skateboarder crouching or riding away, photographed from behind, wearing a white T-shirt with a large black graphic block on the back and dark shorts, in golden sun on pavement; tile 5 is a printed wine ephemera flat lay with cream paper and a pale chartreuse-green wine label or booklet reading {argument name="product text" default="Vino Naturale"}, featuring grape illustration, small black text, and layered paper pieces; tile 6 shows a person facing camera in a white T-shirt with a race-bib style chest print reading 97, wearing a fluorescent yellow-green cap with small brand text, standing outdoors with palm trees and bright sky behind them. Keep the six images slightly imperfect and collage-like, as if pulled from a campaign deck or saved references. Use earthy tones throughout: olive, cream, charcoal, sun-bleached white, asphalt gray, muted brown, and one fluorescent yellow-green accent repeated in small details. Include visible interface framing around the composition: a dark app-like background, the lower image grid aligned left, and a rounded gray “Edit” button near the bottom left, plus a small circular icon near the bottom right, reinforcing that this is a screenshot of a generated moodboard rather than a clean standalone poster.
items.promptZh: 为名为 {argument name="brand name" default="VINCO"} 的虚构品牌创建 4:5 的编辑时尚 Lookbook 情绪板。该图像是一个黑暗界面截图风格的组合，上半部分有一个大的圆形木炭文本面板，左下象限有一个由六张时尚/编辑图像组成的 2×3 网格。整体美学将意大利档案平面设计与 20 世纪 90 年代末的南加州街头服饰融为一体，融合了天然葡萄酒文化、滑板实用性和日晒褪色的纪实时尚摄影。使用坚韧但精确的艺术指导、正午的室外光线、稍微混乱但有纪律的排版以及真人选角，而不是抛光的时装模特能量。在顶部文本面板中，显示一个长的白色无衬线创意方向段落，描述拍摄，其中包含多行副本，例如在近乎黑色的背景上的圆形深灰色气泡内显示的 AI 提示或设计简介。在图像网格中，恰好包含 6 个图块：图块 1 显示一名穿着超大褪色橄榄色 T 恤和深色裤子的年轻人站在灰白色海报般的背景前，背景上有粗体的 {argument name="logo text" default="VINCO"} 品牌、条形码图形和小编辑文本；图块 2 是一个深色酒瓶的特写静物画，上面有一个极简主义的白色标签，上面写着 {argument name="bottle label" default="VINCO"}，在温暖的阳光下拍摄，带有触觉纸张纹理和阴影；图 3 显示了后面的一个人，穿着水洗橄榄色长袖衬衫，胸部或背部有大而精致的品牌标识，穿着白色短裤，右上角附近有黄色吊牌或贴纸元素，靠在带有蓝色条纹细节和编辑布局文本的苍白墙壁上；图 4 显示了一名滑板运动员蹲着或骑着走，从后面拍摄，穿着一件背面有大黑色图案块的白色 T 恤和深色短裤，在人行道上的金色阳光下；图块 5 是一个印刷的葡萄酒蜉蝣平板，配有奶油色纸和浅黄绿色葡萄酒标签或小册子，上面写着{argument name="product text" default="Vino Naturale"}，以葡萄插图、黑色小文字和分层纸片为特色；图 6 显示了一个人面对镜头，身穿白色 T 恤，胸前印有“97”字样的竞赛围兜式图案，头戴印有小品牌文字的荧光黄绿色帽子，站在户外，身后是棕榈树和明亮的天空。保持六张图像稍微不完美并且像拼贴画一样，就像从竞选甲板或保存的参考中拉出来的一样。整体使用大地色调：橄榄色、奶油色、木炭色、日光漂白白色、沥青灰色、柔和棕色，以及在小细节中重复出现的一种荧光黄绿色调。在构图周围包括可见的界面框架：类似应用程序的深色背景、左对齐的下部图像网格、左下角附近的圆形灰色“编辑”按钮，以及右下角附近的小圆形图标，强调这是生成的情绪板的屏幕截图，而不是干净的独立海报。

items.title: Anime Sunset Film Poster
items.titleZh: A breathtaking anime movie poster at golden-hour sunset, vertical theatrical one-sheet composition, painted in the polished cinematic style of a Makoto Shinkai-inspired youth drama. The scene overlooks a Japanese coastal hillside town descending toward a glowing bay, with the sun low on the horizon and its reflection stretching across calm water. The sky dominates most of the image: a vast deep-blue to lavender twilight gradient filled with countless stars, wispy pink and peach clouds, and one especially bright star near the upper right. In the foreground on the right, a teenage schoolgirl stands in three-quarter side profile facing left toward the sea, shown from mid-thigh up, with shoulder-length dark hair blowing in the breeze, a short-sleeved white sailor-style school blouse, a red ribbon at the collar, and a navy pleated skirt; her expression is contemplative and wistful. Farther down the steep stone stair street in the center-left, a teenage schoolboy stands with his back to the viewer, wearing a short-sleeved white shirt and dark trousers, also looking toward the sunset and ocean. At the lower right, include 1 black cat sitting on a wall or rooftop edge in silhouette, looking toward the town. At the lower left, include 1 old-fashioned streetlamp and a dense cluster of blooming hydrangeas in blue and violet along a stone wall. The town below is packed with tiled rooftops, narrow streets, warm window lights, and layered houses, with distant mountains framing the bay. Use dramatic rim light, luminous atmospheric perspective, sparkling highlights, delicate cloud detail, and emotional, nostalgic color grading in indigo, ultramarine, pink, peach, and gold. items.title: Minimal Pelican Riding Bicycle
items.titleZh: A minimalist vector-style illustration on a flat light gray background showing a pelican riding a bicycle, drawn from simple geometric shapes with thick dark charcoal outlines. The composition is wide and centered, with the bicycle occupying the lower two-thirds of the image and the bird’s head floating slightly above and forward of the handlebars in a deliberately abstract, diagram-like way. The bicycle is a simple black road-bike silhouette in side view with exactly 2 large wheels, each with a thick outer rim and exactly 4 visible spoke lines forming a cross, a straight horizontal ground line beneath both wheels, a triangular frame, a short black saddle, and simplified crank and pedal details near the rear of the frame. The pelican is constructed from clean abstract pieces: a white rounded head with a small black circular eye, a long open beak pointing left made of 2 parts with an upper orange triangular section and a lower pale pink pouch section, a short dark curve on top of the head, a small separate white oval neck/body connector, a larger white rounded body positioned over the bike, and a single white wing-like shape angled upward over the back. Add exactly 2 orange leg shapes, long narrow rectangles leaning downward from the body toward the bicycle frame, suggesting the bird is pedaling. Keep the forms intentionally sparse and slightly surreal, like a logo test or simple code-editor doodle, with no shading, no gradients, no textures, no text, and lots of negative space.
items.promptZh: 平面浅灰色背景上的简约矢量风格插图，显示一只骑自行车的鹈鹕，由简单的几何形状和厚厚的深色木炭轮廓绘制而成。构图宽阔且居中，自行车占据了图像的下三分之二，鸟头以一种故意抽象的、类似图表的方式漂浮在车把的上方和前方。从侧面看，这辆自行车是一个简单的黑色公路自行车轮廓，有 2 个大轮子，每个轮子都有厚实的外轮辋和 4 条可见的辐条线，形成十字，两个轮子下方有一条笔直的水平地线，一个三角形车架，一个短的黑色车座，以及靠近车架后部的简化曲柄和踏板细节。鹈鹕由干净的抽象部件构成：一个带有黑色小圆眼的白色圆形头部，一个向左张开的长嘴，由两部分组成，上部为橙色三角形部分，下部为淡粉色袋状部分，头顶上有一条短的深色曲线，一个小的独立的白色椭圆形颈部/身体连接器，一个位于自行车上方的较大的白色圆形身体，以及一个在背部向上倾斜的白色翼状形状。正好添加 2 个橙色腿形状，即从身体向下倾斜到自行车车架的狭长矩形，表明鸟正在踩踏板。故意保持表单稀疏且略显超现实，例如徽标测试或简单的代码编辑器涂鸦，没有阴影、没有渐变、没有纹理、没有文本和大量负空间。

items.title: Cute Four-Panel Cat Jealousy Comic
items.titleZh: A cute hand-drawn four-panel comic in a soft, warm, slice-of-life style on a light cream background with thick black panel borders and slightly textured paper grain. Use simple rounded cartoon cat anatomy, expressive faces, clean black outlines, muted natural colors, and a gentle manga-like presentation. In the top-left panel, show 2 cats: a brown tabby cat with dark stripes and white muzzle sitting with eyes closed, looking pleased, while a mostly white cat with dark brown patches on the head stands beside it and affectionately licks the tabby's cheek; add 2 small black musical notes above them to suggest happy grooming. In the top-right panel, show the white-and-brown patched cat in the foreground looking toward a small calico kitten standing to the right; include a speech bubble containing the Japanese text "めい" above the kitten. In the bottom-left panel, show 3 cats together: the brown tabby on the left with a surprised or blank expression, the white patched cat on the right looking cheerful, and the small calico kitten centered in front between them, looking up. In the bottom-right panel, show a close-up of the brown tabby cat alone, facing forward with narrowed yellow-green eyes and an angry, jealous expression; add 2 short emphasis lines near the face and 1 small puff-shaped anger symbol to the right. Keep the tone cozy and comedic, with the visual joke that the tabby was happy being groomed until the new kitten appears. Use flat colors, minimal shading, and a charming Japanese webcomic feel.

items.title: 108 Chibi Fantasy Mandala
items.titleZh:
A gigantic ultra-detailed fantasy mandala poster featuring exactly 108 distinct chibi characters arranged in concentric circular rings around a radiant central emblem. The composition is perfectly symmetrical overall and fills a wide horizontal canvas like an ornate collectible mural. In the center, place a glowing golden core with 9 chibi animal-fantasy mascots clustered in a circular medallion, each with oversized heads, tiny bodies, expressive eyes, and luxurious costume details. Surround this center with multiple evenly spaced concentric rings containing the remaining 99 characters, each character occupying its own wedge-like segment and designed as a unique elemental or mythical variation. Include fox-like, rabbit-like, cat-like, wolf-like, lion-like, bird-like, dragon-like, deer-like, and hybrid beast characters, all rendered in a cute super-deformed style but with epic high-fantasy armor, robes, crowns, feathers, horns, gems, capes, staffs, and magical accessories. Make every character visually distinct through color, silhouette, species traits, and elemental theme, while preserving a unified painterly anime-fantasy aesthetic.

Use a rich palette dominated by luminous gold, ivory, cream, violet, indigo, sapphire, and soft amber, with accents of crimson, icy cyan, emerald, and sunset orange. Give the image the feel of a sacred celestial chart or zodiac wheel, with each circular band separated by elegant gilded borders and arc dividers. Add glowing magical energy, sparkles, halos, swirling fire, mist, snow, clouds, water splashes, lightning curls, floral motifs, and celestial particles around many of the characters. Around the outer perimeter, place several larger decorative guardian illustrations integrated into the border: a bright sun medallion at the upper left, a white phoenix-like bird in a circular panel at the upper right, a floral or starburst medallion at the lower right, and a fiery character cluster in a circular panel at the lower left, plus additional large elemental beast figures embedded along the left and right edges. Frame the entire artwork with an elaborate antique ornamental border inspired by illuminated manuscripts and fantasy tarot designs, using filigree, corner medallions, geometric trim, and arcane motifs.

The rendering should be extremely dense and crisp, like a 4k fantasy illustration meant for a poster print, with tiny readable character silhouettes across the whole image, intricate linework, soft watercolor-textured shading, glowing highlights, and a polished collectible-card-game concept art finish. Emphasize abundance, harmony, and radial order: exactly 108 chibi figures total, arranged as a majestic mandala of mythical elemental mascots.
items.promptZh:
一张巨大的、超详细的奇幻曼陀罗海报，上面有 108 个不同的赤壁角色，围绕着光芒四射的中央标志排列成同心圆环。构图整体上完美对称，充满了宽阔的水平画布，就像一幅华丽的收藏壁画。在中心放置一个发光的金色核心，上面有 9 个赤壁动物奇幻吉祥物，簇拥在一个圆形徽章中，每个吉祥物都有超大的头、微小的身体、富有表情的眼睛和奢华的服装细节。围绕该中心的是多个均匀分布的同心环，其中包含其余 99 个角色，每个角色占据自己的楔形部分，并设计为独特的元素或神话变体。包括狐类、兔类、猫类、狼类、狮子类、鸟类、龙类、鹿类、混合兽类角色，全部以可爱的超变形风格渲染，但拥有史诗般的高奇幻盔​​甲、长袍、王冠、羽毛、角、宝石、斗篷、法杖和魔法配件。通过颜色、轮廓、物种特征和元素主题使每个角色在视觉上截然不同，同时保留统一的绘画动漫奇幻美学。

使用丰富的调色板，以夜光金、象牙色、奶油色、紫罗兰色、靛蓝、蓝宝石和柔和的琥珀色为主，辅以深红色、冰青色、祖母绿和日落橙色。赋予图像神圣的天象图或黄道带轮的感觉，每个圆形带都由优雅的镀金边框和弧形分隔线分隔开。在许多角色周围添加发光的魔法能量、火花、光环、旋转的火焰、薄雾、雪、云、水花、闪电卷曲、花卉图案和天体粒子。在外周周围，将几个较大的装饰性守护者插图集成到边框中：左上方有一个明亮的太阳徽章，右上角的圆形面板中有一只白色的凤凰鸟，右下角有一个花卉或星爆徽章，左下方的圆形面板中有一个火热的字符簇，再加上沿着左右边缘嵌入的大型元素兽图形。整个艺术品采用精致的古董装饰边框，灵感来自于彩绘手稿和奇幻塔罗牌设计，使用金丝细工、角落奖章、几何装饰和神秘图案。

渲染应该非常密集和清晰，就像用于海报印刷的 4k 奇幻插图一样，整个图像上有微小的可读人物轮廓、复杂的线条、柔和的水彩纹理阴影、发光的亮点以及精美的收藏卡游戏概念艺术完成。强调丰富、和谐和放射状秩序：总共 108 个赤壁人物，排列成神话元素吉祥物的雄伟曼陀罗。

Below it, a purple ribbon banner with white uppercase text reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="CONECTE A CONTA AO RESULTADO!"}. The main area shows 40 domino-style tiles arranged in a 4-column by 10-row grid, evenly spaced. Each tile is a horizontal rounded rectangle with a thin colorful outline, white fill, a vertical divider at the center, and a small black dot on the divider. The left half contains either a number result or the word "INÍCIO" on the first tile, and the right half contains a multiplication expression. Use alternating border colors across the grid such as purple, green, blue, orange, pink, and yellow. At the bottom, add a large rounded dashed purple box spanning most of the width. Inside the left side of this box, place the section title "COMO JOGAR:" in bold purple uppercase, followed by 5 bullet points in black: "Coloque a peça “INÍCIO” na mesa.", "Os jogadores, na sua vez, devem encaixar uma peça cuja conta seja igual ao número da ponta livre.", "Se não tiver peça para jogar, compre do monte.", and "Vence quem ficar sem peças!". On the right side of the same box, add the title "EXEMPLO DE INÍCIO:" in purple uppercase and show 4 small domino tiles in sequence plus ellipsis: "INÍCIO | 1 × 1", then "1 | 1 × 2", then "2 | 1 × 3", then "3 | 1 × 4", followed by "...". Keep the overall style crisp, vector-like, printable, friendly for elementary math practice, with balanced spacing and highly legible text.

items.title: Multiplication Domino Classroom Activity
items.titleZh: A realistic documentary-style photo of an elementary school classroom during a math activity, with about 10 children seated around grouped wooden desks, wearing green and blue school uniforms, actively playing a colorful multiplication domino game. The camera is at child eye level, slightly angled downward toward the main table in the foreground. Center the scene on one square educational board game labeled in Portuguese, with the title "DOMINÓ DA MULTIPLICAÇÃO" on the lower edge and "TREINANDO AS TABUADAS" in the center, surrounded by a border of brightly colored domino-style multiplication tiles. Show 4 children clearly engaged around this main board: one child placing a yellow tile onto the board, one child holding a stack of multicolored tiles, one child watching from the left, and one child in a blue sleeve at the bottom edge arranging pieces. Include 2 shallow wooden boxes labeled "JOGO DE DOMINÓ," one near the center-left and one at the bottom-right, each containing colorful rectangular domino pieces. Scatter school materials naturally on the desks: 3 pencils, 2 worksheets, 1 water bottle, pencil cases, notebooks, and extra game tiles. In the background, show the rest of the classroom softly out of focus with additional students at desks, a bookshelf, a corkboard filled with children’s drawings, and a large multiplication chart poster on the left wall reading "TABUADA DE MULTIPLICAÇÃO." Bright natural daylight enters from tall windows on the right, giving the room a warm, lively, authentic school atmosphere. The educational board and tiles should use vivid classroom colors like yellow, blue, pink, green, and orange. Faces should be unobtrusive or de-emphasized, with the focus on hands-on learning, collaboration, and the multiplication domino activity. Vertical composition, highly realistic photography, candid classroom moment, sharp foreground details, soft depth of field in the background.
items.promptZh: 一张写实的纪实风格照片，显示小学教室正在进行数学活动，大约 10 个孩子围坐在分组的木桌周围，穿着绿色和蓝色的校服，积极地玩着色彩缤纷的乘法多米诺骨牌游戏。相机处于儿童视线水平，稍微向下倾斜，朝向前景的主桌子。将场景置于一个用葡萄牙语标记的方形教育棋盘游戏上，标题为“DOMINÓ DA MULTIPLICAÇãO”位于下边缘，“TREINANDO AS TABUADAS”位于中心，周围环绕着色彩鲜艳的多米诺骨牌式乘法图块的边框。展示 4 个孩子清楚地围绕着这个主板：一个孩子将一块黄色瓷砖放在主板上，一个孩子拿着一堆五彩瓷砖，一个孩子从左边观看，一个孩子穿着蓝色袖子在底部边缘排列碎片。包括 2 个标有“JOGO DE DOMINÓ”的浅木盒，一个靠近中左，一个位于右下角，每个盒子都装有彩色的矩形多米诺骨牌。将学习材料自然地散布在课桌上：3支铅笔、2张工作表、1个水瓶、铅笔盒、笔记本和额外的游戏块。在背景中，教室的其余部分轻轻地失去了焦点，课桌旁有更多的学生、一个书架、一个装满儿童图画的软木板，以及左墙上一张写着“TABUADA DE MULTIPLICAÇãO”的大型乘法图表海报。明亮的自然光从右侧高大的窗户射入，给房间带来温暖、活泼、纯正的学校氛围。教育板和瓷砖应使用生动的教室颜色，如黄色、蓝色、粉色、绿色和橙色。面孔应该不引人注目或不强调，重点是实践学习、协作和乘法多米诺骨牌活动。垂直构图、高度写实的摄影、坦诚的课堂瞬间、锐利的前景细节、柔和的背景景深。

items.title: Vintage Malta Travel Poster
items.titleZh: A vintage travel poster illustration for {argument name="destination" default="Malta"}, designed like a mid-century Mediterranean tourism advertisement with elegant painterly realism and slightly textured printed-poster grain. At the top center, place the large headline {argument name="headline text" default="MALTA"} in oversized cream serif capitals, with the subtitle {argument name="subtitle text" default="MEDITERRANEAN PARADISE"} directly below in smaller dark navy sans-serif capitals. Show a sunlit coastal road curving along a stone waterfront in Valletta, viewed from slightly above and behind a classic white 1960s sedan driving away from the viewer in the lower left foreground; the rear license plate reads {argument name="license plate" default="MTA 1964"}. Across the harbor, depict warm honey-colored limestone buildings climbing the hillside, including 1 large domed church, 1 tall narrow church spire, rows of historic townhouses with several colorful enclosed wooden balconies, and distant city walls stretching across the opposite shoreline. In the bay, include exactly 3 traditional Maltese fishing boats in vivid blue, yellow, red, and green, plus 2 tiny white sailboats farther back. Add exactly 4 white seagulls flying across a brilliant turquoise-blue sky with soft white clouds. Frame the whole composition with dark leafy trees and abundant bright magenta bougainvillea blossoms arching in from the top and right edges, with more flowers in the lower right corner, creating a lush border around the scene. Include a palm tree among the waterfront buildings and a spiky agave plant in the lower left foreground. Use warm golden sunlight, saturated coastal colors, romantic vacation-poster composition, clean readable typography, and a nostalgic, idealized Mediterranean atmosphere.

items.title: Dark Space Emperor Movie Poster
items.titleZh: A dark epic sci-fi movie poster for {argument name="film title" default="EMPIRE OF THE VOID"}, in a highly cinematic photorealistic space-opera style. Centered composition with a tall alien emperor standing behind a massive circular command table, viewed from slightly below to make the figure feel imposing and godlike. The emperor wears ornate black and gunmetal biomechanical armor with sharp layered pauldrons, engraved metallic filigree, a long dark cloak, and a regal elongated helmet-crown. The face is mostly obscured in shadow, giving a mysterious, intimidating presence. One large clawed hand rests prominently on the glowing table in the foreground. The command table displays a luminous spiral galaxy hologram in blue-violet tones, with concentric interface rings and subtle cosmic light. The setting is the bridge of a colossal starship or throne room, with two curved panoramic windows framing outer space. Outside the windows are 8 visible spacecraft total: 4 on the left side and 4 on the right side, including several large battleships and smaller escort vessels. A huge planet fills much of the left background, while the right background shows a purple-blue nebula and starfield. Two secondary alien officers are seated in the mid-background, 1 on the left and 1 on the right, each at glowing futuristic control consoles. The color palette is deep black, steel gray, indigo, violet, and cold blue, with dramatic rim lighting, glossy metallic reflections, and dense atmospheric shadows. The layout should feel like a premium blockbuster poster: a centered top tagline in small uppercase text reading {argument name="tagline" default="INTELLIGENCE. DOMINION. DESTINY. THE GALAXY BOWS TO NONE."}, the giant title near the bottom in elegant spaced serif capitals with the words {argument name="main title" default="EMPIRE"} on the first line and {argument name="subtitle" default="OF THE VOID"} below it, with the letter O stylized as a glowing black-hole eclipse. Beneath that, add a glowing imperial trident-like emblem centered above the release line {argument name="release text" default="COMING SOON"}. items.title: Surreal Archer With Birds and Animals
items.titleZh: A surreal cinematic outdoor portrait of a masked archer standing in a dry field under a deep clear blue sky, framed from about the knees up in a wide horizontal composition. The central figure is a woman-like person in a vintage prairie-style dress and matching headscarf, aiming a simple wooden longbow toward the left side of the frame with an arrow drawn back to the cheek. Her face is fully obscured by a soft rectangular blur or blocky censorship patch, creating an uncanny anonymous effect. The dress is sage green with long puffed sleeves, a gathered waist tied with a sash, and a tiny repeating red-and-white floral dot pattern. A red cloth or scarf is wrapped around the lower face and neck beneath the green head covering. Surrounding her are 12 animals total: 8 white birds flying across the sky at different distances, 2 larger white birds standing on the ground at the right side, 1 deer head entering from the lower left foreground, and 1 sheep or goat head entering from the lower right foreground. Add 1 red-headed crane-like bird at the far right edge, visible in profile. The image should feel dreamlike, strange, and symbolic rather than realistic, with crisp midday sunlight, rich saturated colors, soft film grain, and a slightly vintage editorial-photography look. Use low-angle perspective, dynamic diagonal lines from the bow and arrow, and layered animal placement to create tension and motion. Dry grasses appear at the bottom edge, but the background is mostly open sky. Highly detailed fabric folds, natural bird wing positions, and a balanced surreal composition.

保持构图高度组织化、海报式且视觉密集，每个图块都一目了然。使用轻微的等距透视、清晰的线条、绘画般的阴影和精美的编辑插图质量。整体感觉应该结合博物馆海报、教育时间表和富有想象力的历史科技立体模型艺术。
