items.titleZh: A top-down cinematic still life of a vintage classified investigation dossier on a dark wooden desk, centered and filling most of the frame. Show a stack of 3 worn manila folders with aged beige paper, frayed corners, subtle stains, and realistic paper texture. The top folder is the main focus and is clipped at the upper left with 1 oversized silver paper clip. Across the top center, typewritten in bold black monospaced letters, the headline reads {argument name="headline text" default="CONFIDENTIAL – CASE FILES"}, with a thin horizontal rule beneath it. Add 2 red rubber-stamp marks: one near the top right that says "CONFIDENTIAL" at a slight angle, and one boxed stamp at the bottom right that says "HANDLING INSTRUCTIONS DO NOT COPY – DO NOT DISTRIBUTE". On the right edge of the folder stack, show 1 tabbed side label reading "CASE FILE NO." with a thick black redaction bar below it. The page is formatted like an old typewritten government document with crisp black ink, slightly uneven typewriter alignment, and many thick black redaction bars obscuring key details. Include 5 numbered sections exactly: "1. SUBJECT INFORMATION", "2. CASE SUMMARY", "3. DETAILS", "4. ASSOCIATES / CONTACTS", and "5. REMARKS". In the header area, include the fields "CASE FILE NO.:" with a black redaction bar, "DATE OPENED:" with {argument name="date opened" default="March 14, 20___"}, "PREPARED BY:" with a black redaction bar, "DEPARTMENT:" with {argument name="department" default="Internal Investigations Unit"}, and "CLASSIFICATION:" with {argument name="classification" default="CONFIDENTIAL"}. In section 1, include 6 fields: "NAME:", "ALIASES:", "DATE OF BIRTH:", "PLACE OF BIRTH:", "LAST KNOWN ADDRESS:", and "OCCUPATION:", each followed by black redaction bars of varying lengths. In section 2, add a short paragraph of typewritten case-summary text with 5 separate black redaction bars embedded in the sentence flow. In section 3, add a second paragraph of details text with 4 separate black redaction bars embedded in the paragraph. In section 4, include a 3-column table labeled "NAME", "RELATIONSHIP", and "NOTES", with 3 filled rows, each cell content covered by black redaction bars. In section 5, add a short warning sentence about sensitive information and unauthorized disclosure. Use warm sepia lighting, soft shadows around the folder edges, subtle vignetting, and a moody noir archival atmosphere. The image should feel realistic, tactile, secretive, and slightly dusty, like a confidential detective case file photographed for a crime thriller or worldbuilding prop.
items.promptZh: 深色木桌上的自上而下的电影静物画，展示了一份老式分类调查档案，居中并占据了大部分画面。展示一叠 3 个磨损的马尼拉文件夹，其中有老化的米色纸张、磨损的边角、微妙的污渍和逼真的纸张纹理。顶部文件夹是主要焦点，用 1 个超大银色回形针夹在左上角。在顶部中心，用粗体黑色等宽字母打字，标题为{argument name =“headline text”default =“CONFIDENTIAL – CASE FILES”}，下面有一条细水平线。添加 2 个红色橡皮图章标记：一个靠近右上角，以小角度写着“机密”；一个盒装印章位于右下角，写着“处理说明请勿复制 - 请勿分发”。在文件夹堆栈的右边缘，显示 1 个选项卡式侧面标签，上面写着“案例文件编号”。下面有一个粗的黑色编辑条。该页面的格式类似于旧的打字政府文件，带有清晰的黑色墨水，打字机对齐略有不均匀，并且许多粗的黑色密文条模糊了关键细节。准确包含 5 个编号部分：“1. 主题信息”、“2. 案例摘要”、“3. 详细信息”、“4. 同事/联系人”和“5. 备注”。在标题区域中，包含带有黑色密文栏的字段“CASE FILE NO.:”、带有 {argument name="date opening" default="March 14, 20___"} 的“DATE OPENED:”、带有黑色密文栏的“PREPARED BY:”、带有 {argument name="department" default="Internal Investigations Unit"} 的“DEPARTMENT:”和带有“CLASSIFICATION:”的字段{参数名称=“分类”默认=“机密”}。在第 1 部分中，包括 6 个字段：“姓名：”、“别名：”、“出生日期：”、“出生地点：”、“最后已知地址：”和“职业：”，每个字段后面都有不同长度的黑色密文条。在第 2 部分中，添加一小段打字的案例摘要文本，并在句子流中嵌入 5 个单独的黑色密文条。在第 3 部分中，添加第二段详细信息文本，并在该段落中嵌入 4 个单独的黑色密文条。在第 4 部分中，包括一个标有“名称”、“关系”和“注释”的 3 列表，其中包含 3 行填充内容，每个单元格内容均由黑色密文条覆盖。在第 5 部分中，添加关于敏感信息和未经授权的披露的简短警告句子。使用温暖的棕褐色灯光、文件夹边缘周围的柔和阴影、微妙的渐晕以及喜怒无常的黑色档案氛围。图像应该感觉真实、有触觉、神秘且略带灰尘，就像为犯罪惊悚片或世界构建道具拍摄的机密侦探案件档案一样。

items.title: Photoreal Alien in Dark Ravine
items.titleZh: A full-body cinematic portrait of a deeply unsettling humanoid alien standing alone in a dark rocky ravine, centered in the frame and facing forward in a neutral upright pose with both arms hanging low at its sides. The creature is extremely tall and emaciated, with elongated limbs, narrow shoulders, a sunken torso, visible rib-like structures, taut sinewy anatomy, long forearms, oversized hands with long thin fingers, and long digitigrade-looking feet planted on wet black ground. Its skin is hairless, slick, pale gray-beige with brownish fleshy undertones, semi-organic and biomechanical in appearance, with glossy damp highlights, leathery textures, stretched membranes, tendons, grooves, and subtle vein-like striations. The neck and upper chest are fused into a disturbing organic structure, with tendril-like folds and open channels running from the clavicle area upward into the head. The head is broad and mushroom- or hammer-shaped with a ridged crown and flared side lobes, giving a nonhuman silhouette; the face should feel unreadable and alien rather than cute or familiar. Place the figure in a narrow canyon of dark eroded stone, with 2 large foreground rock masses framing the subject on the left and right, and a misty cliff wall receding behind it. Use cold desaturated lighting, soft fog, damp surfaces, shallow atmospheric haze, and a grim monochrome palette of charcoal, slate, ash gray, and muted flesh tones. The mood should be uncanny, realistic, oppressive, and biologically plausible, like a high-end sci-fi horror still. Ultra-detailed photorealism, sharp texture on the creature, subtle depth of field, dramatic natural backlight from above, no clothing, no tools, no background creatures, no gore, no text.
items.promptZh: 一幅全身电影肖像，描绘了一个令人深感不安的人形外星人，独自站在黑暗的岩石峡谷中，位于画面中央，面朝前方，保持中立直立姿势，双臂低垂在身体两侧。这种生物非常高大且消瘦，四肢细长，肩膀狭窄，躯干凹陷，可见肋骨状结构，肌肉紧绷，前臂长，手指过大，手指细长，长长的脚踩在潮湿的黑色地面上，看起来像数字。它的皮肤无毛，光滑，浅灰米色，带有褐色肉质底色，外观半有机和生物力学，具有光泽潮湿的亮点，皮革般的纹理，拉伸的膜，肌腱，凹槽和微妙的静脉状条纹。颈部和上胸部融合成一个令人不安的有机结构，有卷须状的褶皱和从锁骨区域向上延伸到头部的开放通道。头部宽阔，呈蘑菇状或锤状，有脊状的头冠和喇叭形的侧叶，呈现出非人类的轮廓；这张脸应该让人感觉难以理解和陌生，而不是可爱或熟悉。将人物放置在一个由深色侵蚀石头组成的狭窄峡谷中，左右两侧有两块巨大的前景岩块构成了主体，后面是一堵雾蒙蒙的悬崖墙。使用冷的去饱和照明、柔和的雾、潮湿的表面、浅层大气薄雾，以及木炭、板岩、灰灰色和柔和的肉色调的冷酷单色调色板。气氛应该是怪诞的、现实的、压抑的，并且在生物学上是合理的，就像一部高端科幻恐怖片一样。超详细的照片写实主义，生物上清晰的纹理，微妙的景深，来自上方的戏剧性自然背光，没有衣服，没有工具，没有背景生物，没有血腥，没有文字。

items.title: Uncanny Full-Body Alien Portrait
items.titleZh: A hyper-realistic full-body studio portrait of a disturbing humanoid alien standing alone against a dark, smoky blue-black backdrop. The creature is extremely tall and emaciated, with elongated limbs, a narrow waist, long thin fingers, and oversized bare feet planted on a dim studio floor. Its skin is smooth but leathery and subtly wrinkled, colored deep charcoal blue with cold gray highlights, showing sharply defined ribs, sternum, collarbones, tendons, and stringy musculature across the chest, abdomen, shoulders, and neck. The torso is hairless and gaunt, with an eerie anatomical realism that feels biologically plausible but unsettling. The head is bald, enlarged, and slightly bulbous with a classic extraterrestrial silhouette, attached to an unnaturally long neck; keep the face obscure, unreadable, and deeply uncanny rather than expressive. Pose the alien front-facing with a slight three-quarter angle, arms hanging loosely at its sides, posture upright but subtly predatory, centered in frame from head to feet. Use low-key cinematic lighting with a faint cool rim light and soft overhead illumination that sculpts every crease and contour while keeping the overall scene dark, moody, and oppressive. Desaturated palette, ultra-detailed skin texture, photoreal creature design, sharp focus, high contrast, ominous atmosphere, no clothing, no props, no environment details beyond the shadowy studio background.

items.titleZh:
A dramatic Japanese fantasy anime movie poster, vertical one-sheet composition, centered on a beautiful teenage girl with very long flowing silver-white hair, glowing golden eyes, and a calm inviting smile, reaching one hand toward the viewer. She wears a black-and-white celestial dress with a fitted corset bodice, white chest panel, black ribbon lacing at the front, detached black sleeves with soft white ruffles, a black belt at the waist, layered skirt panels decorated with exactly 3 gold crescent moon ornaments, and a black choker with a gold crescent moon pendant. She also has exactly 1 gold crescent moon hair clip near her bangs. Behind her is a luminous night sky filled with stars, nebula-like clouds, and a huge eclipsed moon halo directly above her head, plus exactly 3 floating crescent-ring light effects around the left side of her hair. The background shows an ornate fantasy city with towering gothic palace architecture, spires, observatory-like structures, and glowing windows, all bathed in cool moonlight. Use a rich palette of deep indigo, violet, midnight blue, silver, and gold, with sparkles, magical particles, rim lighting, glossy highlights, and a slightly dense, painterly modern-anime poster finish.

Design it as a fully typeset Japanese film poster with elegant serif display typography in gold and white. At the very top, place a centered headline in Japanese: {argument name="headline text" default="夜が欠けるたび、忘れていた真実が目を覚ます。"}. On the right side, set a large vertical Japanese tagline in gold: {argument name="right-side tagline" default="最後の月光が消える前に、世界の記憶をつなぎ直せ。"}. On the left side, arrange 4 stacked blocks of smaller Japanese body copy separated by decorative divider lines and crescent motifs. Add a circular gold burst badge on the lower right with Japanese promotional text inside. Across the lower middle, place the large glowing Japanese title in ornate gold-white lettering: {argument name="movie title" default="月蝕のリグレット"}. Beneath the title, add a smaller centered Japanese subtitle line. Below that, place a horizontal feature line with exactly 3 gold-separated phrases in Japanese: "記憶", "月光", "観測魔法". At the very bottom, add 3 short Japanese teaser lines spread left, center, and right, and a large glowing release line centered under them: {argument name="release text" default="近日公開"}. The overall feeling is epic, melancholic, magical, celestial, romantic, and nostalgic, like a high-budget fantasy anime film poster.

items.title: Dark Fantasy Cliffside Outpost
items.titleZh: A dark fantasy matte painting of a bleak hilltop encampment overlooking a vast cursed wasteland at dusk. In the left foreground, a ragged hanging banner reads "The Pale Lodge Outpost" in large black hand-painted letters, attached to wooden poles and weathered by wind. Beside it stands a tall carved totem post topped with a black raven and draped with bones, skulls, and tattered ornaments. The camp itself contains 4 visible canvas tents: 2 large central tents, 1 medium tent on the left, and 1 smaller tent on the right, all in dirty beige fabric with black occult sigils painted on them, held by ropes, spikes, and crooked poles. Around the tents are 5 hooded human figures in dark robes, standing still like sentries or cultists. Near the center-left is a small campfire casting a faint orange glow. In the right foreground sit 2 brass-and-iron astronomical or ritual instruments on stone pedestals, resembling armillary spheres or astrolabes. The ground is uneven black rock at the edge of a cliff, with scattered stakes, lanterns, banners, and ritual posts. Beyond the outpost stretches a desolate valley of ash-colored plains, winding pale waterways, jagged rock spires, and distant mountain silhouettes. On the horizon, slightly right of center, a sinister dark castle rises from a lone hill. The sky is filled with enormous turbulent storm clouds, with 3 flying creatures or birds silhouetted in the distance and a break in the clouds casting cold, sickly light across the landscape. Use a grim, painterly, highly detailed style with muted sepia, charcoal, umber, and gray tones, dramatic atmospheric perspective, cinematic composition, and the mood of a foreboding fantasy frontier outpost at the edge of a dead world.
items.promptZh: 一幅黑暗奇幻的哑光画，描绘了一个荒凉的山顶营地，俯瞰着黄昏时广阔的被诅咒的荒地。在左侧前景中，一条破旧的悬挂横幅用黑色手绘大字写着“苍白旅馆前哨站”，挂在木杆上并被风吹得风化。它旁边矗立着一根高大的雕刻图腾柱，柱顶上刻着一只黑色的乌鸦，上面挂满了骨头、头骨和破烂的装饰品。营地本身有 4 个可见的帆布帐篷：2 个大型中央帐篷、1 个位于左侧的中型帐篷和 1 个位于右侧的较小帐篷，全部采用肮脏的米色织物制成，上面画有黑色神秘符号，由绳子、尖刺和弯曲的杆子固定。帐篷周围有 5 个身穿深色长袍、戴着兜帽的人形，一动不动地站着，就像哨兵或邪教徒一样。中左附近有一个小篝火，发出淡淡的橙色光芒。右侧前景的石座上放置着 2 个铜铁天文或仪式仪器，类似于浑天仪或星盘。地面是悬崖边上凹凸不平的黑色岩石，散落着木桩、灯笼、旗帜和礼柱。前哨站之外是一片荒凉的山谷，灰白色的平原、蜿蜒的苍白水道、锯齿状的岩石尖顶和远处的山脉轮廓。在地平线上，稍偏右的位置，一座险恶的黑暗城堡从一座孤山上拔地而起。天空中布满了巨大的风暴云，远处有 3 只飞行的生物或鸟类的剪影，云层的间隙在大地上投射出寒冷、病态的光线。采用冷酷、绘画般、高度细致的风格，搭配柔和的棕褐色、木炭色、棕褐色和灰色色调，戏剧性的大气视角、电影构图，以及死亡世界边缘不祥的奇幻边境前哨的氛围。

items.title: Epic Senna vs Prost Gladiator Poster
items.titleZh: An epic cinematic poster in a dark golden bronze palette, styled like a mythic gladiator movie poster merged with vintage Formula 1 iconography. Two legendary rival drivers face away from each other in mirrored side-profile bust portraits at the top half of the image, one on the left inspired by Ayrton Senna and one on the right inspired by Alain Prost, both depicted as heroic Roman gladiators with weathered bronze armor, dramatic shoulder plates, and racing colors draped as cloaks. The left figure wears green, yellow, and blue accents, and the right figure wears blue, white, and red accents. Their faces are mostly in shadow, lit by intense backlight through storm clouds, creating a solemn, monumental mood. Behind each driver hangs 1 vertical banner, for a total of 2 banners: the left banner is dark green with a large gold S, the text "SENNA", "#12", and a cursive signature; the right banner is dark blue with a large gold P, the text "PROST", "#1", and a cursive signature. Centered near the top, in elegant serif French text, place the line "DEUX LÉGENDES. UN SEUL TRÔNE." with a small gold Formula 1 emblem and laurel motif below it. In the central sky, add 2 stacked lines of French text reading "RIVAUX SUR LA PISTE." and "LÉGENDES POUR TOUJOURS." The main title dominates the middle in huge metallic serif lettering: "{argument name="headline text" default="SENNA vs PROST"}", with a sword-like vertical separator for "vs". Beneath it, a subtitle in French reads "LE COMBAT ULTIME DE LA F1". The lower half shows a colossal Roman colosseum packed with spectators, flags, arches, dust, smoke, and dramatic perspective lines converging on the center. At the exact center of the arena stands 1 large victory banner with the words "VICTOIRE GLOIRE HONNEUR" in gold. In the foreground, place 2 front-facing late-1980s Formula 1 cars charging toward the viewer on a dirt-covered arena floor, throwing dust. The left car is associated with Senna and features red-and-white Marlboro-inspired livery, Shell branding, and the number 12 on the nose, with the driver wearing a yellow helmet. The right car is associated with Prost and features matching red-and-white Marlboro-inspired livery, Shell branding, and the number 1 on the nose, with the driver wearing a white helmet. At the very bottom, add the line "1988. 1989. 1990." and below it "L’HISTOIRE S’ÉCRIT À PLUS DE 300 KM/H." Include a small ornamental laurel decoration under the final line. Use hyper-detailed textures, dramatic storm clouds, god rays, flying dust, intense contrast, symmetrical composition, ultra-polished poster design, heroic scale, and a timeless legendary atmosphere.
items.promptZh: 史诗般的电影海报采用深金色青铜调色板，风格像神话角斗士电影海报，与复古一级方程式图像融为一体。图像上半部分的镜像侧半身像中，两位传奇对手车手面对面，左边一位的灵感来自埃尔顿·塞纳，右边一位的灵感来自阿兰·普罗斯特，两人都被描绘成英雄的罗马角斗士，身穿风化的青铜盔甲、引人注目的肩甲和披着斗篷的赛车颜色。左边的人物穿着绿色、黄色和蓝色的口音，右边的人物穿着蓝色、白色和红色的口音。他们的脸大多处于阴影中，透过暴风雨的云层被强烈的背光照亮，营造出一种庄严、不朽的气氛。每个车手身后悬挂 1 条垂直横幅，总共 2 条横幅：左侧横幅为深绿色，带有金色大 S、文字“SENNA”、“#12”和草书签名；右边的横幅是深蓝色的，上面有一个大的金色 P、文字“PROST”、“#1”和一个草书签名。在靠近顶部的中心位置，以优雅的衬线法文文本写着“DEUX LÉGENDES. UN SEUL TRÔNE”。其下方有一个小型金色一级方程式徽章和月桂树图案。在中央天空中，添加 2 行堆叠的法语文字：“RIVAUX SUR LA PISTE”。和“传奇 POUR TOUJOURS”。主标题以巨大的金属衬线字体占据中间位置：“{argument name=”headline text”default=”SENNA vs PROST”}”，并带有一个剑状垂直分隔符“vs”。其下方的法语副标题为“LE COMBAT ULTIME DE LA F1”。下半部分展示了一座巨大的罗马斗兽场，里面挤满了观众、旗帜、拱门、灰尘、烟雾，以及汇聚在中心的戏剧性透视线。竞技场的正中央矗立着一面巨大的胜利旗帜，上面写着金色的“VICTOIRE GLOIRE HONNEUR”字样。在前景中，两辆正面朝上的 20 世纪 80 年代末一级方程式赛车在脏兮兮的竞技场地板上向观众冲去，扬起灰尘。左边的车与塞纳有关，具有红白万宝路风格的涂装、壳牌品牌和车头的数字 12，驾驶员戴着黄色头盔。右边的汽车与普罗斯特相关，具有匹配的红白万宝路风格的制服、壳牌品牌和鼻子上的数字 1，驾驶员戴着白色头盔。在最底部添加一行“1988.1989.1990”。其下方为“L’HISTOIRE S’ÉCRIT À PLUS DE 300 KM/H”。在最后一行下方添加一个小的装饰性月桂树装饰。使用超细致的纹理、戏剧性的风暴云、神光、飞扬的尘埃、强烈的对比、对称的构图、超精致的海报设计、英雄的规模和永恒的传奇氛围。

items.title: Studio Portrait With Strawberry Ice Cream
items.titleZh: A polished studio portrait of a glamorous pop-star-like woman from the chest up, centered against a smooth neutral gray backdrop. She has {argument name="hair color" default="jet black"} long loose wavy hair with a middle part, glossy shine, and soft volume falling over both shoulders. Her face is mostly hidden behind the ice cream cone she is holding up in front of her mouth and lower face, creating a playful fashion-editorial composition. She wears a white ribbed tank top with wide straps and a single visible sparkling stud earring. In her hand is 1 waffle cone topped with 1 large scoop of pink strawberry ice cream with dark red berry swirls and slight melting texture. items.title: Storm Wizard Casting Lightning
items.titleZh: A dramatic dark-fantasy portrait of an elderly wizard standing in a stormy wasteland under a black, cloud-choked sky. He wears a tall, weathered pointed hat with a brown leather band and a tiny metal clasp, and a heavy dark blue-gray robe with wide sleeves. His face is mostly hidden in shadow beneath the hat brim, with long strands of glowing {argument name="accent hair color" default="electric blue"} hair peeking out at the sides and a very long flowing silver-white beard reaching down his chest. The wizard thrusts his left hand toward the camera in a powerful forced-perspective pose, fingers spread, conjuring a bright orb of blue-white magical energy in his palm with crackling lightning arcs wrapping around the hand and sleeve. In his right arm he clutches a large ancient leather spellbook with worn corners, metal fittings, embossed arcane markings on the cover, and a few pages visible. items.title: Vintage Kyoto Travel Poster
items.titleZh: A vintage travel poster for {argument name="destination name" default="KYOTO"}, Japan, designed in a nostalgic mid-century tourism style with a faded paper texture, softly worn edges, and warm sun-aged colors. Use a vertical poster layout with rounded corners and a cream border. At the top, place the large headline {argument name="headline text" default="KYOTO"} in oversized elegant red serif letters, with “JAPAN” centered below in dark blue serif type and thin decorative divider lines. Add an italic tagline beneath it reading {argument name="tagline text" default="Timeless Beauty. Endless Memories."}. The main image should show a dramatic low-angle view of a traditional five-story Japanese pagoda in vivid vermilion red with dark wooden eaves and black railings, standing on a stone base with a wooden walkway in the foreground. Surround the pagoda with green wooded hills, a bright blue sky, and soft cream-colored clouds. On the left side, include a vertical red label with white Japanese characters reading “京都、日本”. Also add a blooming cherry blossom branch entering from the left, with clusters of pale pink flowers. In the upper right corner, include a postage stamp featuring a pagoda silhouette in muted red tones, partially overlapped by a circular postal cancellation mark reading “KYOTO JAPAN” with the kanji “京都” in the center and a few wavy postmark lines extending rightward. At the bottom, add a centered vintage footer slogan in serif capitals reading {argument name="footer text" default="DISCOVER TRADITION. EMBRACE KYOTO."}. The overall look should feel romantic, collectible, slightly distressed, and like a classic Japanese tourism print from the 1950s or 1960s.

Keep the app UI recognizable on the phone display, but place it in a realistic lifestyle context: a vineyard worker in the foreground holding a smartphone that shows the app, with vineyard rows, mountains, and a few workers in the background under natural daylight. Design the full page as a Spanish-language magazine cover with a refined agricultural-business aesthetic in green, cream, and earthy tones. Add a large masthead at the top reading “REVISTA CAMPO FUTURO”, a thin top strapline with 3 items separated by vertical bars: “Especial Viñas de Chile”, “Innovación agrícola”, and “Abril 2026”, plus a subtitle line beneath the masthead: “Agricultura, innovación y gestión rural”. On the left, add a green section tag reading “TECNOLOGÍA AGRÍCOLA” and a bold stacked main cover headline: “La app con IA que está revolucionando el campo”, followed by a short deck about Kimün replacing the traditional notebook and giving real-time control to vineyards and agricultural businesses. Add a circular callout badge mentioning a special feature about Kimün as an intelligent field notebook with AI. Include 2 bottom teaser photos: one close-up of the worker holding the phone in the vineyard with page label “p.18” and a caption about field diagnosis and cellphone alerts, and one small group scene with 3 people reviewing the app together with page label “p.24” and a caption about connected field teams, voice, records, and instant costs. items.title: Satirical Spanish Sports Front Page
items.titleZh: A satirical Spanish sports newspaper front page designed like a tabloid cover, full-frame and perfectly frontal, on slightly aged off-white newsprint with subtle paper texture, faint stains, and narrow black border lines. The masthead is a huge red SPORT logo across the top on a bright yellow banner. In the upper right, include 1 small interview promo box with a headshot of a footballer and the text block in Spanish: “ENTREVISTA CUBARSÍ ‘ESTOY PARA COSAS GRANDES’”. Under the masthead, add a yellow strip with bold black text “EXCLUSIVA MUNDIAL” and a small red lightning bolt. The main headline dominates the page in gigantic black condensed uppercase letters over 2 lines: “LAMILE FICHA POR LA PEÑA DEL BINGO”. Beneath it, add the subheadline in italic black Spanish text: “El crack pide dorsal el 10 y bocadillo de calamares en el contrato”. The main photo occupies the left-center and lower-middle of the page: a young footballer seen mostly from the back wearing a Barcelona home jersey in blue and garnet stripes, with the name “LAMILE” and the number “10” in large yellow lettering, standing in a celebratory stadium scene with confetti, bright lights, blurred fans, and people around him. He is holding or presenting a large bingo card board with the word “BINGO” at the top and “BINGO!” at the bottom. On the right side, create a vertical sidebar with 4 stacked content blocks: first, a photo of a calamari sandwich on a plate with the caption “El motivo del fichaje”; second, a red info box listing 3 humorous transfer facts in yellow and white text, exactly “EDAD: muy joven”, “FICHAJE: 4 cartones”, and “CLÁUSULA: una partida de parchís”; third, a quotes column with 3 stacked mini-items, each with a small portrait and Spanish caption: “XAVI: ‘No me lo esperaba, pero respeto’”, “LAPORTA: ‘Renegociaremos en el próximo bingo’”, and “EL VESTUARIO: Le preparan línea y bingo de bienvenida”; fourth, a small motorsport teaser at the bottom with a driver image and the text “FÓRMULA 1 ALONSO SUEÑA CON EL PODIO EN YEDA”. Along the bottom strip, include 3 small teaser panels: 1 woman footballer holding a trophy with the text “CHAMPIONS FEMENINA LA REINA AITANA QUIERE OTRA CORONA”, 1 basketball panel with two Barça players and the text “BÁSQUET EL BARÇA, A UN PAS DE LA FINAL FOUR”, and the Formula 1 teaser panel already integrated at the right edge. Add tiny newspaper metadata below the masthead on the left in Spanish, including issue number, date, and price, such as “Nº 16.743 MIÉRCOLES 22 DE ABRIL DE 2026 2,00 EUROS”. The overall style should be hyper-realistic printed newspaper cover photography and editorial layout, with authentic magazine typography, strong black headlines, saturated sports-photo colors, comedic transfer-rumor parody tone, and seamless believable print design.

items.title: Futuristic Mumbai Sunset Skyline
items.titleZh: A cinematic ultra-detailed wide-angle cityscape of {argument name="city name" default="Mumbai"} reimagined as a futuristic megacity at sunset, viewed from an elevated overlook above the coastline. The skyline is packed with dozens of towering futuristic skyscrapers of varied silhouettes, including 6 especially prominent supertall towers with sleek glass facades, sharp angular forms, and neon accents, mixed with dense mid-rise urban buildings below. On the right side, a long sea bridge resembling the Bandra-Worli Sea Link curves dramatically from the foreground into the distance over calm coastal water, with flowing streams of headlights and taillights. The sun sits low near the horizon over the Arabian Sea, casting glowing golden reflections across the water and bathing the scene in intense orange, amber, pink, and magenta light under richly layered clouds. In the lower left foreground, include a grand historic domed building inspired by South Mumbai heritage architecture, warmly illuminated, juxtaposed against the futuristic skyline; above it, add a hovering circular UFO-like platform with blue light. Also place 2 visible illuminated billboards in the lower-left and center-right urban area: one large sign reading "MUMBAI", "मुंबई", and "THE CITY OF DREAMS", and one smaller sign reading "NAVI MUMBAI". Add 1 small flying vehicle or drone near the central towers. Place large clean white uppercase text near the top center reading {argument name="top text" default="CHATGPT"}. The overall mood is epic, aspirational, glossy, highly detailed, vibrant, cinematic sci-fi urban fantasy, with atmospheric haze, glowing windows, reflective glass, dramatic contrast, and a polished concept-art finish.

items.title: Censored Point-Cloud Portrait
items.titleZh: A minimalist monochrome portrait made entirely from millions of tiny white point-cloud dots on a pitch-black background, showing 1 adult man from the chest up in a formal dark blazer and light collared dress shirt. The subject is centered slightly to the right, facing forward with a subtle three-quarter turn, with neatly combed short hair and one visible ear sharply defined by dense lidar-like particles. Render the figure as raw 3D scan data mixed with topological contour logic: ultra-dense stippling, precise geometric dot placement, faint isoline structure, and clean depth shaping across the hair, jacket lapels, collar, neck, and shoulders. Keep the face intentionally obscured by 1 large vertical rectangular censor block in dark gray to black, perfectly centered over the facial area from forehead to below the nose, creating a stark privacy-mask effect. Use matte texture, crisp edges, sharp focus, high contrast, no glow, no bloom, no neon, no fog, no motion blur, no chromatic aberration, no painterly strokes. Add 1 small four-point sparkle icon in light gray in the bottom-right corner. The overall image should feel mathematical, forensic, and futuristic, like a high-resolution lidar scan portrait in 8k.
items.promptZh: 一幅极简主义的单色肖像，完全由漆黑背景上数百万个微小的白色点云点组成，展示了一名成年男子的胸部以上，穿着正式的深色西装外套和浅领正装衬衫。对象的中心稍微偏右，面朝前，微妙地转了四分之三，短发梳理得整整齐齐，一只可见的耳朵被密集的激光雷达状颗粒清晰地界定出来。将图形渲染为与拓扑轮廓逻辑混合的原始 3D 扫描数据：超密集点画、精确的几何点放置、微弱的等值线结构以及头发、夹克翻领、衣领、颈部和肩部的清晰深度塑造。用 1 个深灰色到黑色的大型垂直矩形检查块故意遮挡面部，完全位于从前额到鼻子下方的面部区域的中心，形成鲜明的隐私面罩效果。使用哑光纹理，清晰的边缘，锐利的焦点，高对比度，无辉光，无晕染，无霓虹灯，无雾，无运动模糊，无色差，无绘画笔触。在右下角添加 1 个浅灰色的四点闪光小图标。整体图像应该给人一种数学、法证和未来感，就像 8k 高分辨率激光雷达扫描肖像一样。

items.title: Anime Shrine Princess in Palace
items.titleZh: A highly detailed anime-style portrait of a seated shrine maiden princess in an opulent traditional Japanese palace interior, centered in a vertical composition. She is a young woman with very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="mint green"} hair fading into yellow-green at the tips, soft pink accent strands, straight bangs, and ornate hair ornaments including 2 tall faceted crystal fox ears, 1 pink flower cluster, and 2 small ribbon clips. Her face is intentionally obscured with a soft square blur. She wears an elaborate layered kimono and dress ensemble in deep indigo, violet, magenta, white, and gold, with rich brocade, floral embroidery, lace sleeves, tassels, cords, and jeweled obi ornaments. items.title: Washington Crossing Style Winter Boat Scene
items.titleZh: A cinematic historical scene at dusk on a freezing river crossing in winter, showing a crowded wooden rowboat packed with exactly 11 colonial-era soldiers and boatmen pushing through dark icy water filled with floating chunks of ice. In the center stands 1 commanding figure, upright and resolute, wearing a dark navy or black heavy cloak draped over a light tan military uniform and a black tricorne hat, evoking an 18th-century general. Around him are 10 other men seated or crouched low in the boat, dressed in weathered Revolutionary War-era clothing: dark coats, wool caps, cloaks, scarves, leather straps, and tricorne hats, with several gripping long wooden oars and one visible musket angled upward behind the central figure. The mood is grim, cold, and heroic, with wet clothing, snow dusting, pale breathy atmosphere, and a stormy blue-gray sky. The river is wide and partially frozen, with a dark tree-lined shoreline in the distance and a few tiny warm lights glowing on the far bank. Composition is frontal and tightly framed from just above the bow of the boat, making the viewer feel inside the freezing crossing. Use low-key lighting, muted desaturated colors, deep shadows, damp textures, realism, dramatic historical painting energy blended with cinematic photorealism, ultra-detailed fabric, wood grain, ice, and mist.

Add layered delicate necklaces including a small pendant and a silver cross, plus a bracelet or watch on one wrist. Place a classic white Greek church with a bright {argument name="dome color" default="blue"} dome in the upper right background, and frame the right side of the image with vivid {argument name="flower color" default="magenta pink"} bougainvillea in full bloom. items.title: Minimalist Saint Augustine Book Cover
items.titleZh: A minimalist classical book cover in vertical format on a warm ivory or parchment background. At the top center, set the title in elegant large dark navy serif type across 2 lines: {argument name="title text" default="La Ciudad de Dios"}. Beneath it, centered with generous spacing, place a small gold phi symbol. In the upper-middle area, draw a delicate thin-line gold illustration of a fortified circular heavenly city with exactly 8 visible outer towers or gate structures, crenelated walls, and compact classical buildings inside, including a central dome. From the bottom center of this city, extend a soft vertical gold beam of light downward. In the lower-middle area, create thin dark navy line art of earthly classical ruins: the Roman Colosseum on the left, a large Greek or Roman temple with a triangular pediment and a long row of columns on the right, a broken fallen column in front, a small stone block near it, and an arched ruin structure spanning the lower left. Keep the composition symmetrical and airy, with lots of empty space, refined editorial balance, and subtle contrast between gold heavenly imagery and dark navy earthly architecture. At the bottom center, place the author name in matching dark navy serif type: {argument name="author name" default="San Agustín de Hipona"}. Clean premium literary design, sacred philosophy aesthetic, no extra text, no texture-heavy effects, no photographic elements.

Center the title near the top in large classical serif typography, dark navy blue, with refined spacing and a literary feel. Directly below it, place 1 small eight-point star in gold. In the upper middle, illustrate a heavenly walled city floating on clouds, drawn as delicate gold line art: a symmetrical sacred city with 1 central domed cathedral, many clustered towers, spires, walls, and gates, surrounded by soft clouds, with radiant sunburst lines spreading outward behind it. From the central gate of the celestial city, send down 1 vertical column of thin golden light beams toward the lower half of the cover. In the bottom third, depict an earthly ancient Roman landscape in fine blue-gray ink line art: 5 main architectural ruins and monuments arranged horizontally, including a long arcade on the left, a classical temple with columns near left-center, a domed building in the middle, a bell tower and surrounding ruins near right-center, and a colosseum-like ruin on the far right, plus a broken fallen column drum in the right foreground and sparse shrubs and ground texture. Place the author name {argument name="author name" default="SAN AGUSTÍN DE HIPONA"} centered at the bottom in spaced small caps serif, dark navy blue. Use only 3 visible text elements total: the title, the author name, and no subtitle. Palette limited to ivory, gold, and dark navy blue, with precise engraved linework and a sacred, timeless, classical theological mood.

items.prompt: Create a glossy, hyper-saturated social media ad poster for a futuristic beauty product launch, designed like a Canva marketing graphic. The composition is a single widescreen promotional banner centered on a cyan-to-purple gradient background, with rounded corners and a vivid neon pink color palette. Inside the banner, show a young woman from the chest up in a glowing sci-fi tunnel made of concentric pink and white light rings. Her face is obscured by a soft square blur block, but her hair is styled in two small buns, and she wears hoop earrings, layered chain necklaces, a metallic silver top, and an iridescent pink holographic jacket. She extends one hand toward the camera holding a clear lip balm tube close to the lens, creating strong foreground perspective. The tube label reads “GLOW MODE Lip Balm.” At the top center, large neon headline text reads “GLOW MODE” with a script subtitle “Lip Balm,” and below it a smaller line reads “JUICY SHINE. HYDRATING CARE. ZERO STICKINESS.” In the upper left corner, add a handwritten neon note reading “NEW!” In the upper right corner, place an orange rounded sticker with white text reading “gpt-image-2,” plus a small orange pointer tab beneath it. On the right side of the banner, include 2 circular callout badges: a pink starburst badge that says “ONLY $14.99” and a black glowing circular badge that says “VIRAL ON TikTok 2M+ views.” At the lower right, show 2 product display elements: one upright open lip balm tube with wand applicator beside it, and one whole sliced peach plus one cut mango half with green leaves, all sitting on a glossy reflective surface with pink light swirls. Along the lower center, add 3 feature icons with labels: a droplet icon labeled “HYALURONIC HYDRATION,” a fruit icon labeled “PEACH MANGO SCENT,” and a bunny icon labeled “100% VEGAN & CRUELTY-FREE.” In the lower left inside the banner, add a vertical stack of 3 social buttons with platform icons and handles: TikTok with “#GlowMode,” Instagram with “@LunaBeatty,” and Snapchat with “@LunaGlow.” Beneath them place 1 glowing QR code card, and next to it handwritten script text reading “Shop Now!” with an arrow pointing toward the QR code. Outside the banner at the bottom left, place a tilted teal rounded label reading “Canva AI,” with a small teal paper-plane style accent nearby. Add glossy reflections, lens flares, bloom, neon rim lighting, sparkles, and polished ad-design styling throughout, with crisp commercial product photography mixed with futuristic graphic design.

items.title: Chaotic Road Trip Comedy Poster
items.titleZh: A bright, chaotic theatrical comedy movie poster in a polished Hollywood one-sheet style, vertical composition, with a retro yellow Mini Cooper speeding straight toward the viewer down a sunny palm-lined city street. The car is packed with exactly 5 vacationing friends: 2 visible in the front seats, 2 partially visible squeezed in the back, and 1 man sprawled on the roof luggage, pointing dramatically forward with a wild grin. Everyone wears colorful casual vacation clothes, including tropical prints, relaxed shirts, and sun hats. The scene feels loud, reckless, and fun. On the roof are stacked suitcases and travel bags. A police car with flashing lights chases from the rear right background. On the left side, a crooked wooden signpost has exactly 3 signs reading "BEACH", "MOUNTAINS", and "WHAT COULD GO WRONG?". A squawking seagull perches on top of the signpost. On the right side, a giant roadside donut shop sign reads "DONUT" and a folded paper map flies through the air. The street is full of motion blur, dust, debris, and tire energy, with a saturated blue sky and fluffy clouds above. At the very top, place exactly 4 actor names in black condensed caps: "DAVE JOHNSON", "LILY WANG", "KEVIN HARTLEY", and "AMY CHEN". Beneath that, add a stacked tagline in bold caps: "THEY CAME. THEY SAW." in dark navy, and "THEY MESSED EVERYTHING UP." in red. The main title dominates the upper middle in huge playful 3D typography: "{argument name="movie title" default="VACATION MODE"}", with "VACATION" in bright yellow and "MODE" in white, heavy blue shadowing, and the O replaced by a simple smiling face wearing sunglasses. Add small doodle-like yellow accent marks around the title. Across the lower right of the title, place a tilted hot-pink banner reading "A COMEDY ABOUT BAD IDEAS & GOOD TIMES" with a hand-drawn curved arrow pointing down. The car license plate reads "NO PLAN ALL FUN". Near the bottom, add a glowing pull-quote in yellow: "LAUGH-OUT-LOUD FUNNY!" and below it "- MOVIE BUZZ". At the bottom center, add the release line "ONLY IN THEATERS" and then "{argument name="release date" default="JUNE 20"}" in large bold yellow caps. Add tiny legal credits along the very bottom edge and small production logos in the corners, including "GOOD TIME FILMS" on the lower left and "NO PLAN ALL FUN" on the lower right. Use high-contrast lighting, exaggerated perspective, glossy commercial poster finish, vibrant summer colors, and a goofy road-trip comedy tone.
items.promptZh: 一张明亮、混乱的戏剧喜剧电影海报，采用抛光的好莱坞单页风格、垂直构图，一辆复古的黄色 Mini Cooper 在阳光明媚的棕榈树成荫的城市街道上笔直向观众驶来。车上正好挤满了 5 位度假的朋友：其中 2 个人坐在前排座位上，2 个人挤在后排，部分可见，还有 1 个人趴在车顶行李箱上，夸张地指着前方，咧着嘴笑。每个人都穿着色彩缤纷的休闲度假服装，包括热带印花、休闲衬衫和太阳帽。这个场景给人一种喧闹、鲁莽、有趣的感觉。屋顶上堆放着行李箱和旅行包。一辆闪着灯光的警车从右后背景追赶。左侧有一个弯曲的木制路标，上面正好有 3 个标牌，分别写着“海滩”、“山脉”和“什么地方出错了？”。一只嘎嘎叫的海鸥栖息在路标顶部。右侧，路边有一个巨大的甜甜圈店招牌，上面写着“DONUT”，一张折叠的纸质地图在空中飞舞。街道上充满了运动模糊、灰尘、碎片和轮胎能量，上面是饱和的蓝天和蓬松的云彩。在最顶部，正好放置 4 个黑色大写字母的演员名字：“DAVE JOHNSON”、“LILY WANG”、“KEVIN HARTLEY”和“AMY CHEN”。在其下方，添加一条用粗体大写字母堆叠的标语：“他们来了。他们看到了。”深海军蓝，“他们把一切都搞砸了。”红色。主标题以巨大的俏皮 3D 字体占据了中上部：“{argument name=”movie title” default=”VACATION MODE”}”，“VACATION”为亮黄色，“MODE”为白色，深蓝色阴影，O 被一个戴着墨镜的简单笑脸取代。在标题周围添加类似涂鸦的黄色小强调标记。在标题的右下角，放置一个倾斜的粉红色横幅，上面写着“关于坏想法和好时光的喜剧”，并带有一个向下的手绘弯曲箭头。汽车牌照上写着“NO PLAN ALL FUN”。在底部附近，添加一条黄色的发光引言：“大声笑，有趣！”以及其下方的“- MOVIE BUZZ”。在底部中心，添加发布行“ONLY IN THEATERS”，然后添加粗体黄色大写字母“{argument name="release date" default="JUNE 20"}”。在最底部边缘添加微小的法律制作人员，并在角落添加小制作徽标，包括左下角的“GOOD TIME FILMS”和右下角的“NO PLAN ALL FUN”。使用高对比度的灯光、夸张的视角、光滑的商业海报效果、充满活力的夏日色彩和愚蠢的公路旅行喜剧基调。

items.title: WWII D-Day Cinematic Poster
items.titleZh: A gritty cinematic World War II movie poster in a vertical one-sheet layout, designed like a modern prestige war film advertisement. At the top, two centered tagline lines in condensed uppercase text read {argument name="top tagline" default="COURAGE. BROTHERHOOD. SACRIFICE."} and {argument name="second tagline" default="VICTORY COMES AT A PRICE."}. The main composition features 4 American WWII soldiers in the foreground wearing dark olive uniforms and large netted M1 helmets: 1 dominant central soldier shown from the chest up, facing forward, flanked by 3 slightly smaller soldiers receding behind him, one on the left and 2 on the right. Their faces are shadowed, dirty, battle-worn, and dramatic, with intense low-key lighting and smoky backlight. Behind them, a stormy war-torn sky filled with heavy smoke columns, sparks, embers, and 2 aircraft groups: 1 group of 3 planes on the upper left and 1 group of 5 planes on the upper right. In the middle, a small centered line of text says {argument name="based on text" default="INSPIRED BY TRUE EVENTS"}. Below it, an enormous distressed title in bold block letters reads {argument name="movie title" default="D-DAY"}, with a star used as the separator between the two D letters. Under the title, a red condensed date line reads {argument name="date text" default="JUNE 6, 1944"}. The lower half shows the D-Day beach landing from the viewpoint inside an open landing craft, with 2 dark metal ramp walls framing the left and right edges. In the surf, exactly 8 soldiers are wading toward shore with rifles and packs, surrounded by Czech hedgehog beach obstacles, rough water, smoke, distant fires, and an embattled coastline under bombardment. At the very bottom is a dense strip of tiny production credits, and beneath that a bold red release line reading {argument name="release text" default="COMING SOON"}, followed by a smaller white line, "HONOR THEIR SACRIFICE.". Color palette is charcoal gray, steel blue, muddy brown, and fire orange with red accent typography. His face is partially obscured in shadow for a mysterious, menacing look. Behind him is a dark modern city skyline at night under stormy clouds, with 1 helicopter in the upper right sky and 1 massive fireball explosion on the right side near the buildings, sending smoke, sparks, and debris into the air. Across the very top, small red uppercase text reads {argument name="top tagline" default="REVENGE IS HIS MISSION"}. On the left-center area, add a stacked white uppercase tagline in 4 lines: {argument name="left tagline" default="THE PAST TOOK EVERYTHING. HE'LL TAKE EVERYTHING BACK."}, styled as 2 short blocks separated by thin red accent lines. Place the main title huge across the lower middle, with 2 words: the first word in enormous distressed metallic-white block letters, and the second word in slightly smaller bold red uppercase letters. In the bottom third, show 1 lone male figure from behind standing in the middle of a wet reflective street, holding a pistol, facing the burning city. Surround him with 4 police vehicles total, 2 on the left and 2 on the right, with flashing lights, plus 2 additional helicopters in the distant sky near the horizon, making 3 helicopters total in the full poster. items.title: Sengoku vs Sangoku Crossover Poster
items.titleZh:
A dramatic ultra-detailed vertical anime key visual poster showing a crossover war between Japan’s Sengoku era and China’s Three Kingdoms era, split exactly down the center by a glowing vertical beam of light. The left half is themed in crimson, magenta, ember orange, and cherry blossom pink, representing {argument name="left faction title" default="日本戦国"}; the right half is themed in jade green, teal, cyan, gold, and stormy blue, representing {argument name="right faction title" default="中国三国"}. At the center, large vertical Japanese calligraphy reads {argument name="center slogan" default="時空を越え、宿命が交錯する。"}. The composition is dense, cinematic, and symmetrical, like a premium game or movie crossover poster, with dozens of sparks, petals, glowing particles, motion streaks, and layered background architecture.

On the left side, depict 4 distinct Sengoku-themed warriors. At the top left, a stern samurai warlord in ornate black and deep red armor with gold trim, long dark hair tied high and blowing in the wind, shown in a powerful upper-body portrait facing inward; behind him are sakura blossoms, banners, and stacked Japanese castles illuminated with neon-magenta highlights. Mid-left, show 1 battle-hardened older general with wild silver hair, heavy layered armor, and a fierce glare, partially emerging from the fortress cityscape. Lower-left, show 1 aggressive crimson-clad warrior lunging forward with sweeping cloth, horned or antler-like helmet ornamentation, and dynamic red-black armor. At the bottom-left foreground, show 1 dominant swordsman in demonic samurai armor with a crescent-moon helmet crest and glowing red eyes, gripping a katana angled diagonally downward, surrounded by embers and petals. A vertical banner near the upper-left edge displays the Japanese text 日本戦国.

On the right side, depict 4 distinct Three Kingdoms-themed heroes. At the top right, show 1 regal strategist-emperor figure in elaborate blue, black, and gold ceremonial armor with a tall crown-like headdress, shown in upper-body profile facing inward; behind him rises a luminous spectral dragon made of water, cloud, and light. Mid-right, show 1 long-bearded green-robed general with a tall headpiece and lamellar armor, solemn and heroic, framed by neon-lit city structures and swirling magical energy. Slightly below center-right, show 1 elegant strategist-scholar holding an opened feather fan, wearing layered robes and gold ornaments, calm and calculating. At the lower-right edge, show 1 roaring armored warrior with a fierce expression and windblown hair. In the bottom-right foreground, make the dominant figure a green-and-gold armored hero extending a glowing jade-green sword toward the viewer, with flowing robes and luminous energy ribbons curling around the blade. A vertical banner near the upper-right edge displays the Chinese text 中国三国.

Blend historical East Asian war aesthetics with futuristic cyberpunk megacity elements: Japanese pagodas and fortresses on the left, neon skyscrapers and glowing urban lights across both halves, flying fortress silhouettes and distant airborne warships in the sky, magical lightning, smoke, and storm clouds overhead. The sky transitions from sunset violet and rose on the left to stormy turquoise and silver on the right. Use hyper-detailed painterly anime illustration, intricate armor textures, metallic reflections, volumetric lighting, high contrast, epic scale, and intense atmosphere.

At the bottom, add huge stylized title typography: on the left, massive fiery kanji 戦国 with the romanization SENGOKU beneath it; in the middle, a metallic gold VS; on the right, massive jade-glowing kanji 三国 with the romanization SANGOKU beneath it. Below that, add a smaller centered subtitle line reading SENGOKU VS SANGOKU, and beneath it a Japanese tagline: {argument name="bottom tagline" default="時空を超え、英雄たちの戦いが始まる。"}. Poster layout, polished commercial promotional art, extremely detailed, high-impact, collectible poster aesthetic.

items.title: Apple macOS Redesign Promo Mockup
items.titleZh: A polished Apple-style macOS promotional desktop mockup shown as a full-screen screenshot, with a soft pastel dawn wallpaper of layered purple-blue rolling hills under a pale peach and lavender sky. items.title: Found-Footage Office Horror Snapshot
items.titleZh: A gritty found-footage horror photo taken inside a dim, cramped security office at night, shot with a direct on-camera flash and slight film grain. In the foreground are exactly 2 young women, both partially cropped by the frame and both with their faces heavily blurred into rectangular smudges for privacy. The woman on the left has long dark hair and wears a black top, turned slightly away from camera. The woman on the right has long platinum blonde hair, a low-cut black top, and is holding a black flashlight angled upward in her right hand. Between them in the lower center foreground is 1 small black metal desk fan with visible circular grill. The background reveals a narrow open doorway centered in the image, leading into almost complete darkness. Standing deep inside that doorway is a terrifying rabbit animatronic silhouette with glowing eyes, long upright ears, a huge toothy grin, and faintly visible metallic body details, barely illuminated so it emerges from the shadows. The office walls are off-white and worn, with a black-and-white checker stripe and a thin red stripe running horizontally across the room. On the left wall is 1 colorful “CELEBRATE!” poster featuring animatronic characters, plus 1 smaller character drawing sheet pinned nearby, and 1 black walkie-talkie standing upright on a surface. Near the doorway is 1 silver desk lamp. On the right side are 2 sheets of paper clipped to the wall and a gray filing cabinet in shadow. The door is ajar with the handle visible. Composition should feel like a candid party snapshot turning into a horror scene, with harsh flash-lit foreground subjects, deep black shadows, analog noise, muted colors, unsettling realism, and the hidden monster in the center background as the main scare.
items.promptZh: 一张在夜间昏暗、狭窄的保安办公室内拍摄的粗糙恐怖照片，使用机内闪光灯和轻微的胶片颗粒拍摄。前景中正好有两名年轻女性，她们的部分轮廓都被画面剪掉了，为了保护隐私，她们的脸都被严重模糊成矩形污迹。左边的女人有一头深色长发，穿着黑色上衣，稍微背对着镜头。右边的女人有着一头白金金色的长发，穿着低胸的黑色上衣，右手拿着一支向上倾斜的黑色手电筒。在它们之间的下部中央前景是 1 个黑色金属小台扇，带有可见的圆形格栅。背景显示出图像中心有一个狭窄的敞开的门口，通向几乎完全黑暗的地方。站在门口深处的是一个可怕的兔子电子动画剪影，它有发光的眼睛、长直立的耳朵、巨大的露齿笑容，以及隐约可见的金属身体细节，几乎没有被照亮，所以它从阴影中出现。办公室的墙壁是灰白色且破旧的，有黑白格子条纹和一条细红色条纹水平穿过房间。左墙上有 1 个彩色的“庆祝！”海报上有电子动画人物，再加上一张固定在附近的较小的人物绘图纸，以及一个直立在表面上的黑色对讲机。门口附近有一盏银色台灯。右侧有两张纸夹在墙上，阴影中还有一个灰色文件柜。门半开着，把手可见。构图应该感觉像一个坦率的派对快照变成了一个恐怖场景，具有刺眼的闪光灯前景主题、深黑色阴影、模拟噪音、柔和的色彩、令人不安的现实主义以及中心背景中隐藏的怪物作为主要恐惧。

The mood is melancholic, intimate, and awe-inspiring, blending post-apocalyptic realism with emotional scale contrast. items.title: 3D Papercut Pirate Scene
items.titleZh: Eye-level view, looking straight at a high-saturation 3D multi-layered paper carving scene. The overall colors are grayish-blue, creamy white, and deep forest green, accented with amber warm light. All elements must be physical paper layered structures, with hard-cut edges and clearly visible thick paper cross-sections. Extremely rich composition, a high-energy {argument name="scene theme" default="pirate group scene"} set in a chaotic sea adventure. Multiple stylized pirate characters are presented in exaggerated actions, with a {argument name="core character" default="young captain wearing a straw hat"} in the middle layer charging forward, surrounded by crew members with distinct poses. Layered ships, surging waves, and swirling currents run through the foreground, middle, and background, with multiple ships colliding and tilting in different spatial layers, sails torn, and flags flying. Silhouettes of giant opposing characters appear in the background layer to enhance the sense of oppression and spatial hierarchy. The foreground is filled with narrative elements: treasure chests, gold coins, maps, barrels, ropes, lanterns, and a wanted poster with a smiling pirate. A mascot-like small character is placed in the corner as a visual anchor. All atmospheric elements are presented in paper carving form: waves, splashes, smoke, debris, and movement lines, strengthening the chaos and sense of motion. The main subject is in the middle layer, with elements interacting across layers to express movement through overlap and spatial relationships. Soft light from a single direction creates clear inter-layer shadows. Overall matte paper texture, no glowing, no soft edges, no volumetric light. Octane render, 8K, clear details --ar 3:4 --stylize 450

平视视角，正面直视一个高饱和度3D多层纸雕场景。
整体为灰蓝、奶油白、深森林绿，点缀琥珀色暖光。所有元素必须是实体纸张分层结构，边缘为硬切割效果，并清晰可见厚纸横截面。
极致丰富构图，一个高能量的{argument name="场景主题" default="海盗群像场景"}，发生在混乱的海上冒险中。多个风格化海盗角色以夸张动作呈现，中层核心是一位{argument name="核心角色" default="戴草帽的年轻船长"}向前冲刺，周围是姿态鲜明的船员。
分层的船只、翻涌海浪和旋转洋流贯穿前中后景，多艘船 in 不同空间层中碰撞倾斜，船帆破损、旗帜飞扬。
背景层中出现体型巨大的对立角色剪影，增强压迫感和空间层级。
前景堆满叙事元素：宝箱、金币、地图、木桶、绳索、灯笼，以及一张带笑脸海盗的通缉令。角落放置一个吉祥物式小角色作为视觉锚点。
所有氛围元素以纸雕形式呈现：海浪、水花、烟雾、碎片、动势线，强化混乱与动感。
主体位于中层，元素跨层互动，通过重叠和空间关系表达运动感。
单一方向柔光，形成清晰层间投影。整体为哑光纸张质感，无发光、无柔边、无体积光。
octane渲染，8K，细节清晰 --ar 3:4 --stylize 450

items.titleZh: A smartphone screenshot of an AI chat app interface in portrait orientation, showing a clean white iOS-style screen with a top bar containing a hamburger menu on the left, the blue title “Thinking” with a small chevron, and two icons on the right for compose and more options. Near the top is a rounded light-gray user message bubble in Japanese reading “Attention機構を人体に喩えて細かくラベルを付けて。医学書の精緻な挿絵風に。” Below it, faint gray system text reads “Thought for 5s” and “画像が作成されました”. The lower half of the screen displays the generated image as a detailed medical textbook-style anatomical poster. The poster shows a realistic three-quarter back view of an adult woman from head to upper thighs, with her head turned slightly left and her dark brown hair tied into a messy bun. Her skin and outer tissues are removed across most of the body to reveal musculature, nerves, blood vessels, and fibrous structures, rendered in extremely detailed vintage medical illustration style on a warm cream paper background. A rectangular cutout obscures the center of the face from forehead to jaw, creating a censored blank block over the facial area. Fine glowing network lines and nodes are overlaid through the exposed brain and body to visualize the attention mechanism as if it were an anatomical system. Surrounding the figure are 6 numbered explanatory panels and 2 additional text blocks, all densely filled with Japanese and English bilingual labels, formulas, arrows, and diagrams. The main poster title at upper left is “アテンション機構の解剖学的構造” with the English subtitle “The Anatomy of the Attention Mechanism”. At the top right is a flowchart labeled “Overall Flow of Attention” containing 5 connected boxes describing the process from input to output. Down the left side are 3 stacked explanatory sections with equations and mapping tables. Down the right side are 3 more numbered sections, each with technical notes and a small chart or matrix; the visible mini-diagrams include 1 purple heatmap matrix, 1 blue bar chart, and 1 multicolored cube graphic. Along the bottom edge are 5 small brain inset illustrations with captions showing stages of information flow. The overall aesthetic should feel like a highly polished AI-generated screenshot documenting a surreal scientific illustration request, with crisp UI, lots of tiny readable labels, and a convincing fusion of transformer attention diagrams and classical anatomical plate design.

items.title: Gritty Evangelion Unit-01 Poster
items.titleZh: A gritty vertical anime-mecha poster in distressed screen-print style, inspired by retro military dossiers and Evangelion key art. The main subject is a massive close-up side profile of {argument name="mecha unit name" default="EVANGELION: UNIT-01"}, dominating the right two-thirds of the composition, facing left with its jaws open in a feral scream. The head is angular and biomechanical, with deep purple armor, olive-green accent plates, black metal inner structures, a single long horn projecting diagonally upward to the left, sharp teeth, and a narrow glowing eye. The surface is scratched, chipped, weathered, and inked with heavy comic-style linework. Behind it is a dark navy blueprint background filled with 8 visible technical diagram clusters, white schematic lines, anatomical overlays, cross-sections, labels, measurement marks, and interface graphics. A violent red paint slash explodes diagonally across the upper center and left side, with additional red drips running downward from the mecha’s mouth area. In the lower left corner, 1 small human figure sits hunched on a gray equipment crate: a teenage boy in a short-sleeve white school shirt, dark pants, and white sneakers, elbows on knees, looking down at a glowing handheld device, conveying isolation and anxiety. Add layered poster typography and warning graphics throughout the border: a torn yellow caution sign in the upper right with Japanese warning text and “CAUTION NERV ONLY”; a tall left sidebar with “01”, barcode-like blocks, hazard icons, and red-black labels; large distressed white kanji vertically stacked over the mecha torso; the word {argument name="main title" default="ESCAPE"} in spaced red capitals beneath the kanji; a small black label reading “PILOT: {argument name="pilot name" default="IKARI, SHINJI"}”; a bottom-right NERV logo; and footer text such as classified file markings and top secret stamps. Include 6 clearly readable English technical labels in the blueprint area: “TEST TYPE”, “BIOLOGICAL CONSTRAINT”, “AT FIELD”, “MAGI SYSTEM”, “INTERNAL”, and “CLASSIFIED MATERIAL”. Add Japanese dossier text blocks as authentic graphic texture. The palette is limited to dark indigo, black, crimson red, purple, olive green, dirty beige, and off-white. High contrast, torn-paper collage details, halftone texture, ink splatter, cracked paint, and worn print edges. Cinematic, oppressive, chaotic, collectible poster design, ultra-detailed, sharp, textured, no clean modern polish.
items.promptZh: 一张坚韧的垂直动漫机甲海报，采用仿旧丝网印刷风格，灵感来自复古军事档案和新世纪福音战士的关键艺术。主要主题是{argument name="mecha unit name" default="EVANGELION: UNIT-01"}的巨大特写侧面轮廓，占据了构图右侧三分之二的位置，面朝左侧，张开下巴，发出野性的尖叫声。头部呈棱角状，具有生物力学特征，拥有深紫色盔甲、橄榄绿重音板、黑色金属内部结构、向左斜上方突出的单个长角、锋利的牙齿和一只狭窄的发光眼睛。表面有划痕、缺口、风化，并带有浓重的漫画风格的线条。其背后是深海军蓝蓝图背景，其中充满了 8 个可见的技术图表簇、白色示意图线、解剖覆盖图、横截面、标签、测量标记和界面图形。一道猛烈的红色油漆斜线沿对角线穿过上部中心和左侧爆炸，额外的红色滴从机甲的嘴部区域向下流淌。左下角，一个小人物弓着背坐在一个灰色的设备箱上：一个十几岁的男孩，穿着短袖白色校服、深色裤子和白色运动鞋，手肘放在膝盖上，低头看着一个发光的手持设备，传达出孤独和焦虑。在整个边框中添加分层海报排版和警告图形：右上角有一个撕破的黄色警告标志，上面有日语警告文字和“小心神经”；一个高的左侧边栏，上面有“01”、类似条形码的块、危险图标和红黑标签；大型仿旧白色汉字垂直堆叠在机甲躯干上；汉字下方的红色间隔大写字母 {argument name="main title" default="ESCAPE"} ；一个黑色小标签，上面写着“PILOT: {argument name="pilot name" default="IKARI, SHINJI"}”；右下角的 NERV 标志；和页脚文本，例如机密文件标记和绝密邮票。在蓝图区域包含6个清晰可读的英文技术标签：“TEST TYPE”、“BIOLOGICAL CONSTRAINT”、“AT Field”、“MAGI SYSTEM”、“INTERNAL”和“CLASSIFIED MATERIAL”。添加日本档案文本块作为真实的图形纹理。调色板仅限于深靛蓝、黑色、深红色、紫色、橄榄绿、脏米色和灰白色。高对比度、撕纸拼贴细节、半色调纹理、墨水飞溅、裂纹油漆和磨损的打印边缘。电影般的、压抑的、混乱的、具有收藏价值的海报设计，超详细、锐利、有质感，没有干净的现代修饰。

items.titleZh: A dark monochrome manga-style horror illustration on a pure black background, in a tall vertical poster composition. Centered at the bottom is a small lonely teenage boy with messy short dark hair, sitting on the ground with his knees pulled to his chest and his arms wrapped around them, head slightly bowed, conveying fear, isolation, and helplessness. Towering over him is a gigantic biomechanical demon or armored monster head descending from above, with a long angular skull-like face, sharp chin, narrow hollow eye sockets, layered helmet-like plates, and a jagged open mouth. Surrounding the boy are exactly 2 enormous skeletal clawed hands, one on the left and one on the right, framing him like a cage; each hand has long segmented metallic fingers ending in sharp pointed tips, bent inward menacingly. Render everything in rough scratchy white ink linework and heavy crosshatching against deep black, with intense high-contrast seinen manga energy. Add vivid neon purple paint-like liquid in splashes and long dripping streaks from the monster’s face, the hands, and the ground, pooling around the boy for the only strong color accent. On the upper right side, add vertical Japanese text reading 逃げちゃダメだ, and beneath it in small white English text: EGO BORDER: ACTIVE. The mood is oppressive, psychological, claustrophobic, and nightmarish, like a dark anime poster about inner fear and mental collapse.

items.title: Cinematic Backlit Woman Portrait
items.titleZh: A cinematic vertical portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young woman"} shown from the chest up in a close half-body composition, positioned slightly right of center, with her body turned to the right and her head turned back toward the camera in a restrained over-the-shoulder pose. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long black hair"}, loose and slightly messy, being blown strongly through the frame so many strands lift outward and sweep across the air around her face and shoulders. Her visible styling is elegant and minimal: a dark thin-strap slip dress or camisole exposing the shoulder line, collarbone, and upper back, with a sheer black off-shoulder wrap or translucent outer layer slipping down the arms to create a soft dark framing shape around the lower body. The mood is cold, quiet, mysterious, and wistful, with a high-fashion cinematic realism rather than glamour polish. Use dramatic backlighting from the upper left, creating a bright halo along the hair, shoulder, and edge of the body, while the front of the figure stays mostly in shadow with only extremely soft fill light. The face is largely obscured in darkness and soft haze, emphasizing silhouette, neck, ear, shoulder, and luminous hair edges more than facial detail. The background is a dark gray to near-black empty space with 2 clear environmental elements: floating dust-like particles and soft circular bokeh light spots scattered mostly on the left side and around the hair. Overall color grading is low saturation with cool blue-gray shadows and slightly warm skin tones for subtle warm-cool contrast. Add diffused bloom, misty atmosphere, faint film grain, soft vignette, and shallow depth of field. Keep the eyes and lips de-emphasized or hidden in shadow, avoid hard frontal light, avoid bright busy background details, avoid cartoon styling, avoid oversharpening, and avoid plastic skin texture.

items.titleZh: A cinematic third-person action RPG gameplay screenshot set in {argument name="city district" default="Macau Peninsula, New Road"}, styled like a gritty realistic open-world crime game from the late 1990s. The camera is positioned behind a lone male protagonist standing in the middle of a rain-soaked street, full body visible from the back, wearing a dark brown leather jacket with a large embroidered dragon on the back, blue jeans, and dark shoes. He faces a dense neon-lit urban street packed with pedestrians, old shopfronts, hanging signs, tangled cables, weathered apartment buildings, and a tram approaching from the center distance. The scene is at dusk under a cloudy sky, with wet asphalt reflecting orange, pink, blue, and white neon signage. The environment should evoke old Macau with a Cantonese-Portuguese visual mix: narrow streets, vintage cars, crowded sidewalks, multilingual storefront signs, one large glowing sign reading GRAND LISBOA, another reading BANCO TAI SIN, and many vertical Chinese neon signs layered into the depth of the street. Include 1 tram in the middle lane, 1 black sedan parked on the left, and around 10 to 14 pedestrians crossing or standing on both sides of the road. Add realistic puddles, crosswalk lines, metal railings in the right foreground, storefront interiors with warm lighting on the left, and a moody noir atmosphere. Overlay a complete game HUD: top left circular character portrait with the name {argument name="character name" default="龍少爺"}, level 36, 3 horizontal status bars; top center compass with N and E markers plus the location text and a clock reading 14:35; top right circular minimap with icons; right side quest tracker panel containing 3 quest groups with Chinese text, with the top highlighted quest header in orange; bottom left semi-transparent chat box with 4 colored lines of Chinese system and world chat plus a text entry bar and a send button; bottom center hotbar with 7 skill slots labeled 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, Q, E, R, including a large ornate circular ultimate icon at the center and one glowing purple skill icon; bottom right 5 menu icons with Chinese labels for character, inventory, quests, friends, and settings, plus a small ESC indicator. items.title: Fantasy Manga Spell Explosion Page
items.titleZh: A dramatic black-and-white fantasy manga page in highly detailed ink line art and screentone style, vertical comic layout with 2 panels. The top panel is a full-width action scene showing a young anime-style mage boy, about early teen age, standing on cracked rocky ground and casting a powerful spell with his right hand extended toward the left side of the frame. He has short tousled light hair, large serious eyes, and a calm, focused expression. He wears a high-collared cape flowing behind him, a buttoned vest over a shirt, fitted trousers, boots, a belt with pouches, and a holstered wand or small magical tool at his hip, with a gemstone clasp at the neck. In front of his open palm is a large glowing circular magic sigil with intricate concentric symbols and runic ornamentation. The spell erupts into a massive explosion of white light and energy, blasting outward with dense speed lines, black debris clouds, shattered rock fragments, dust, and impact textures filling the background. Large stylized Japanese sound effect lettering is integrated into the art on the left side and along the lower foreground, creating a sense of repeated roaring impacts. The composition is dynamic and high contrast, with the boy positioned right of center and the blast dominating the left half. The bottom panel is a narrower reaction shot, count 1 character visible, showing a long-haired witch in profile facing left, wearing a wide-brimmed pointed hat with an ornate band and gem, and a cloak fastened with a jewel brooch. Her face is partially obscured by a solid rectangular censorship block over the central face area. Behind her, the same explosion and flying rubble continue in the distance. A single vertical Japanese speech balloon on the right reads "…うわ". Use clean manga panel borders, polished professional shonen fantasy comic style, intense motion, crisp pen hatching, screentone shading, and cinematic impact.
items.promptZh: 戏剧性的黑白奇幻漫画页面，采用高度详细的墨水线条艺术和屏幕色调风格，垂直漫画布局，有 2 个面板。顶部面板是一个全角动作场景，展示了一个年轻的动漫风格的法师男孩，大约十几岁，站在破裂的岩石地面上，用右手伸向画面左侧施展强大的咒语。他有一头蓬乱的浅色短发，一双严肃的大眼睛，表情平静而专注。他穿着一件高领斗篷在身后飘逸，衬衫外面套着纽扣背心，合身的裤子，靴子，一条带小袋的腰带，腰间挂着一根装在皮套里的魔杖或小型魔法工具，脖子上有一个宝石扣。在他张开的手掌前面有一个巨大的发光圆形魔法印记，上面有复杂的同心符号和符文装饰。该法术爆发出白光和能量的巨大爆炸，向外爆炸，密集的速度线、黑色碎片云、破碎的岩石碎片、灰尘和冲击纹理充满了背景。大型风格化的日本音效字体融入到左侧和下部前景的艺术中，营造出一种反复轰鸣的冲击感。构图充满活力且对比度高，男孩位于中心右侧，爆炸占据左半部分。底部面板是一个较窄的反应镜头，计数 1 个字符可见，显示一个长发女巫，侧面朝左，戴着一顶带有华丽带子和宝石的宽边尖顶帽子，披着一件用宝石胸针固定的斗篷。她的脸部被中央脸部区域上方的实心矩形审查块部分遮挡。在她身后，同样的爆炸和飞扬的瓦砾在远处继续发生。右侧有一个垂直的日语语音气球，上面写着“…うわ”。使用干净的漫画面板边框、精美的专业少年奇幻漫画风格、激烈的动作、清晰的钢笔阴影、屏幕色调阴影和电影效果。
items.prompt: A dramatic black-and-white fantasy manga page in highly detailed ink line art and screentone style, vertical comic layout with 2 panels. The top panel is a full-width action scene showing a young anime-style mage boy, about early teen age, standing on cracked rocky ground and casting a powerful spell with his right hand extended toward the left side of the frame. He has short tousled light hair, large serious eyes, and a calm, focused expression. He wears a high-collared cape flowing behind him, a buttoned vest over a shirt, fitted trousers, boots, a belt with pouches, and a holstered wand or small magical tool at his hip, with a gemstone clasp at the neck. In front of his open palm is a large glowing circular magic sigil with intricate concentric symbols and runic ornamentation. The spell erupts into a massive explosion of white light and energy, blasting outward with dense speed lines, black debris clouds, shattered rock fragments, dust, and impact textures filling the background. Large stylized Japanese sound effect lettering is integrated into the art on the left side and along the lower foreground, creating a sense of repeated roaring impacts. The composition is dynamic and high contrast, with the boy positioned right of center and the blast dominating the left half. The bottom panel is a narrower reaction shot, count 1 character visible, showing a long-haired witch in profile facing left, wearing a wide-brimmed pointed hat with an ornate band and gem, and a cloak fastened with a jewel brooch. Her face is partially obscured by a solid rectangular censorship block over the central face area. Behind her, the same explosion and flying rubble continue in the distance. A single vertical Japanese speech balloon on the right reads "…うわ". Use clean manga panel borders, polished professional shonen fantasy comic style, intense motion, crisp pen hatching, screentone shading, and cinematic impact.

items.title: Japanese Izakaya Highball Poster
items.titleZh: A photorealistic Japanese izakaya advertisement poster in a warm, cinematic night-time mood, designed like a street-front restaurant flyer. The composition is vertical and densely layered. On the right side, a young Japanese woman with long straight dark brown to black hair, wearing a fitted black ribbed turtleneck sweater, stands from the waist up and holds a large frosty glass mug of golden highball with visible ice cubes in her right hand near chest level. Her pose is relaxed and inviting, looking toward the camera, with a soft nightlife ambiance. The background is a narrow traditional izakaya exterior or interior alley scene filled with warm orange lantern light, shallow depth of field, hanging wooden menu plaques with handwritten Japanese calligraphy, and a nostalgic bustling-after-work atmosphere. In the upper left, a large weathered dark wooden signboard dominates the design, with bold white brushstroke kanji reading 蓮華食堂, small hiragana above it reading れんげしょくどう, and a red brush-painted banner beneath reading 大衆居酒屋. Below that on the left-center, place a large cream-colored paper or painted panel featuring the drink special in oversized calligraphic typography: ハイボール above a huge red 198円, with small black（税込） beside the price, the numerals painted in energetic brush style. Along the far right edge, add vertical white Japanese text reading 今日も一日、おかれさまです。 Near the lower right over the woman’s torso, place a red circular stamp-like badge with white handwritten text arranged diagonally and vertically: 旨い！安い！居心地◎. Across the bottom foreground, show exactly 4 plated menu items lined up side by side on rustic ceramic dishes: 1) two glazed grilled chicken skewers with char marks, labeled 焼き鳥 盛り合わせ and priced 580円; 2) a sashimi assortment with slices of tuna, salmon, white fish, shiso leaves and wasabi, labeled お刺身 盛り合わせ and priced 780円; 3) a plate of fried chicken karaage pieces with a lemon wedge, labeled 若鶏の唐揚げ and priced 480円; 4) sliced rolled dashi omelet topped with chopped green onion and served with grated daikon, labeled 出汁巻き玉子 and priced 380円. At the bottom left, include a glowing red paper lantern graphic with black vertical text 居酒屋. Across the bottom center on a dark band, add large bold white brush lettering reading でかい！うまい！安い！ and below it smaller white text reading みんなの憩いの場、蓮華食堂へようこそ！ Add a decorative red lotus-like emblem near the top sign and another matching emblem in the bottom right corner. Use rich amber highlights, strong contrast, glossy food styling, realistic skin and drink textures, commercial poster polish, and a nostalgic Showa-inspired izakaya promotion aesthetic.

items.title: Fitness SaaS Landing Page UI
items.titleZh:
Design a modern, high-end {argument name="app type" default="fitness app"} landing page and product UI for a brand called {argument name="brand name" default="PulseFit"}.

Create a clean web design mockup that looks like a real SaaS fitness platform and mobile companion app. The design should feel premium, motivating, and easy to use, with a polished UI/UX style similar to top-tier health and wellness apps.

Include:
- A hero section with bold headline, short subheadline, strong call-to-action button, and app preview
- Dashboard UI showing daily activity, calories burned, workout streak, heart rate, step count, and progress rings
- Workout program cards for strength, cardio, mobility, and recovery
- Nutrition tracking section with macro breakdown and water intake
- Progress charts and analytics widgets
- Trainer/community section with profile cards and testimonials
- Pricing section and download/app store callout
- Mobile app screens shown alongside the web design for a cohesive product ecosystem

Style direction:
- Sleek, minimal, modern interface
- Premium fitness brand aesthetic
- Smooth spacing, strong hierarchy, rounded cards, soft shadows
- Dark mode UI with energetic accent colors like electric blue, neon green, or vibrant orange
- Crisp typography, realistic charts, polished buttons, beautiful onboarding feel
- Highly detailed, dribbble-worthy, startup-quality product design
- Realistic UX case study presentation, not a cartoon or illustration

Composition:
- Full website homepage mockup
- Multiple UI sections visible in one polished presentation
- Slight perspective or straight-on product showcase
- Clean background with subtle gradients and professional lighting
- Ultra-detailed, sharp text rendering, visually balanced layout

Output:
A stunning, realistic UI/UX design concept for a fitness app website and dashboard that looks ready for development.

Make it look like a real Figma product design presentation for a premium startup.
items.promptZh:
为名为 {argument name="brand name" default="PulseFit"} 的品牌设计现代、高端的{argument name="app type" default="fitness app"}着陆页和产品界面。

创建一个干净的网页设计模型，看起来像一个真正的 SaaS 健身平台和移动配套应用程序。设计应该给人一种优质、激励人心且易于使用的感觉，并具有类似于顶级健康和保健应用程序的精美 UI/UX 风格。

包括：
- 带有粗体标题、短副标题、强大的号召性用语按钮和应用程序预览的英雄部分
- 仪表板用户界面显示每日活动、消耗的卡路里、连续锻炼、心率、步数和进度环
- 力量、有氧运动、活动能力和恢复的锻炼计划卡
- 营养跟踪部分，包含宏观分解和饮水量
- 进度图表和分析小部件
- 培训师/社区部分，包含个人资料卡和感言
- 定价部分和下载/应用商店标注
- 移动应用程序屏幕与网页设计一起显示，形成一个有凝聚力的产品生态系统

风格方向：
- 时尚、简约、现代的界面
- 优质健身品牌美学
- 平滑的间距、强烈的层次感、圆形卡片、柔和的阴影
- 深色模式 UI 具有充满活力的强调色，如电蓝色、霓虹绿或鲜艳的橙色
- 清晰的排版、逼真的图表、精美的按钮、漂亮的入门感觉
- 高度详细、值得运球、启动质量的产品设计
- 真实的用户体验案例研究演示，而不是卡通或插图

成分：
- 完整的网站主页模型
- 多个 UI 部分在一个精美的演示文稿中可见
- 轻微透视或直接产品展示
- 干净的背景，微妙的渐变和专业的灯光
- 超详细、清晰的文本渲染、视觉平衡的布局

输出：
一个令人惊叹的、现实的 UI/UX 设计概念，适用于健身应用程序网站和仪表板，看起来已准备好开发。

让它看起来像为一家优质初创公司提供的真正 Figma 产品设计演示。

items.titleZh: A high-resolution top-down satellite map view of central {argument name="city" default="London"}, focused tightly on the area around {argument name="landmark" default="Big Ben"} and the Palace of Westminster beside the River Thames. Show a realistic aerial orthographic perspective like a modern digital map or satellite layer, with detailed rooftops, streets, trees, shadows, and brownish river water. Place the long Palace of Westminster complex vertically near the center-right, directly along the west bank of the river, with Big Ben at the northeast corner of the palace near the river edge. A bridge labeled {argument name="bridge name" default="Westminster Bridge"} crosses horizontally near the bottom of the frame from left to right over the river. Include 6 visible map labels total: {argument name="label 1" default="Westminster Abbey"}, {argument name="label 2" default="Parliament Square"}, Big Ben, Palace of Westminster, Westminster Bridge, and Horse Guards Parade. Also show Whitehall as a labeled road running vertically on the left side of the palace area. Surrounding details should include Westminster Abbey in the upper left quadrant, Parliament Square above the palace, Horse Guards Parade as a large sandy rectangular ground in the lower left quadrant, dense city blocks and roads on the left half, the River Thames occupying the full right side, embankments on both sides, a few boats on the river, and tree-lined streets and parks. Use natural satellite-image colors, crisp cartographic label overlays, and the look of a zoomed-in online maps screenshot.

The main character is {argument name="character name" default="もち子さん"}, a cute anime girl with short white hair fading slightly to silver, large vivid blue eyes, soft blush, and twin low ponytails tied near the shoulders. She wears an oversized black hood shaped like floppy dog ears, round silver goggles resting on top of her head, a black choker with a metallic round ornament, a futuristic white-and-black cropped sleeveless top with dark trim and a small emblem on the chest, detached black arm sleeves, very short white shorts with black edging, a thigh strap on one leg, and a small side pouch on her hip. Her body proportions are youthful anime stylization with a slim, petite build and slightly exaggerated chest, rendered in polished modern moe character design. In the center she stands full body, smiling gently and holding a pen in one hand as if she is about to make a mistake while writing, facing the viewer in a confident but sweet pose. Around her place 5 supporting vignette images of the same character: 1) upper left, a chibi-style scene of her outside with both hands thrown forward, crying dramatically with a huge open mouth; 2) lower left, a comic scene of her collapsed face-down on a desk or floor with scattered papers, exhausted and flustered; 3) upper right, a bust shot where she holds up a paper sign with Japanese writing, looking apologetic; 4) lower right, a cheerful half-body portrait with closed smiling eyes and one fist raised in encouragement; 5) a small background portrait in the top-right area behind text, used like a character callout. Include exactly 2 small white mascot creatures near the bottom center, both round and mochi-like with tiny dot eyes and tiny mouths, one larger and one smaller, floating or standing beside the heroine. Use a soft spring palette with pink, sky blue, mint green, peach, cream, and white, with scattered cherry blossom petals and rounded graphic shapes in the background. The background should feel airy and celebratory, with subtle outdoor scenery blur and decorative swooshes, stars, and bubbles. Fill the poster with Japanese typography in a playful commercial-anime style: a large multicolored title at top left, small header text above it, a red seasonal broadcast announcement, a pink "あらすじ" synopsis box on the left with several lines of body text, a blue explanatory box at bottom left, vertical and angled exclamatory phrases around the character, and a pink production-credit block at bottom right. Add a prominent character name banner in the upper right. Keep all text looking like authentic printed Japanese promotional copy, using rounded colorful fonts for the title and clean magazine-style fonts for the smaller text. Overall mood: adorable, comedic, slightly chaotic, professionally designed anime key art for a new TV series announcement in 16:9 landscape format.
