items.title: Japanese AI Creator Studio Banner
items.titleZh: Create a polished Japanese promotional website hero banner for an AI creator community, in a clean modern tech-advertising style with a soft pastel blue, lavender, pink, and white palette. Wide 16:9 composition. On the left, place a gradient triangular abstract logo and the Japanese brand name {argument name="brand name" default="AIクリエイターズ・スタジオ"} at the top, followed by a thin horizontal divider line with a small sparkle in the middle. Below that, a very large bold Japanese headline in 2 lines: first line in dark navy, 「AIで、もっと自由に」, second line in large gradient letters from cyan to purple to pink, 「創る・学ぶ・つながる」. Under the headline, add a short Japanese subheadline with sparkle marks, 「AIを使ったクリエイティブの可能性を広げるメンバーシップコミュニティ」. On the right half, create a collage of 6 rounded-rectangle visual cards showing AI-generated creative examples: 1 large dreamy portrait of a woman in profile surrounded by flowers and butterflies in ethereal purple light, 1 small cyberpunk city nightscape with a lone figure, 1 small close-up portrait of a fluffy cat, 1 small luxury cosmetic bottle labeled “AI STUDIO”, 1 small bright seascape or flower-field landscape with a woman in white, and 1 large tablet drawing device on a desk with a stylus, plus a coffee mug and plant nearby. Add a circular gradient badge overlapping the right side with bold white Japanese text {argument name="badge text" default="一緒に創造の未来をつくろう！"}. Across the lower middle, place a translucent white rounded feature panel containing exactly 5 equal columns with thin separators and pastel line icons. Each column has an icon, a bold Japanese title, and a smaller 2-line description. The 5 titles are: 「限定コンテンツ」, 「実践プロンプト＆テンプレート」, 「メンバー限定コミュニティ」, 「最新情報をいち早くお届け」, 「メンバー限定特典」. Use fitting icons for book, monitor, chat bubble, light bulb, and gift. Add concise Japanese descriptions beneath each title. At the very bottom, add a dark navy footer strip with a large Japanese call-to-action sentence in white and pink-purple gradient accent text, {argument name="footer text" default="AIを味方に、あなたの『創りたい』をカタチに。さあ、一緒に創ろう！"}. Overall look: premium startup landing page, glossy soft lighting, subtle sparkles, glassmorphism panels, clean typography, Japanese text rendered accurately, highly legible, visually balanced, professional social media thumbnail quality.

items.title: Polaroid of Japanese Class Graduation Photo
items.titleZh: A realistic instant film Polaroid photo lying flat on a light wooden tabletop, photographed from directly above. The instant print has a thick white border with a wider bottom margin and slight natural wear, with the photo area showing an indoor Japanese high school classroom group portrait. Inside the photo, about 35 graduating students in dark school uniforms are gathered in 4 loose rows in front of a green chalkboard, posing casually and tightly packed together. Most are teenage boys in black gakuran-style jackets or dark blazers with white shirts and ties, and several teenage girls wear dark blazers with blue plaid skirts. One girl near the front left stands out in a white cardigan and blue plaid skirt. Many students hold up peace signs, some crouch in front, and a few sit or recline on the wooden floor in the front row. Faces are intentionally obscured with soft square mosaic blurs, but the overall feeling is candid, nostalgic, and celebratory. On the chalkboard, hand-drawn Japanese graduation messages in chalk include large central text reading "3年B組" and celebratory doodles and writing around it such as graduation-themed congratulations. The classroom has white walls, a round wall clock above the chalkboard, a fluorescent ceiling light fixture, and subdued indoor lighting. The image should feel like a slightly dim early-2000s or 2010s snapshot with mild grain, soft focus, authentic flash photography, and natural color fading, emphasizing a sentimental end-of-school memory preserved as a physical instant print.

items.title: Foreign Clerk in County Phone Shop
items.titleZh: A realistic documentary-style smartphone photo inside a small county-town mobile phone shop in China, showing a candid sales interaction at the counter. A tall foreign man, about {argument name="shop clerk nationality" default="Russian"}, stands behind a glass display case wearing a black jacket and a blue employee lanyard with badge, holding a smartphone in both hands as if introducing it to a customer. His face is deliberately blurred into a soft rectangular mosaic for privacy. In the foreground, a middle-aged Chinese male customer in a black jacket is seen from behind and slightly to the side, facing the clerk. The store is cramped, brightly lit, and visually cluttered with authentic retail details. Behind them are large smartphone brand posters and lightbox ads, including 2 major phone brand ads: vivo and oppo. There are 4 prominent Chinese promotional signs visible: a red overhead banner about buying phones and carrier service, a blue vertical installment-payment sign mentioning 0 down payment and 0 interest, a blue trade-in subsidy sign mentioning 1000 yuan, and a small counter sign promoting a Xiaomi model with a 6999 price. The glass counter contains multiple display phones, with 4 clearly visible upright demo phones on stands, plus scattered brochures and accessories beneath the glass. Add dense shelves of boxed accessories and hanging decorations in the background, with slightly messy composition, harsh indoor shop lighting, mild lens distortion, and the rough, unpolished realism of a casually taken phone snapshot. The mood should feel mundane, local, and faintly surreal because the foreign clerk appears completely integrated into an ordinary Chinese mobile phone store.
items.promptZh: 中国一家小县城手机店内的真实纪实风格智能手机照片，展示了柜台上坦诚的销售互动。一名身材高大的外国男子，大约{argument name="shop clerk nationity" default="Russian"}，站在玻璃展示柜后面，身穿黑色夹克，佩戴带有徽章的蓝色员工挂绳，双手拿着一部智能手机，好像在向顾客介绍它。为了保护隐私，他的脸被故意模糊成柔软的矩形马赛克。前景中，一位穿着黑色夹克的中年中国男性顾客从后面看到，稍微偏向一侧，面对着店员。这家商店空间狭小，灯光明亮，视觉上杂乱无章，充满了真实的零售细节。背后是大型智能手机品牌海报和灯箱广告，其中包括两大手机品牌广告：vivo和oppo。有4个显眼的中文促销标志：红色头顶横幅上写着购买手机和运营商服务，蓝色垂直分期付款标志上写着0首付0利息，蓝色以旧换新补贴标志上写着1000元，还有一个小柜台标志上宣传着售价6999的小米手机。玻璃柜台上有多部展示电话，展台上有 4 部清晰可见的直立演示电话，玻璃下方还散落着小册子和配件。在背景中添加密集的盒装配件架和悬挂装饰品，构图略显凌乱，室内商店灯光刺眼，镜头轻微变形，以及随意拍摄的手机快照的粗糙、未经修饰的真实感。气氛应该是平凡的、本土的，还有一点超现实的感觉，因为外国店员看起来完全融入了一家普通的中国手机商店。

Near the upper right is a single rounded dark-gray message bubble containing the white Chinese text {argument name="message text" default="拳击手被击中的瞬间"}. Below and to the left is one large embedded photo with rounded corners, occupying most of the lower-left half of the screen. The embedded photo shows the exact instant in a professional boxing match when one boxer lands a hard straight punch flush on the other boxer’s face. Two shirtless male boxers with muscular, sweaty bodies are inside a ring under arena lights. The boxer on the right is seen mostly from the back and side, extending his right arm fully across the frame; his back and shoulder muscles are sharply defined, and he has short dark hair and tattooed arms. He wears a white boxing glove with blue trim, and the glove is smashing into the left boxer’s face. The boxer on the left is recoiling from the impact, his head snapping sideways, with a spray of sweat and water droplets exploding outward around his head. He has a heavily tattooed left arm and chest, a black glove raised near his torso, and black trunks with large gold letters reading VICTOR across the waistband area. The ring ropes are red and white, with visible branding including PBC, and the dark blurred arena background includes bright signage reading RODRIGUEZ VS. The action photo should feel like a frozen high-speed sports photograph, dramatic, crisp, and photorealistic. Over both fighters’ faces are 2 rectangular mosaic-blur censor blocks, one on each face. Add small mobile UI overlay details on the image: the Chinese word 编辑 in white at the bottom-left corner of the photo and a circular share/upload icon at the bottom-right corner. Overall composition should look exactly like a casually shared AI-generated image shown inside a messaging app screenshot, clean, believable, and highly realistic.

items.title: Fantasy Campfire Before a Crimson Mountain
items.titleZh: A cinematic fantasy scene inside a rocky cave during a blizzard, viewed from slightly above campfire level, with 8 characters seated in a circle around a small fire. Outside the cave mouth, a colossal dark mountain rises in the snowstorm, shaped like a sinister pyramid or volcanic fortress, split with glowing crimson-magenta fissures and crowned by a branching, ember-like red energy bloom at the summit; a ring of lava or fire glows at its base across the frozen landscape. The cave interior is warm, amber, and intimate, lit by the fire and a single ornate oil lamp on the right, contrasting with the cold blue-gray storm outside. The group should feel like a high-fantasy adventuring party resting together: 1 regal bird-like humanoid on the left with white feathers, a hooked beak, braided plumage, and layered tribal jewelry; 1 red-haired woman in the left foreground with long braided hair and ornate fantasy garments; 1 young elf-like traveler in blue sitting left of center; 1 small blond elf-like girl at center with pointed ears and clasped hands; 1 elderly king-like man on the right with long white hair, full beard, crown, and dark green robe with gold ornamentation; 1 elegant blond noblewoman beside him in embroidered formal dress; 1 white-haired figure in the foreground right seen mostly from behind in feathered or fur-trimmed clothing; and 1 blue-skinned aquatic-looking woman on the far right with a fin-like headdress, elaborate jewelry, and a cup in hand. Include cups, bowls, plates, bedrolls, sacks, and travel gear scattered around the cave edges. The composition should frame the terrifying glowing mountain through the cave opening behind the party, emphasizing the contrast between sheltered companionship and looming apocalyptic danger. Ultra-detailed textures, realistic fabric and skin, dramatic volumetric firelight, snow streaks driven by wind, moody dark fantasy color grading, painterly realism, epic film still atmosphere, high contrast, rich shadows, masterpiece quality.
items.promptZh: 暴风雪期间岩石洞穴内的电影奇幻场景，从略高于篝火高度的角度观看，8 个角色围着小火围坐一圈。洞口外，一座巨大的黑暗山脉在暴风雪中拔地而起，形状像一座险恶的金字塔或火山堡垒，裂开着发光的深红色裂缝，山顶有一朵分枝的、灰烬般的红色能量花。一圈熔岩或火在它的底部发光，穿过冰冻的土地。洞穴内部温暖、琥珀色、亲密，被右侧的火和一盏华丽的油灯照亮，与外面寒冷的蓝灰色风暴形成鲜明对比。这个团队应该感觉像是一个一起休息的奇幻冒险小队：左边有 1 个像鸟一样的人形动物，有白色的羽毛、钩状喙、编织的羽毛和分层的部落珠宝；左前景是 1 位红发女性，留着长辫子，穿着华丽的奇幻服装； 1 名身穿蓝色衣服的年轻精灵旅行者，坐在中间左侧； 1 个金发精灵般的小女孩位于中心，耳朵尖尖，双手紧握；右边1位年长的国王般的男子，白发长须，头戴王冠，身穿深绿色金饰长袍；他身边有一位穿着绣花礼服的优雅金发贵妇；前景右侧有 1 个白发人物，主要是从后面看到，穿着羽毛或毛皮装饰的衣服；最右边是一名蓝色皮肤、水生模样的女人，戴着鳍状头饰，戴着精致的珠宝，手里拿着一个杯子。包括散布在洞穴边缘的杯子、碗、盘子、铺盖卷、麻袋和旅行装备。构图应该通过聚会后面的洞穴开口来勾画出可怕的发光山，强调受庇护的陪伴与迫在眉睫的世界末日危险之间的对比。超细致的纹理，逼真的织物和皮肤，戏剧性的体积火光，风驱动的雪纹，喜怒无常的黑暗幻想色彩分级，绘画现实主义，史诗电影静止氛围，高对比度，丰富的阴影，杰作品质。

items.title: Fiery Butadon Japanese Ad Poster
items.titleZh: A dramatic Japanese food advertisement poster for a premium pork rice bowl, vertical composition, black and fiery orange background with glowing embers, smoke, and a high-contrast gourmet marketing look. The main focus is an oversized bowl of butadon in the lower center, filled with white rice and topped with many thick slices of glossy grilled pork belly, richly lacquered with dark sweet soy glaze, visible char marks, caramelized edges, and a stream of sauce pouring down from above onto the meat. Make the food look hyper-appetizing, juicy, rich, and slightly exaggerated like a restaurant flyer. Large bold brushed gold Japanese headline text dominates the upper left: {argument name="headline text" default="帯広の肉厚豚丼"}. Across the middle, a gold paint-stroke banner contains black Japanese text: {argument name="subheadline text" default="極上の炭火焼き。極上のタレ。"}. On the right side, add a cute anime girl mascot standing behind the bowl, about half-body visible, wearing a black-and-white cow-themed hoodie with small horns, long blonde hair, frilly sleeves, and a shy delighted pose with one hand near her mouth; keep her face intentionally obscured by a plain beige rectangle censor block. Add vertical white Japanese copy along the right edge in 2 separate text groups: 1 at the upper right, 1 larger at the mid-to-lower right. Add a small handwritten-style white note near the girl with a tiny heart. In the lower left, include a dark circular callout badge with gold rim and white/yellow Japanese text about charcoal grilling and flavor. Along the very bottom, place 3 circular ingredient-feature icons with exact labels beneath them: raw pork slices labeled {argument name="feature label 1" default="肉厚!"}, glowing charcoal embers labeled {argument name="feature label 2" default="炭火焼き!"}, and glossy dark sauce labeled {argument name="feature label 3" default="極上ダレ!"}. At the bottom right, add a huge energetic gold brush-calligraphy slogan with splattered paint effects, plus a smaller white sentence beneath it. Use intense lighting, glossy highlights, premium yakiniku flyer aesthetics, dense Japanese typography, bold brush fonts, and a mouthwatering late-night food terror vibe.

items.title: Ancient Scroll Scholar Riding Dragon
items.titleZh: An ancient Chinese ink-and-wash style portrait on aged tan parchment, composed like a classical hanging scroll. A scholarly East Asian man in flowing gray-blue robes sits side-saddle atop a long serpentine Chinese dragon emerging through swirling clouds. His face is intentionally obscured by a flat rectangular blur block in parchment-brown tones. He has short dark curly hair and wears layered traditional robes with ornate patterned trim, a dark sash belt, and two modern OpenAI knot emblems worked into the costume: one printed on the chest and one on a round hand fan he holds upright in his right hand. His left hand rests near the dragon's mane as if holding the creature steady. The dragon is large and detailed, with blue-green scales, a pale underbelly, reddish-brown mane and fin accents, antler-like horns, whiskers, bared teeth, and a fierce expressive face in the lower left foreground, while its body coils upward to the upper right. Surround the figures with mist, stylized clouds, and steep craggy mountain peaks fading into the background. Add a vertical column of black Chinese calligraphy at the upper left and 3 red seal stamps near the lower part of the inscription area. The palette is muted, dusty, and antique: parchment beige, faded teal, moss green, smoky gray, sepia, and rust. Overall feeling: mythical, scholarly, dignified, slightly surreal, blending classical Chinese scroll painting with subtle modern AI iconography. Highly detailed brushwork, weathered paper texture, elegant composition, no border, full-frame vertical artwork.

items.titleZh: A sepia-toned ancient Chinese scroll painting reimagined as a visionary propaganda-style scene. In the center stands a scholarly robed figure styled like an imperial sage or philosopher, wearing flowing blue-gray hanfu with ornate trim, addressing a crowd of exactly 8 followers seen mostly from behind in the foreground. The sage’s face is intentionally obscured by a plain rectangular blur, and 3 members of the crowd also have blurred rectangular faces. The central figure raises one hand in a teaching gesture and holds a glowing geometric polyhedron crystal in the other hand. Behind him is a monumental hanging banner or framed plaque displaying the Google DeepMind logo and the words “Google DeepMind.” The background is a richly detailed traditional shanshui landscape with layered mountains, mist, trees, rocky formations, and a pagoda temple on the right. Along the upper right side, include vertical Chinese calligraphy text headed by “德米斯願景圖,” followed by several elegant columns of classical-style writing, plus a smaller vertical signature line and 2 red seal stamps. Use aged paper texture, muted brown ink, faded mineral pigments, fine linework, and the composition of a historic Chinese hanging scroll or literati painting, but with subtle anachronistic modern-AI symbolism. The overall mood is solemn, mythic, intellectual, and satirical, blending traditional East Asian art with corporate AI iconography.

items.title: Ancient Scholar AI Safety Poster
items.titleZh:
A refined sepia-toned illustration in the style of an ancient Chinese scholarly portrait fused with modern AI branding, on aged parchment paper with visible grain and ink-wash texture. Centered is a half-body portrait of a curly-haired male scholar inspired by Democritus, seated behind a wooden desk and wearing layered traditional robes in muted blue-gray and brown with intricate trim. His face is intentionally obscured by a flat rectangular block in a brown skin-tone color, creating an anonymized or redacted look. He holds 1 calligraphy brush upright in his right hand, while his left hand rests on the table. In the upper center-right, place the Claude logo with a rust-orange sunburst emblem and the word “Claude” in dark serif lettering. On the upper left, add a large vertical title in Chinese, “德米斯圖”, with 1 vertical column of smaller Chinese calligraphy text beside it reading: “以語言為媒，理解為舟，助人洞見，推動協作，造福人類，安全可信，通往更美好的未來。” Add a smaller vertical signature line on the far left reading “甲辰春寫” with 2 red seal stamps below it. The background shows a classical Chinese landscape painting with distant mountains, a small pavilion on a cliff, mist, and dense bamboo leaves framing the upper right and right edge, plus dark pine branches on the lower left.

The wooden desk fills the lower third and contains exactly 8 distinct object groups: 1 brush pot holding 4 brushes on the left, 1 stack of 4 stitched books with Chinese titles on the spines reading “人工智慧概論”, “機器學習原理”, “負責任的 AI”, and “對齊與價值觀”, 1 ink stone or ink dish near the center-left, 1 central parchment diagram sheet, 1 small dark cube seal near the bottom left with Chinese characters on two visible faces, 1 framed placard on the right, 1 rolled scroll at the bottom right, and 1 tabletop surface with visible wood grain. The central parchment diagram should show a circular node labeled “AI 安全 Safety” connected to 6 surrounding nodes labeled “準確”, “可靠”, “有益”, “透明”, “對齊”, and “隱私”, with delicate cloud motifs around the diagram. The framed placard on the right should read “AI 安全原則” as a header and list 4 bullet points in Chinese: “減少災難性風險”, “尊重人類價值觀”, “確保系統可控”, and “促進長遠福祉”. The rolled scroll at the bottom right should display the phrase “以謹慎之心 創造未來”.

Use a balanced composition, scholarly calm mood, highly detailed ink linework, subtle watercolor shading, antique museum-print aesthetics, and a restrained palette of parchment tan, ink brown, faded blue, and muted charcoal. The overall feeling should be an intellectual tribute poster blending classical East Asian literati painting, philosophical portraiture, and contemporary AI safety themes.

items.title: Minecraft Ender Dragon Fantasy Poster
items.titleZh: Create a dramatic vertical dark-fantasy poster in a Minecraft-inspired voxel style, like an epic movie or game cover. At the very top, place a large ornate metallic-gold blackletter title reading {argument name="headline text" default="[Heliocore.C6]"}, with a smaller elegant serif subtitle beneath it reading {argument name="subtitle" default="The Final Convergence"}. The main scene shows 1 massive Ender Dragon made of black cubic blocks, flying forward and downward out of the sky with its wings spread wide, mouth open, glowing purple eyes, and violet energy in its throat, while chunks of voxel debris break apart around its body. Behind the dragon, place 3 large concentric glowing magic circles with arcane runes and geometric symbols in pale gold light, centered in the sky like a summoning seal. In the foreground, show 1 blocky hero seen from behind, resembling Steve, standing on a ruined stone staircase-throne and raising 1 glowing purple enchanted sword toward the dragon. Surround the platform with 4 visible Endermen total, tall and slender with black blocky bodies and glowing purple eyes, acting as ominous witnesses. The environment is an enormous ruined End-city style abyss with towering broken pillars, floating block fragments, crystal clusters, and distant structures fading into purple fog. Use a palette of black, charcoal, deep violet, magenta glow, and antique gold highlights, with cinematic volumetric lighting, heavy atmosphere, sparks, dust, magical particles, extreme scale, high contrast, and a polished ultra-detailed poster composition.

items.titleZh: A dynamic anime action illustration of two young martial-arts women fighting inside a traditional Japanese-style wooden dojo. The left fighter is in the foreground, a black-haired girl with a neat bun tied by a yellow ribbon, wearing a sleeveless yellow Chinese kung fu tunic with black trim, loose black pants, and black cloth shoes. She is in a deep low stance on the wooden floor, one fist pulled back and the other punching forward, surrounded by bright red energy trails that arc around her body and sweep across the scene. Water splashes dramatically around her feet as if her movement skims through a shallow layer of water. The right fighter is airborne in the midground, a pale-skinned girl with light lavender hair in two round buns, wearing a short black-and-white cheongsam-inspired battle dress with gold trim, black sheer tights, and black shoes. She performs a flying side kick while a vivid blue energy spiral curls around her in a circular motion. The collision of force between them has cracked and exploded the wooden floor at center-right, with debris and wood fragments flying outward, while dust and smoke billow across the lower right corner. The dojo interior has exposed timber beams, tatami edging, shoji-style windows, and warm natural light entering from the left. Hang a wooden sign above them with the Chinese text {argument name="sign text" default="币安 vs OKX"}. Use a dramatic wide-angle composition, strong foreshortening, cinematic motion blur, intense speed lines, high-detail anime rendering, glossy highlights, clean line art, energetic combat choreography, and a polished poster-like finish. Add exactly 2 visible fighters, 1 overhead wooden sign, 1 cracked floor impact point, 1 red energy effect around the left fighter, and 1 blue energy effect around the right fighter. Optionally place a subtle watermark-like text at the lower right reading {argument name="watermark text" default="UM YouMind"}.

items.title: Retro RPG Item Grid Prompt
items.titleZh: Create a {argument name="grid size" default="10x10"} grid containing {argument name="item count" default="100"} different fantasy role-playing game (RPG) items in a {argument name="art style" default="classic pixel art style"} (16-bit or 32-bit sprite style, similar to Japanese RPGs from the SNES/GBA era). Each item should occupy a square tile individually with a short, clear label below. The grid should be neatly arranged on a white background. Ensure each item is visually unique and every label is spelled correctly. Use clean pixel edges, a limited palette for each sprite, and subtle dithering for shadows. Use the following row themes: Row 1: Swords and blades; Row 2: Shields and armor; Row 3: Bows, crossbows, and ranged weapons; Row 4: Staves, wands, and magical implements; Row 5: Potions, elixirs, and bottles; Row 6: Scrolls, grimoires, and spellbooks; Row 7: Rings, amulets, and enchanted accessories; Row 8: Helmets, crowns, and headgear; Row 9: Keys, relics, and quest items; Row 10: Gems, runes, and crafting materials. Display each tile as a centered item sprite on a clean background square, presented in the form of classic inventory icons—similar to what you'd see in a fantasy RPG menu. Maintain consistency and coherence in the overall style, reminiscent of beloved retro fantasy RPGs—charming and refined, yet clear even at small sizes.
items.prompt: 创建一个 {argument name="网格尺寸" default="10×10"} 的网格，其中包含 {argument name="物品数量" default="100"} 种不同的奇幻角色扮演游戏 (RPG) 物品，采用{argument name="艺术风格" default="经典的像素艺术风格"}（16 位或 32 位精灵图风格，类似于 SNES/GBA 时代的日式角色扮演游戏）。每个物品应单独占据一个正方形图块，并在下方附上简短清晰的标签。网格应整齐排列在白色背景上。确保每个物品在视觉上都独具特色，并且每个标签的拼写都正确。使用清晰的像素边缘，每个精灵使用有限的调色板，并使用轻微的抖动效果来表现阴影。使用以下行主题：第 1 行：剑和刀剑；第 2 行：盾牌和盔甲；第 3 行：弓、弩和远程武器；第 4 行：法杖、魔杖 and 魔法法器；第 5 行：药水、药剂 and 药瓶；第 6 行：卷轴、典籍 and 魔法书；第 7 行：戒指、护身符 and 附魔饰品；第 8 行：头盔、王冠 and 头饰；第 9 行：钥匙、圣物 and 任务物品；第 10 行：宝石、符文 and 制作材料。将每个图块显示为居中的物品精灵，置于干净的背景方块上，并以经典的物品栏图标形式呈现——类似于你在奇幻角色扮演游戏菜单中看到的那种。保持整体风格的一致性、连贯性，并让人联想起备受喜爱的复古奇幻角色扮演游戏——既迷人又精致，即使在小尺寸下也清晰易读。

items.title: Photorealistic Boeing 747 Cockpit
items.titleZh: Ultra-realistic interior photograph of a {argument name="aircraft model" default="Boeing 747"} cockpit viewed from slightly behind and between the two pilot seats, centered and perfectly symmetrical, showing the full main instrument panel, center pedestal, dual control yokes, and the overhead switch panel across the top edge of the frame. The cockpit is unoccupied, with 2 pilot seats visible in the foreground, each with light gray or off-white sheepskin seat covers, and 2 control yokes each holding a dark rectangular checklist or electronic note board clipped to the center. The main panel is densely packed with authentic-looking avionics, analog dials, autopilot controls, radio panels, and 6 illuminated display screens total: 2 large central navigation displays, 2 smaller blue-toned flight displays near the left and right sides, and 2 green text/data screens on the lower center pedestal. Include 4 throttle levers in the center, plus additional flap and systems levers, rotary knobs, guarded switches, and weathered brown-gray metal surfaces typical of a widebody airliner cockpit. The overhead panel should be crowded with rows of switches, toggles, and indicator lights, partially shadowed but sharply detailed. Through the front cockpit windows, show an airport gate scene in soft focus with pale concrete tarmac, painted ground markings, and a passenger jet bridge connected or positioned near the aircraft. Lighting is natural daylight from outside, subdued inside the cockpit, with realistic shadows, mild reflections on glass screens, and documentary-style photographic color grading. Emphasize extreme detail, realism, authentic aviation engineering complexity, and a near indistinguishable-from-real photo quality. Shot with a full-frame camera, eye-level perspective, wide lens around 24–28mm, deep focus across the instrument panel, high dynamic range, no people, no dramatic stylization, no illustration look.

items.title: Three Floral Chickens Portrait
items.titleZh: A whimsical studio portrait of 3 full-body chickens standing side by side against a clean light gray seamless background, centered with soft diffused lighting and subtle shadows beneath their feet. Each chicken is sculpted entirely from layered flower petals and blossoms while keeping realistic chicken anatomy, skinny scaly legs, clawed feet, beaks, wattles, and combs. The left chicken is cream and ivory colored, fluffy and rounded, decorated with pale white blossoms and tiny sprigs of baby's breath, with oversized round googly eyes and a surprised, innocent expression. The center chicken is dusty pink and blush colored, built from dense overlapping petals and medium flower heads, with a long drooping pink comb falling over one eye, a stern intense expression, and floral detailing around the neck and body. The right chicken is vivid orange, amber, and golden yellow, made of marigold-like petals and warm autumn flowers, with narrowed sleepy eyes, a tall red-orange comb, and a grumpy unimpressed expression. Emphasize intricate botanical texture, handcrafted floral sculpture realism, playful character design, high detail, sharp focus, symmetrical lineup composition, and a cute surreal fine-art aesthetic.

items.title: Crimson Space Opera Key Visual
items.titleZh: A dramatic vertical sci-fi key visual poster for a dark space opera game, featuring a single colossal alien-mechanical spacecraft centered slightly low in the frame, angled diagonally from lower left toward upper right as if surging forward through space. The ship is razor-sharp, asymmetrical, and aggressively organic, built from layered black metal and glowing crimson-red armor plates, with a long spear-like prow, many jagged fins, and about 12 to 16 whip-like tendrils or spines streaming backward from its upper rear like biomechanical hair. Behind it floats a large shadowed planet at center, encircled by 3 luminous red orbital rings that create a halo effect. At upper left, include 1 cratered moon or planet partially cropped by the frame. Scatter multiple dark asteroids and rocky debris across the foreground and edges, especially lower right and lower left, to create depth. The background is a dense starfield with red nebula clouds and streaks of fiery cosmic dust. In the upper right, place a blazing orange-white sun flare breaking into the scene, casting hot rim light across the ship and rings. Use a high-contrast palette of black, deep crimson, ember red, and white highlights, with glossy metallic reflections and a grim, apocalyptic mood. Add vertical Japanese tagline text on the right side in white Mincho-style serif characters: 「あの太陽に飛び込めば 冷めきった私の心も温かくなるのだろうか」. At the bottom center, add the main title in very large distressed white Japanese serif characters with cracked texture and subtle red glow: 「斑鳩の柩」. Beneath it, add 1 line of smaller red katakana subtitle text: 「イカルガのクルスー」, and beneath that 1 line of small Roman letters in red: "IKARUGA NO CRUX". Make it look like premium anime game key art, cinematic poster composition, ultra-detailed, sharp focus, dynamic lighting, epic scale, ominous and beautiful.

items.title: Mechanical Keyboard Product Page Mockup
items.titleZh: Create a clean modern e-commerce product detail page for a premium mechanical keyboard brand called {argument name="brand name" default="KeyForge"}, presented as a high-fidelity desktop website mockup on a white background with subtle light-gray dividers and generous spacing. The layout is a single unified storefront scene with a top navigation bar, a left product thumbnail rail, a large center product hero image, and a right-side purchase information panel. In the header, place the bold wordmark on the far left, then 7 navigation items reading “Keyboards”, “Switches”, “Keycaps”, “Accessories”, “Sale”, “Blog”, and “Support”, and on the far right 3 icons for search, account, and cart, with a small black notification badge showing “1” on the cart. The main product shown in the center is a compact 75% mechanical keyboard photographed from a slightly elevated front angle on a pale gray stage, with an aluminum case in silver, white and gray keycaps, several accent keys in lavender purple, and a silver volume knob at the top right. The left vertical gallery contains exactly 5 thumbnails: 1 selected front product shot, 1 angled keyboard view, 1 mechanical switch close-up, 1 keycap texture close-up, and 1 dark video thumbnail with a circular play icon. The right product panel includes a small pill badge reading “NEW”, a large bold product name {argument name="product name" default="KeyForge K75 Pro"}, a subtitle “75% Mechanical Keyboard”, a 5-star rating row with 4.8 and “(126 reviews)”, a large bold price {argument name="price" default="$129.99"} followed by a green “In Stock” status, and a short two-sentence description about premium performance, gasket-mounted design, QMK/VIA support, and RGB. Under that, include a “Switch Type” selector with exactly 4 pill buttons labeled “Cherry MX Red”, “Gateron Brown”, “Gateron Blue”, and “TTC Gold Pink”, with the first selected; a “Color” selector with exactly 3 pill buttons labeled “White / Purple”, “Black / Gray”, and “Navy / Blue”, with the first selected; a “Quantity” dropdown set to “1”; one large black primary button labeled “Add to Cart” with a cart icon; and one outlined secondary button labeled “Add to Wishlist” with a heart icon. Beneath the buttons, show exactly 3 horizontal service highlights with small icons: “Free Shipping” with subtext “On orders over $99”, “30-Day Returns” with subtext “Hassle-free returns”, and “2-Year Warranty” with subtext “Peace of mind”. In the lower content area, create a two-column section separated by light lines. On the left is a vertical tab list with exactly 5 items: “Overview” selected, then “Specifications”, “What’s in the Box”, “Shipping & Returns”, and “Reviews (126)”. To the right of the tabs, place a rounded white feature card grid with exactly 6 feature blocks in 2 rows of 3, each with a simple line icon, bold title, and short explanatory text: “75% Layout”, “Gasket-Mounted”, “QMK/VIA Support”, “Hot-Swappable”, “RGB Backlighting”, and “Premium Build”. On the far right of this lower area, add a specifications bullet list with exactly 7 bullets: “Layout: 75% (82 Keys)”, “Switch Type: Cherry MX Red”, “Mounting: Gasket-Mounted”, “Connectivity: USB-C (Wired)”, “Backlight: RGB, South-facing”, “Material: Aluminum Case”, and “Dimensions: 322 x 135 x 42 mm”, plus an additional final bullet “Weight: 1.25 kg”. Use a refined minimalist product-design aesthetic, realistic UI spacing, clean sans-serif typography similar to Inter or SF Pro, soft shadows, subtle rounded corners, monochrome icons, and polished startup-style consumer electronics presentation.

items.title: Chinese Calligraphy Poem Scroll
items.titleZh: A traditional Chinese ink wash hanging-scroll painting on warm aged rice paper, vertical composition, with six large vertical columns of bold black brush-calligraphy occupying the upper and right half of the image. The calligraphy should be highly legible expressive Chinese cursive-regular script with varied ink density and natural brush taper, reading from right to left in 6 columns: "金樽清酒斗十千 玉盘珍羞直万钱", "停杯投箸不能食 拔剑四顾心茫然", "欲渡黄河冰塞川 将登太行雪满山", "闲来垂钓碧溪上 忽复乘舟梦日边", "行路难 行路难 多歧路 今安在", "长风破浪会有时 直挂云帆济沧海". Add one smaller vertical inscription on the left side reading "李白行路难" with a small red seal stamp beneath it. In the lower left foreground, depict an ancient Chinese scholar-poet in flowing white and pale gray robes with a blue sash, long black hair in a traditional topknot with loose strands and ribbon, standing on the edge of a dark rocky cliff, body angled right and head lifted upward in a contemplative, heroic pose. Below and across the lower half, paint a turbulent river or sea with white crashing waves in monochrome ink and soft gray washes; in the distance, faint misty mountains and fog dissolve into the paper. Classical literati painting style, dynamic calligraphy as the main focus, poetic and majestic mood, restrained palette of black ink, gray wash, off-white paper, and a small touch of muted blue on the robe, ample negative space, museum-quality Chinese shanshui and calligraphy fusion.

items.title: Visit Malaysia 2026 Travel Poster
items.titleZh: A luxurious tourism poster for {argument name="destination" default="Malaysia"}, designed as a vertical fine-art travel advertisement on a clean ivory-white textured background with subtle embossed ornamental patterns. The composition is built around one long flowing red-and-gold batik silk ribbon that sweeps diagonally and spirals through the page, forming an elegant S-curve and visually containing a dreamlike collage of landmarks, culture, and nature. At the top left, warm golden sunrise light pours over misty tropical mountains and rainforest with a waterfall, dense palms, and a large rhinoceros hornbill perched beside hibiscus flowers and white tropical blossoms. In the upper center, a detailed Kuala Lumpur skyline rises from mist, dominated by the Petronas Twin Towers, with the KL Tower and several modern skyscrapers visible. Near the upper right floats 1 colorful traditional wau kite with floral patterns against open white space. In the middle left, include 1 grand mosque with multiple domes and minarets set among palms and haze. In the middle center-right, include the historic Sultan Abdul Samad Building with its copper domes and clocktower. In the lower middle left, include 1 elevated red-and-silver urban train crossing through the city. In the lower center, show 1 ornate Chinatown gate labeled Jalan Petaling, decorated with red lanterns and bustling pedestrians. In the lower right-middle, depict the Batu Caves area with 1 towering golden Murugan statue and 1 steep rainbow staircase climbing into limestone cliffs, surrounded by crowds. At the lower right, nestle 1 landscaped city park with a turquoise lake and fountains. Purple orchids and tropical flowers are woven into the ribbon and foreground in several places. At the very bottom right, show 1 small traditional dancer in red and gold attire twirling the trailing end of the ribbon. The collage should feel luminous, hyper-detailed, majestic, and celebratory, blending photorealistic architecture with painterly fantasy travel-poster styling, soft clouds, atmospheric haze, and glowing highlights. Add elegant poster typography in the lower left: the main headline reads {argument name="headline text" default="VISIT MALAYSIA 2026"}, a smaller location line reads {argument name="location text" default="KUALA LUMPUR"}, a blue script tourism slogan reads {argument name="tagline" default="Malaysia Truly Asia"}, and below that a small refined subheading reads {argument name="subheading" default="Where Diversity Converges\nKuala Lumpur, City of Wonders\nThe Heart of Asia"}. Use a premium color palette of gold, crimson, ivory, emerald, sky blue, and tropical greens, with polished editorial composition and high-end destination-branding aesthetics.
items.promptZh: {argument name="destination" default="Malaysia"} 的豪华旅游海报，设计为垂直艺术旅游广告，采用干净的象牙白色纹理背景，并带有微妙的浮雕装饰图案。该构图围绕一条长长的流动的红色和金色蜡染丝带构建，该丝带沿对角线扫过并螺旋穿过页面，形成优雅的 S 曲线，在视觉上包含地标、文化和自然的梦幻拼贴。在左上方，温暖的金色日出光线倾泻在薄雾笼罩的热带山脉和雨林上，有瀑布、茂密的棕榈树和一只巨大的犀鸟栖息在木槿花和白色的热带花朵旁边。在中上部，详细的吉隆坡天际线从薄雾中升起，以双子塔为主，吉隆坡塔和几座现代摩天大楼清晰可见。右上角附近漂浮着 1 个色彩缤纷的传统 wau 风筝，其花卉图案与开放的白色空间相映成趣。左中角有 1 座大清真寺，其多个圆顶和尖塔坐落在棕榈树和薄雾之中。中间偏右，包括历史悠久的苏丹阿都沙末大厦及其铜质圆顶和钟楼。中左下角有 1 列红银相间的高架城市列车穿过城市。在中下方，展示了 1 个华丽的唐人街大门，标有 Jalan Petaling，装饰着红色灯笼和熙熙攘攘的行人。右中下方描绘了黑风洞地区，有 1 座高耸的金色 Murugan 雕像和 1 座陡峭的彩虹楼梯，攀爬到石灰岩悬崖上，周围都是人群。右下角是一座风景优美的城市公园，有碧绿的湖泊和喷泉。紫色兰花和热带花卉被编织到丝带和前景的几个地方。在最右下角，展示了 1 位穿着红色和金色服装的小型传统舞者，正在旋转丝带的尾端。拼贴画应该给人明亮、细致、雄伟和喜庆的感觉，将逼真的建筑与绘画奇幻的旅行海报风格、柔和的云彩、大气的薄雾和发光的亮点融为一体。在左下角添加优雅的海报排版：主标题为{argument name="headline text" default="VISIT MALAYSIA 2026"}，较小的位置线为{argument name="location text" default="KUALA LUMPUR"}，蓝色字体旅游口号为{argument name="tagline" default="Malaysia Truly Asia"}，在其下方有一个精致的小标题为{argument name="subheading" default="多元化汇聚之处\n吉隆坡，奇迹之城\n亚洲之心"}。使用金色、深红色、象牙色、翡翠色、天蓝色和热带绿色等优质调色板，搭配精美的编辑构图和高端目的地品牌美学。

items.title: Futuristic Photonics Magazine Cover
items.titleZh: A hyper-detailed French popular science magazine cover in the style of a bold mainstream newsstand publication, full-page vertical layout, dramatic glossy print design, black background with intense neon lighting and saturated red, blue, purple, green, and orange highlights. At the very top, a wide red masthead bar with the magazine title {argument name="magazine title" default="SCIENCE & VIE"} in huge white serif capital letters with subtle beveling and metallic shine; small issue details on the upper right in tiny white text. On the upper left, a bright yellow and black special tag reading {argument name="special tag" default="SPÉCIAL PHOTONIQUE"} with a red arrow motif. The main headline dominates most of the upper half in gigantic white block capitals with a red glow and slight 3D shadow: {argument name="main headline" default="LA PHOTONIQUE RÉVOLUTIONNE TOUT !"}. Beneath it, 3 short cover lines in smaller white text with selected words highlighted in yellow, discussing ultrafast light-speed chips, a French record computer called Lucy, and light trapped for millions of cycles for energy-efficient AI. Centerpiece image: a futuristic square photonic processor chip floating in space at a slight perspective tilt, extremely detailed circuitry, metallic screws at the corners, glowing traces, and a bright cyan-blue core display labeled {argument name="chip name" default="Lucy"}; the chip emits intersecting beams and flowing fiber-optic light trails in electric blue, magenta, orange, and violet that radiate outward across the page. Background behind the chip shows 2 luminous server-wall corridors, red on the left and green on the right, fading into darkness, suggesting a high-tech datacenter. At the bottom, the curved horizon of Earth from space with a soft blue atmospheric glow and scattered city lights. Add 4 side callout boxes total: 2 stacked on the left and 2 stacked on the right, each with yellow headers and white body text, using a magazine cover typography hierarchy. Left box 1 header: "EXCLUSIF", featuring Lucy as the most powerful French photonic quantum computer in the world, with several short bullet lines and a yellow emphasis on "12 qubits". Left box 2 header: "RECORD MONDIAL", about light trapped for millions of cycles in a chip, with yellow emphasis on "millions de cycles". Right box 1 header area in yellow, with a bold red percentage "+300 %" and text about the French gem Soitec rising thanks to photonic AI and saving datacenters during the energy crisis. Right box 2 header: "ENQUÊTE", about the end of power-hungry GPUs, with yellow-highlighted numeric claims such as 100 times cheaper and 1,000 times faster. Near the lower center, tiny white image-credit text. A thick black bottom banner spans the page with a red square containing a white plus symbol on the left, and a large dossier teaser in white and red text: {argument name="bottom feature text" default="DOSSIER COMPLET Photonique & IA : les 10 avancées qui vont transformer votre quotidien"}. Along the very bottom, add 3 small circular red icon blurbs with short white captions about seismic optical fibers, a new generation of LiDAR and AR, and European sovereignty in progress. Lower right corner includes a white barcode box and a short block of white text about the issue being on sale. Overall look: sensational, prestigious, futuristic, glossy, information-dense, sharp editorial typography, dramatic science-news cover, cinematic lighting, high contrast, photorealistic 3D chip illustration mixed with premium magazine graphic design.

items.title: Anime Martial Arts Duel in Dojo
items.titleZh: A dramatic anime action illustration inside an old wooden martial arts hall, showing two young women in mid-battle with explosive motion and elemental energy trails. In the foreground, a fierce female martial artist lunges low toward the viewer in a powerful punching stance, her right fist extended straight ahead and her body twisted dynamically. She has dark black hair tied into a messy high bun with loose strands and red ribbons, sharp intense eyes, and a focused combative expression. She wears a white traditional Chinese martial arts top with red trim, red tassel frog closures, and subtle embroidered patterns, paired with flowing deep red pants and black cloth shoes with red accents. Red ribbon-like energy and glowing scarlet brushstroke arcs coil around her arms, torso, and legs, sweeping across the frame like fiery calligraphy. In the upper right, a second young woman leaps through the air in a defensive or spellcasting pose, one hand stretched outward. She has {argument name="hair color" default="light purple"} hair styled in two buns with trailing strands and ornate gold hair ornaments. She wears a dark green Chinese-style dress with gold embroidery, black stockings, and dark shoes. Bright blue water-like energy spirals around her in a large circular arc, splashing and glittering with luminous droplets. Set the scene in a weathered dojo or wuguan interior with tall wooden beams, hanging lanterns, broken floorboards, flying splinters, dust, sparks, and debris exploding from the impact of the fight. Include one large wooden signboard above them with the black calligraphy text 武术会, plus two vertical hanging banners, the left reading 以武会友 and the right reading 刚柔并济. Use a low-angle cinematic perspective, strong foreshortening, extreme motion, dense particles, and dramatic warm-vs-cool color contrast between the red and blue energy. Highly detailed anime painting, ultra-dynamic composition, sharp linework, rich textures, glowing effects, volumetric lighting, and epic battle key visual quality.

Her face is mostly obscured by the angle. She wears a richly layered, ornate Japanese court kimono inspired by a jūnihitoe, with voluminous sleeves and many overlapping panels in crimson, white, purple, green, gold, and soft pink, decorated with floral brocade, embroidered blossoms, metallic trim, and shimmering patterns. The setting is a moonlit lakeshore covered in fresh snow, with bare winter trees on the right, a small traditional pavilion or shrine structure across the water on the left, and the bright full moon high in a deep indigo sky filled with dense stars and softly falling snow. The water mirrors the moonlight and glittering particles. Emphasize cinematic lighting, ethereal atmosphere, ultra-detailed fabric textures, dynamic flowing motion, magical sparkle effects, elegant composition, and a dreamlike celestial mood. items.titleZh: A whimsical minimalist illustration of a {argument name="cat breed" default="brown tabby kitten"} standing upright in the exact center of a very tall vertical canvas, with an absurdly elongated, noodle-like body stretched from near the top to near the bottom of the image. The cat has a small round face with large glossy eyes, a tiny open smiling mouth, upright ears, and both front paws raised straight overhead in a cheering pose, showing 2 visible pink paw pads. Its fur is soft and detailed, with a white muzzle, chest, belly, and inner legs, and brown-and-black tabby stripes along the sides, head, arms, and tail. The body is extremely thin and vertically extended, creating a comical exaggerated proportion, while the hind paws remain tiny and close together at the bottom. Add 1 curved striped tail extending to the lower right side. Above the head, place the playful hand-drawn text "{argument name="caption text" default="nyoooon~"}" in a rounded dark brown font, arched like a semicircle, with 6 short motion lines around the raised paws and text to emphasize stretching. Use a clean off-white or warm light beige background with no scenery, only a faint soft oval shadow beneath the feet. Cute, polished digital illustration style, centered composition, high detail in fur, humorous Japanese sticker or social-media mascot vibe, lots of negative space, extra-tall aspect ratio.

items.titleZh: A side-by-side desktop screenshot comparing two nearly identical AI-generated street portraits in separate macOS-style image viewer windows against a light cyan background. The layout has exactly 2 vertical image panels, left and right, each inside a rounded gray window with a toolbar at the top. The left window title begins with "NanoBanana2" and the right window title begins with "ChatGPTImage2". In both panels, show the same scene concept: a fashionable young woman standing on a city street corner during golden hour, framed from about mid-thigh to head, with her face obscured by a soft rectangular blur block. She has long wavy brown hair, a slim figure, and wears an off-shoulder fitted cream long-sleeve top, high-waisted blue jeans, a delicate small pendant necklace, and a large black leather shoulder bag with a gold-tone chain strap over one shoulder. She holds a black smartphone in one hand near her waist. The background in both panels is an upscale tree-lined urban street with warm sunlight filtering through leaves, shallow depth of field, parked and passing cars, old stone buildings, and a visible green traffic light near the upper left area of each image. Keep the two portraits very similar but not identical: the left image is slightly cooler, softer, and more muted with a centered street perspective; the right image is slightly warmer, brighter, and crisper with stronger sunlight on the hair and more dramatic bokeh. Include exactly 2 viewer windows separated by a narrow vertical gap, with subtle drop shadows and a clean tech-comparison presentation, as if capturing a visual comparison between two image generation models.

items.title: Cute Bunny Hiragana Poster
items.titleZh: Create a cute Japanese preschool hiragana poster in a soft watercolor storybook style on warm textured parchment paper. The composition is a vertical educational chart with a whimsical spring border of grass, flowers, mushrooms, butterflies, and tiny chicks, designed like a children's classroom learning sheet. At the top, place a wooden signboard header with colorful rounded Japanese text reading {argument name="headline text" default="うさぎのひらがな表"}, decorated with 2 white bunny mascots, one sitting on the left and one peeking from the right, plus small flowers and leaves around the sign. Below the header, arrange a clean 5-row by 8-column grid for a total of 40 square cells, each cell outlined in thin brown lines on a cream background. In every cell, place one large brightly colored hiragana character near the top and one small kawaii rabbit illustration below it, each rabbit acting out or holding an object associated with the word written underneath. Use a different cheerful color for many of the hiragana characters, including reds, oranges, yellows, greens, blues, and purples, with a hand-painted rounded font. Keep the text and illustrations exactly as follows, left to right by row: row 1 has 8 cells labeled あ, い, う, う, え, え, お, お with the words あめ, いい, いい, うさぎ, えんぴつ, えんぴつ, おやすり, おにぎり; row 2 has 8 cells labeled か, き, く, け, せ, せ, そ, そ with the words きくら, たま, サベツン, ケーキ, せんせい, そう, そう, しょうこう; row 3 has 8 cells labeled た, ち, ち, つ, て, て, と, と with the words たまご, たまご, ちびこ, つと, てんとうむし, てしなを, とうこ, ほしい; row 4 has 8 cells labeled な, に, ぬ, ふ, め, ね, の, ほ with the words まな, ひこうき, みんきう, ふたう, てつ, へびす, ようこ, ほし; row 5 has 8 cells labeled ま, み, む, る, れ, れ, ろ, ん with the words わた, まくら, みかん, むぎぎ, めがみ, もも, ろうた, ん. The bunny illustrations should be varied and adorable: examples include holding an umbrella, cuddling grapes, drawing with a pencil, eating a rice ball, sitting with cherry blossoms, standing under an umbrella, holding fruit, eating cake, dressed as a teacher, holding flowers, sleeping under a blue blanket, carrying eggs, hugging a tomato, holding strawberries, blowing bubbles, wearing a blue cap, holding an orange, sitting with cotton, bathing in a wooden tub, and holding candy. Maintain a gentle pastel palette, soft shading, round faces, rosy cheeks, and subtle ink outlines. The overall feeling should be nostalgic, charming, educational, highly detailed, and perfect for a nursery wall chart or a cute slide cover for a Japanese learning presentation.

items.title: Two-Era Naval Comparison Poster
items.titleZh: Create a cinematic Japanese naval comparison poster in a highly detailed, photorealistic concept-art style with a warm amber sunset palette, dramatic clouds, glowing backlight, and a premium movie-poster plus technical-reference-sheet layout. The composition is vertically stacked in 2 main zones. In the top hero zone, show 2 large semi-transparent officer portraits facing inward, one on the left in an older imperial-era naval uniform and one on the right in a modern maritime self-defense force style dress uniform, both wearing peaked caps and formal dark coats, with a blazing sunset sky behind them. Centered between them, place a large serif English title reading {argument name="headline text" default="Fog of Two Eras"}, with a smaller Japanese subtitle beneath it reading ふたつの時代の霧, and 2 lines of Japanese tagline text above the title. Below the title, on the ocean at golden hour, show 2 warships moving forward on slightly converging paths: on the left, a massive World War II-era battleship with many large gun turrets, tower superstructure, weathered dark hull, and white bow spray; on the right, a modern gray guided-missile destroyer with hull number 115 visible on the bow, sleek radar-equipped superstructure, and foamy wake. Add exactly 4 helicopters in the sky, 2 on the left side and 2 on the right side, plus a suspension bridge and distant modern city skyline on the horizon. In the lower reference-sheet zone, split the page into 2 vertical panels, left for the historical ship and right for the modern ship, each panel styled like a parchment-toned military specification board with dark blue and dark red header bars, fine dividing lines, inset image boxes, and Japanese labels. The left panel should present exactly 1 large perspective render of the battleship, 3 orthographic ship views beneath it, 5 small labeled equipment/detail thumbnails in a row, 4 small head-and-shoulders uniform portraits, 4 full-body character turnaround views of a male naval officer, and 1 bottom scale silhouette of the ship beside a human figure with a 20m marker. The right panel should present exactly 1 large perspective render of the modern destroyer, 3 orthographic ship views beneath it, 6 small labeled equipment/detail thumbnails arranged around the ship references, 4 small head-and-shoulders uniform portraits, 4 full-body character lineup views including a central female officer in white cap and dark uniform, and 1 bottom scale silhouette of the ship beside a human figure with a 20m marker. Use visible Japanese headers and labels throughout, including a left historical title area and a right title area naming the ship as 護衛艦 あさつ (DDG-115). Make the whole image feel like a museum exhibition poster, military design sheet, and prestige historical sci-fi drama key art combined, with ultra-sharp detail, realistic metal textures, ocean reflections, aged paper panels, symmetrical balance, and polished editorial typography.

items.title: Zombie Survival RPG Anime Ad Poster
items.titleZh:
Create a dramatic Japanese mobile game advertisement poster for a zombie survival RPG in anime-meets-cinematic style. Vertical smartphone poster layout, dense promotional design, gritty urban apocalypse background at dusk with ruined city streets, smoke, sparks, debris, damaged buildings, neon signs, and a crowd of zombies advancing from behind. In the center, a young anime woman sits on the ground in a slightly slouched pose, legs bent, holding a black handgun upright in one hand. She has straight dark brown to black shoulder-length hair, pale skin, and an oversized dirty white T-shirt splattered with blood. Large bold Japanese calligraphy is printed vertically on the shirt: "働きたくね〜". Her expression area is simple and unobtrusive so the composition emphasizes the shirt, weapon, and mood. Surround her with multiple zombies in torn clothing, reaching forward from the left and right background.

Use an aggressive game key-art design with 8 clearly separated promotional sections. Section 1: top-left game logo block, count 3 text elements, with large distressed English title "Dead or work", smaller Japanese subtitle "ゾンビサバイバルRPG", and heavy black paint-splatter background with white and red text. Section 2: right-side vertical slogan area, count 2 text elements, with white Japanese text "動かない、ただ" above giant red vertical text "生き残れ。" on a rough black brushstroke strip. Section 3: left-middle feature list panel, count 4 feature rows, each row with a white icon in a black square and yellow/white Japanese copy; labels are "ゾンビを倒して生き延びろ", "拠点を強化・カスタマイズ", "仲間と協力プレイ", and "デイリーミッションで報酬GET". Section 4: right-middle bonus campaign panel, count 1 headline plus 3 reward items; headline in a bright jagged yellow burst says "今すぐ始めると 豪華特典プレゼント!" and beneath it are three item boxes labeled "ゴールド ×5000", "レア武器 (7日間)", and "サバイバルキット ×10". Section 5: lower-middle gameplay screenshot strip, count 4 thumbnails with captions; captions are "リアルタイムバトル!", "基地を自由にカスタム!", "仲間とレイドボスに挑め!", and "広大なオープンワールド!". Section 6: bottom call-to-action banner, count 2 text elements, with a huge yellow-and-red Japanese phrase "今すぐダウンロード!" and smaller white/red subtext "あなたの選択が、生死を分ける。". Section 7: bottom-right store badges, count 2 badges, showing App Store and Google Play style download buttons. Section 8: bottom-right QR area, count 1 QR code in a white square.

Overall aesthetic: hyper-detailed, high-contrast, grimy, intense, commercially polished gacha/mobile game ad, combining anime character art with realistic zombie horror background. Use bold distressed typography, black brush textures, red warning colors, yellow promotional highlights, metallic UI framing, and cinematic orange-gray lighting.

items.title: Philosophical Concept Infographic Manuscript
items.titleZh: A breathtaking and extremely complex conceptual world-building infographic masterpiece of the "{argument name="theme" default="fundamental differences between Confucianism, Taoism, and Buddhism"}", overall designed as an ancient Eastern classical mythological manuscript. Background: pure white retro textured canvas, light beige aged parchment base color, with slight frayed edges and water stain effects. Core layout: The central visual adopts a grand "vertical egg-shaped layered structure", with Buddhism, Taoism, and Confucianism layers from top to bottom. Edge details: four corners adorned with fine microscopic illustrations themed on ancient observation notes, ritual implements, and runes. Color: low-saturation sage green, light gold, and off-white as main tones, generally light and soft without piercing high-saturation colors. Details: architectural lines, landscape brushwork techniques, lotus patterns, and cloud layers are clearly visible and rendered with extreme detail. Seamless fusion: Natural transitions between the three layers via clouds and flowing water, seamlessly connecting Buddhist light, Taoist Taiji clouds, and Confucian scholarly atmosphere. Style: {argument name="art style" default="classical ink line art + low-saturation digital watercolor"}, with a light Chinese style ancient book manuscript texture. Text annotations: Pure traditional Chinese characters in a mottled ancient Song font, each annotation containing a short title + a line of poetic description, connected to details by dark gold hairline leads with no repetitive pointing. Aspect ratio: 3:4 vertical independent complete unit. Title Area (top): `Confucianism, Buddhism, Taoism: Fundamental Differences`. Central layered annotations: Top layer 'Buddhism': `Buddhism`, `Relationship between self and self`, `No-self, governing the heart, letting go`. Middle layer 'Taoism': `Taoism`, `Relationship between self and all things`, `Non-action, governing the body, keeping an open mind`. Bottom layer 'Confucianism': `Confucianism`, `Relationship between people`, `No-ego, governing the world, taking responsibility`. Side auxiliary annotations: Left: `Purity: clear heart and bright mind, severing afflictions`; `Stillness: following nature, returning to the original heart`; `Reverence: awe of responsibility, active engagement with the world`. Right: `60+ years refining the heart: looking past gains and losses, returning to the inner self`; `35-55 years being human: balance of tension and relaxation, following laws`; `7-35 years doing things: forging ahead with determination, building a career`. Bottom summary: `The balance between being in the world and being out of it is a high-level wisdom of life`.
items.prompt: 一幅令人叹为观止、极其复杂的「{argument name="主题" default="儒释道根本区别"}」概念世界构建信息图杰作，整体被设计成一部底蕴深厚的东方古典神话传说手稿。背景：纯白色复古纹理画布，浅米黄做旧牛皮纸底色，轻微毛边与水渍感。核心布局：中心视觉采用宏大的「竖版蛋形分层结构」，从上到下依次为释、道、儒三层。边缘边角料：四个角落点缀精细微观插图，主题为古代观测手记、法器与符文。色彩：低饱和鼠尾草绿、浅金、米白为主色调，整体清淡柔和，无刺眼高饱和色彩。细节：建筑线条、山水皴法、莲花纹路、云气层次清晰可见，纤毫毕现。无缝融合：三层之间通过云雾与水流自然过渡，释的佛光、道的太极云气、儒的书卷气息无缝衔接。风格：{argument name="艺术风格" default="古典墨水线稿+低饱和数字水彩"}，清淡国风古籍手稿质感。文字标注：纯正繁体汉字，采用斑驳古风宋体，每个标注含短标题+一行诗意描述，由暗金色发丝引线连接对应细节，无重复指向。画幅比例：3:4竖版独立完整标题区（顶部）：`儒釋道·根本區別`中心分层标注：顶层「釋」：`釋`，`人與自己的關係`，`無我·治心·放得下`中层「道」：`道`，`人與萬物的關係`，`無為·治身·想得開`底层「儒」：`儒`，`人與人的關係`，`無己·治世·拿得起`左右辅助标注：左侧：`淨`，`清淨明心，斷除煩惱`；`靜`，`順應自然，回歸本心`；`敬`，`敬畏責任，積極入世`右侧：`60歲+修心`，`看淡得失，回歸內心`；`35-55歲做人`，`張弛有度，順應規律`；`7-35歲做事`，`銳意進取，建功立业`底部总结文字：`入世與出世之間的平衡，是高級的生活智慧`

items.title: Abstract Chaos Character Art
items.titleZh:
# Art that reveals a character's face from a chaotic collection of notes and symbols

---

## Style
- Mass of handwritten notes, formulas, symbols, and random lines in black ink on white paper.
- Scribbled chaos scattered across the paper.
- Sporadic emphasis using {argument name="accent color" default="red ink"} (lines, fills, marker-like blobs).
- Texture of analog notebook doodles.

---

## Composition
- Random notes and symbols cover the entire area.
- The density of black ink lines and characters concentrates on the position of the "character's face."
- As a result, the silhouette and expression of the given character's face faintly emerge from the chaos.
- The face is not realistic but formed by a collection of chaotic fragments.

---

## Color Palette
- Mainly monochrome (black and white).
- {argument name="accent color" default="red ink"} placed sporadically as an accent.
- Low saturation, emphasizing the feel of analog paper and ink.

---

## Expressive Elements
- Mixed strings of semi-readable Japanese, English, and numbers.
- Mathematical symbols, arrows, dots, slashes, crosses, and ink drips.
- The outlines of the face, eyes, and hair emerge from the "negative space" and "shading" of the symbol placement.

---

## Prohibitions
- Direct, realistic portraits.
- Digitally processed, orderly geometric patterns.
- Colorful or oversaturated expressions.
- Logos, watermarks, or artificial CG aesthetics.

---

## Definition of Done (DoD)
- The whole piece works as a "chaotic collection of notes and symbols."
- The provided character's face naturally emerges from the density and arrangement of chaos.
- Colors are monochrome + {argument name="accent color" default="red accent"} only.
- Maintains the hand-drawn texture of paper and ink.
items.prompt:
# 混沌としたメモ書き・記号の集合体からキャラクターの顔を浮かび上がらせるアート

---

## スタイル
- 白い紙の上に黒インクで描かれた大量の手書きメモ、数式、記号、ランダムな線。
- 紙いっぱいに散らばる書き殴り風のカオス。
- 所々に{argument name="アクセント色" default="赤インク"}の強調（ライン、塗り潰し、マーカー風の塊）。
- アナログのノート落書きのような質感。

---

## 構図
- ランダムなメモや記号が全体を覆い尽くす。
- 黒インクの線や文字の密度が「キャラクターの顔」の位置に集中する。
- 結果として、混沌の中から「与えられたキャラクターの顔のシルエット・表情」がうっすら浮かび上がる。
- 顔は写実的ではなく、カオスの断片が集まって形を成す。

---

## 色彩
- モノクロ（黒・白）を主体に構成。
- {argument name="アクセント色" default="赤インク"}をアクセントとして散発的に配置。
- 彩度は抑えめ、アナログの紙とインク感を重視。

---

## 表現要素
- 読めるようで読めない文字列、日本語や英数字が混在。
- 数式記号、矢印、点、斜線、クロス、ドリップ（インクの飛び散り）。
- キャラクターの顔の目や髪の輪郭は、メモや記号の配置の「余白」や「濃淡」で浮かび上がる。

---

## 禁止事項
- 顔を直接的に描き込む写実ポートレート。
- デジタル処理的で整然とした幾何学模様。
- カラフルな彩色や過飽和表現。
- ロゴ、透かし、人工的なCG感。

---

## Definition of Done (DoD)
- 全体は「混沌としたメモ・記号の集合体」として成立している。  
- 与えられたキャラクターの顔が、混沌の濃淡・配置から自然に浮かび上がる。  
- 色はモノクロ＋{argument name="アクセント色" default="赤アクセント"}のみ。  
- 紙とインクの手描き的質感を保持している。

items.title: Vintage Pomegranate Growth Atlas
items.titleZh:
Create a highly detailed vintage scientific botanical infographic poster on warm ivory paper, styled like a 19th-century natural history atlas plate with modern clean layout refinement. The main subject is a full pomegranate plant, labeled {argument name="plant name" default="石榴"} / {argument name="latin name" default="Punica granatum"}, shown centered from crown to roots in a full vertical cutaway-style presentation. Depict a slender woody trunk with many branches, glossy green leaves, several orange-red blossoms, unopened buds, young fruits, mature fruits, one large split-open pomegranate exposing dense ruby seeds, and a fully visible sprawling root system underground. Use delicate watercolor and ink rendering, realistic botanical anatomy, precise linework, subtle sepia shadows, fine leader lines, arrows, and small numbered callout circles. Overall poster title at upper left: {argument name="headline text" default="植物生命路径剖面"} with English subtitle directly below: {argument name="subtitle text" default="BOTANICAL GROWTH ATLAS"}. Add a short introductory bilingual-style text block beneath the title. The composition is a tall 9:16 educational poster with the plant occupying the center and explanatory diagrams surrounding it.

Include exactly 8 numbered educational sections around the plant, each with visible Chinese title and smaller English translation, arranged atlas-style:
1. Seed Architecture — a large cutaway seed diagram with labeled internal parts and a smaller cellular cross-section inset.
2. Germination Mechanism — a left-side sequence of exactly 5 stages showing seed swelling, cracking, sprouting, radicle emergence, and early seedling.
3. Root System + Substrate Intelligence — a large exposed root mass at lower left with exactly 2 circular magnified root-detail insets showing branching structures and root-hair/network texture.
4. Stem, Leaf & Vascular System — a right-middle section with exactly 2 anatomical circular cross-sections and exactly 1 separate leaf illustration, with labels for xylem, phloem, epidermis, and related tissues.
5. Photosynthesis + Energy Conversion — a lower-right biology panel with exactly 3 green microstructure diagrams, including leaf tissue/cell-like sections, plus a simple chemical flow line indicating CO2 + H2O to sugars and O2.
6. Bud Formation + Blooming — an upper-right flowering section with exactly 2 large flower anatomy diagrams, one side view and one longitudinal cutaway, with labeled stamens, petals, ovary, and pollen structures.
7. Pollination + Fruiting Pathway — a right-side development strip with exactly 5 fruit development stages from bud to mature pomegranate, accompanied by a pollination inset featuring a bee approaching a flower.
8. Fruit Maturation + Seed Cycle — a bottom-right lifecycle section with exactly 3 fruit illustrations showing whole fruit, cracked fruit, and opened fruit with scattered seeds, plus exactly 3 seedling progression drawings.

Along the very bottom edge, include a long chronological growth strip with exactly 19 small step illustrations, each numbered in sequence from 1 to 19, showing the plant life cycle from dormant seed through germination, root growth, seedling emergence, sapling development, flowering, fruit set, ripening, seed release, and cycle renewal. Add a small environmental factors panel at lower left with icon-like indicators for light, temperature, water, nutrients, and air. Use bilingual labeling throughout, with Chinese headings more prominent and English translations in smaller serif text. Aesthetic should feel scholarly, elegant, museum-quality, and information-dense, with refined antique typography, muted beige background, realistic reds and greens, and a clean balanced atlas layout.

items.title: Solar System Ice Cream Cones
items.titleZh: A whimsical, photorealistic product-style food photograph of 8 ice cream cones lined up in a straight row on a matte black rectangular stand, each scoop designed to look like a different planet of the solar system. The scene is shot at eye level with a shallow depth of field and creamy urban bokeh in the background, suggesting an outdoor city street or café setting in soft daylight. From left to right, show exactly 8 cones: a gray speckled Mercury scoop, a yellow-brown swirling Venus scoop, a blue-and-green Earth scoop with white cloud patterns and a small blue drip, a deep red Mars scoop with darker marbling and red melted drips, a striped Jupiter scoop with its Great Red Spot visible, a pale tan Saturn scoop with a thin ring encircling it, a light icy blue Uranus scoop with a blue drip, and a vivid cobalt-blue Neptune scoop with glossy texture and blue dripping melt. Use crisp waffle cones, realistic melting details, glossy frozen surfaces, careful studio-quality lighting, and a centered symmetrical composition. Keep the planets highly recognizable but rendered as believable ice cream, with the black stand spanning the width of the frame and the background softly blurred.

items.title: Surreal Octopus Burger Fine Dining Photo
items.titleZh: A dark, moody fine-dining restaurant scene photographed with direct flash and a slightly unsettling surreal-horror tone. Center the composition on a plated gourmet sandwich that looks like a realistic octopus used as the filling: a glossy golden-brown sesame burger bun on top of a fleshy pink-purple octopus body with detailed veins, pores, suction cups, wrinkled skin, and several visible tentacles protruding from the sides and front. The creature should appear cooked yet disturbingly lifelike, with one bulbous eye-like form visible on the left side and clustered holes and texture on the right side, creating an uncanny bio-organic appearance. The sandwich sits on a large round white ceramic plate with a pool of yellow butter-like or oily sauce spreading beneath it and a few small reddish droplets mixed into the sauce. In the foreground-left background place a small white dish holding a pat of butter. On the dining table include exactly 6 visible drinking glasses: 2 large red wine glasses, 3 tall white-wine or champagne-style stem glasses, and 1 dark beer glass at the right edge. In the back center place 1 small lit candle in a gold-toned holder and 1 small clear vase with white flowers. Use a white tablecloth, very dim ambient lighting, warm candle glow, strong camera flash reflections on the glassware, shallow casual snapshot framing, and a bizarre upscale restaurant presentation that feels grotesque, hyper-detailed, photorealistic, and intentionally shocking.

items.title: Owl-Shaped Nebula in Deep Space
items.titleZh: A majestic deep-space scene of an owl-shaped nebula floating in a black starfield, centered composition, the cosmic gas and dust naturally forming the clear face of an owl. Two large glowing circular eyes with bright electric-blue star cores, a narrow pointed beak of amber light between them, and two long upward-sweeping ear tufts made of burnt-orange and golden-brown nebula pillars. The body is formed from layered translucent clouds of warm copper, sepia, ivory, and cool smoky blue, with soft luminous edges and intricate filament textures. Surround the figure with many sharp stars of varying sizes, including several bright blue-white stars with subtle diffraction spikes. items.titleZh: A dramatic high-action anime fantasy illustration of a young female warrior with {argument name="hair color" default="jet black"} hair and piercing {argument name="eye color" default="bright blue"} eyes, shown in a dynamic low-angle close-to-mid shot as she swings a long segmented metal whip-sword in a wide circular arc around her body. Her hair is long, voluminous, and blowing violently in the wind, with sharp glossy strands and detailed highlights. She has a focused, fierce expression and is looking directly toward the viewer over her shoulder. She wears ornate black, silver, and gold-trimmed armor with a fitted bodice, armored gauntlets, shoulder plates, thigh armor, and a short layered skirt with flowing blue-and-white fabric panels and metallic decorations. The weapon forms a bright spiral ring across the foreground and upper right of the composition, with reflective steel segments, motion blur, and sparkling highlights. Small rocks and debris are suspended in the air from the force of the attack. items.title: Encyclopedia Style Infographic Generator
items.titleZh:
Please generate a high-quality vertical "Popular Science Encyclopedia Image" based on {argument name="theme" default="animals"}.

This image is not a regular poster or a simple illustration, but a modular popular science infographic that possesses a sense of "illustration book, encyclopedia, information structure, and collectability." The overall style should reference a combination of high-end natural history illustrations, modern encyclopedia pages, lifestyle knowledge cards, and highly shareable social media infographics.

Please include in the frame:
- A clear and beautiful main visual of the subject
- Several magnified details of local characteristics
- Multiple rounded modular information sections
- Clear title hierarchies and key labels
- Concise yet rich encyclopedic content
- Visual ratings, key point summaries, or Top 5 modules

Content columns should be automatically adapted based on the theme, prioritized from these directions: basic profile, classification information, appearance characteristics, habits/ecology, formation mechanism/structure, growth or use conditions, care or maintenance suggestions, risks and precautions, suitable audience or scenarios, pros and cons comparison, and quick rating cards.

Visual requirements:
Light-colored clean background, soft color palette, light shadows, exquisite small icons, rounded information boxes, neat layout, high information density but not crowded, good reading experience. The overall result must look like a real science encyclopedia card suitable for publishing, reading, collecting, and serialized production, rather than an advertisement.

Please do not make it a regular commercial promotional poster. Highlight the features of "knowledge organization + modular information + illustration-style display."
items.prompt:
请根据{argument name="主题" default="动物"}生成一张高质量竖版「科普百科图」。 

这张图不是普通海报，也不是单纯插画，而是一张兼具“图鉴感、百科感、信息结构感、收藏感”的模块化科普信息图。整体风格参考高级博物图鉴、现代百科书页、生活方式知识卡和社交媒体高传播信息图的结合。

请让画面包含：
- 一个清晰漂亮的主题主视觉
- 若干局部特征放大细节
- 多个圆角模块化信息分区
- 清楚的标题层级与重点标签
- 简洁但丰富的百科内容
- 可视化评分、要点总结或Top 5模块

内容栏目请根据主题自动适配，优先从这些方向中选择并合理组合：
基础档案、分类信息、外观特征、习性/生态、形成机制/结构组成、生长或使用条件、养护或维护建议、风险与注意事项、适合人群或适用场景、优缺点对比、快速评分卡。

视觉要求：
浅色干净背景，柔和配色，轻阴影，精致小图标，圆角信息框，整洁排版，信息密度高但不拥挤，阅读体验好。整体必须像真正可以发布、阅读、收藏、系列化生产的科普百科卡，而不是广告图。

请不要做成普通商业宣传海报。要突出“知识整理 + 模块信息 + 图鉴式展示”的特征。

items.title: Character Relationship Diagram Poster Generator
items.titleZh:
Please generate a high-design character relationship map poster based on {argument name="theme" default="Demon Slayer"}. This image should not be a simple illustration, but a character relationship map that combines information visualization, narrative structure, poster design sense, and stylistic fidelity.

Please automatically complete the following:
- Identify the work and core settings corresponding to the theme
- Extract the most representative 6–12 key characters, not exceeding 15 if necessary
- Identify and display key character relationships, including blood ties, romance, friendship, alliances, hostility, master-disciple, etc.
- Automatically choose a composition method based on the work's characteristics, such as protagonist-centered, dual-core confrontation, faction-based, family tree, or chronological evolution
- Automatically refine the work's style DNA, including color, worldview symbols, textures, mood, typography, and representative elements
- Transform these stylistic elements into an overall visual design for the relationship map, rather than simply copying an official poster
- Use different colors, line types, and arrows to distinguish different relationships, ensuring clear lines and layers without clutter
- Make core characters most prominent, followed by important characters, and subordinate characters weakened to form a clear visual hierarchy
- Ensure every character name is legible, with identity or faction labels if necessary

The final product should satisfy:
- Immediate understanding of character hierarchy and key relationships
- Obvious alignment with the original work's temperament and setting
- Combines the clarity of an infographic with the premium design of a poster
- Unified, exquisite, complete, and suitable for social media sharing or poster display
- Avoids a cheap flowchart feel, messy piling, and information overload.

- 识别该主题对应的作品及其核心设定

items.title: Oriental Fantasy City Poster
items.titleZh:
Flat illustration, high-end oriental fantasy style city poster design, vertical 9:16 composition. The layout uses a diagonal + S-shaped flow extending from the bottom left to top right. The background is deep black grading down to intense dark red, creating strong warm-cool contrast and spatial depth with faint stardust and grain texture. In the center, a flowing golden energy line winds through like a flame, extending upward from the base, featuring fluid texture, particle effects, and gradient highlights, with subtle energy debris and volumetric light.

Within the golden flow, the architectural landmarks of {argument name="city" default="Guangzhou"} emerge layer by layer: the Canton Tower is the visual core with prominent proportions, surrounded by the Zhujiang New Town skyline, Liede Bridge, and modern Lingnan architectural elements. Buildings are rendered using "fine line drawing + golden luminous blocks," with clear outlines and rich details, appearing to float in a void against the golden halo, creating a surreal spatial hierarchy with slightly fogged backgrounds for added depth.

At the bottom of the frame is an oriental white-haired female figure with flowing hair like mist, naturally connecting and merging with the golden light. Her hair is translucent with gradient light effects; she has a graceful posture, eyes closed, and a serene expression, holding a bouquet of colorful flowers dotted with shimmering particles, symbolizing the spiritual connection between people and city energy. Character details are moderately simplified to emphasize the overall design.

Lighting is concentrated on the golden flow, buildings, and character outlines, creating intense chiaroscuro and visual focus. The overall atmosphere is grand, mysterious, imbued with oriental mythology, and slightly healing. Colors use black and dark red as a base with brilliant gold as the main visual emphasis. The gold has rich light-dark layers, complemented by small areas of high-saturation floral colors, maintaining a sophisticated and restrained aesthetic.

Integrated text and layout: Centered Songti font at the top reads "{argument name="city" default="Guangzhou"} · China," followed by smaller text "{argument name="date" default="2026/04/20"}" and "{argument name="author" default="LIYUE"}" below. Text uses pale gold or soft warm white, unified with the overall lighting. High-quality details, cinematic lighting, rich volumetric and particle details, clean image without noise, ultra-high 8K resolution, commercial-grade poster quality.
